plugin_asdk_app_69bc11db874881918718abac.longDescription:
Connect your Interactive Brokers account to ChatGPT and manage your portfolio through natural language. 
Ask about positions, balances, P&L, allocations, and open orders, or request real-time quotes and historical market data. 
You can also prompt ChatGPT to draft trade instructions — for example, "Buy 100 shares of AAPL at a limit of $200" — which are sent to your IBKR account for your review and approval. 
ChatGPT never submits orders directly to the market. Any trading symbols displayed or discussed are for illustrative purposes only and are not intended to portray recommendations.
Member SIPC.
plugin_asdk_app_69bc11db874881918718abac.longDescriptionZh:
将您的盈透证券账户连接到 ChatGPT，并通过自然语言管理您的投资组合。 
询问头寸、余额、损益、分配和未结订单，或请求实时报价和历史市场数据。 
您还可以提示 ChatGPT 起草交易指令——例如，“以 200 美元的限额购买 100 股 AAPL”——该指令将发送到您的 IBKR 账户供您审核和批准。 
ChatGPT 从不直接向市场提交订单。显示或讨论的任何交易符号仅用于说明目的，并不旨在描述建议。
国际投资保护公司会员。

plugin_asdk_app_6a4d14f6bfa48191a49bc4f4.longDescription:
Massive brings institutional-grade market data directly into ChatGPT. Query real-time and historical stocks data, options data, futures data, indices data, forex data, and crypto data through Massive.com's financial data API — no code or scraping required.

Stocks & equities: Real-time stock prices, historical stock data, tick-level trades and quotes, OHLC aggregates and candlestick bars, market snapshots, and stock ticker reference data for all US equities and ETFs, sourced from all US exchanges.

Options: Options contracts data including options chains, options prices, quotes, trades, open interest, and historical options data across the full US listed options market.

Futures: Futures market data including futures contracts, futures prices, trades, quotes, and historical futures data across major products.

Indices: Real-time and historical index data including index values and aggregates for major market indices.

Forex & crypto: Currency pairs, exchange rates, crypto prices, and historical FX and cryptocurrency market data.

Beyond prices, pull company fundamentals and financials, corporate actions like dividends and stock splits, market news, technical indicators (SMA, EMA, MACD, RSI), and market status. Ask ChatGPT natural-language questions — "show me NVDA's opening cross" or "chart AAPL's daily bars this quarter" — and get answers backed by licensed, exchange-sourced market data.

Built for traders, quants, analysts, and developers who need accurate stock market data, equities data, and multi-asset market data inside ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_6a4d14f6bfa48191a49bc4f4.longDescriptionZh:
Massive 将机构级市场数据直接引入 ChatGPT。通过 Massive.com 的金融数据 API 查询实时和历史股票数据、期权数据、期货数据、指数数据、外汇数据和加密数据 - 无需代码或抓取。

股票和股票：来自所有美国交易所的所有美国股票和 ETF 的实时股票价格、历史股票数据、变动水平交易和报价、OHLC 聚合和烛台条、市场快照以及股票报价参考数据。

期权：期权合约数据，包括整个美国上市期权市场的期权链、期权价格、报价、交易、未平仓合约和历史期权数据。

期货：期货市场数据，包括主要产品的期货合约、期货价格、交易、报价和历史期货数据。

指数：实时和历史指数数据，包括主要市场指数的指数值和汇总。

外汇和加密货币：货币对、汇率、加密货币价格以及历史外汇和加密货币市场数据。

除了价格之外，还应了解公司基本面和财务状况、股息和股票分割等公司行为、市场新闻、技术指标（SMA、EMA、MACD、RSI）和市场状况。询问 ChatGPT 自然语言问题 - “显示 NVDA 的开盘交叉”或“绘制 AAPL 本季度的每日柱形图” - 并获得由许可的、交易所来源的市场数据支持的答案。

专为需要 ChatGPT 内准确股票市场数据、股票数据和多资产市场数据的交易者、量化分析师、分析师和开发人员而构建。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5948004878819183847782.longDescription:
This connector lets ChatGPT and Codex securely read from and write to QuickBooks Online.

Some things you can do:
• Connect multiple QuickBooks Online companies to the same agent (great for booking intercompany JEs)
• Choose read-only or read-write access separately for each company
• Create arbitrary QuickBooks transactions, including journal entries
• Bulk-create invoices or import credit card transactions
• Upload and attach receipts and supporting files to QuickBooks transactions
• Automatically fill in your firm-specific reporting template
• The craziest use case I tried was "Clone the contents of QBO A into QBO B", and… it worked

plugin_asdk_app_6a1e0440ecc081918f60d334.productIntroEn: Your complete financial picture, ready for real conversations
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e0440ecc081918f60d334.longDescription:
Your complete financial picture, ready for real conversations

Connect every bank account, credit card, and investment account to ChatGPT — then ask it anything about your money. Era Context unifies your accounts, categorizes transactions, surfaces recurring charges, and tracks cash flow so ChatGPT can give you answers that are actually grounded in your data.

What you can do:
- See where your money went — Compare spending across months, categories, or accounts. Ask why a month felt expensive, and get a real answer.
- Catch problems before month-end — Project where you'll land on dining, travel, or any category before the damage is done.
- Audit your subscriptions — Surface every recurring charge across all your cards, flag what you're not using, and calculate what canceling the bottom five would save you.
- Get a grounded answer to "can I afford this" — Tell any AI agent what you're considering. It'll check your cash flow, upcoming bills, and buffer — and give you a straight answer.
plugin_asdk_app_6a1e0440ecc081918f60d334.longDescriptionZh:
您完整的财务状况，为真正的对话做好准备

将每个银行账户、信用卡和投资账户连接到 ChatGPT — 然后询问有关您资金的任何信息。 Era Context 可以统一您的账户、对交易进行分类、显示经常性费用并跟踪现金流，以便 ChatGPT 可以为您提供实际基于您的数据的答案。

你可以做什么：
- 查看您的资金去向 - 比较不同月份、类别或账户的支出。询问为什么一个月感觉很贵，并得到真正的答案。
- 在月底前发现问题 — 在损害发生之前，预测您将在餐饮、旅行或任何类别上遇到的问题。
- 审核您的订阅 — 显示您所有卡上的每项经常性费用，标记您未使用的内容，并计算取消最后五项可以为您节省哪些费用。
- 得到“我能负担得起吗”的切实答案 - 告诉任何人工智能代理你正在考虑什么。它将检查您的现金流、即将到来的账单和缓冲，并给您一个直接的答案。
defaultPrompts: Analyze my finances and suggest rules to automatically categorize and tidy up my transactions.
Analyze my credit card spending and tell me how to maximize my rewards points based on where I spend the most.
Am I overpaying for any of my subscriptions? Check if I have duplicate charges or if cheaper alternatives exist.
defaultPromptsZh: 分析我的财务状况并提出规则以自动分类和整理我的交易。
分析我的信用卡支出，并告诉我如何根据我支出最多的地方最大化我的奖励积分。
我是否为任何订阅支付了过高的费用？检查是否有重复收费或是否存在更便宜的替代方案。

plugin_asdk_app_6965faefe2b081919a998e14.longDescription:
Binance for ChatGPT lets you access and explore Binance public, read-only market data using natural language. Retrieve current and historical prices, order books, recent trades, candlesticks (klines), and exchange metadata across Spot, Futures, and Options. No authentication is required. This app does not access user accounts and does not support trading or transactions.

Market data is provided “as is” from Binance’s public APIs and may be delayed, incomplete, or subject to change. This information is for informational purposes only and should not be relied upon for trading or financial decisions. Binance makes no representations or warranties regarding accuracy or timeliness and disclaims all liability arising from use of this data.
plugin_asdk_app_6965faefe2b081919a998e14.longDescriptionZh:
Binance for ChatGPT 让您可以使用自然语言访问和探索币安公开、只读市场数据。检索当前和历史价格、订单簿、近期交易、烛台（k线）以及现货、期货和期权的交易元数据。无需身份验证。此应用程序不会访问用户帐户，也不支持交易或交易。

市场数据由币安的公共 API“按原样”提供，可能会延迟、不完整或可能发生变化。该信息仅供参考，不应作为交易或财务决策的依据。币安对准确性或及时性不做任何陈述或保证，并且不承担因使用该数据而产生的所有责任。

plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6774ddc08191a0750a0d.productIntro: 任何股票、ETF、共同基金、期权、外汇、大宗商品和全球指数的实时和历史股票价格、报价和价格历史记录。获得全球主要交易所的许可，具有机构级准确性。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6774ddc08191a0750a0d.productIntroEn: Real-time and historical stock prices, quotes, and price history for any ticker, spanning stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, options, forex, commodities, and global indices. Licensed by major global exchanges for institutional-grade accuracy.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6774ddc08191a0750a0d.longDescription:
Real-time and historical stock prices, quotes, and price history for any ticker, spanning stocks, ETFs, mutual funds, options, forex, commodities, and global indices. Licensed by major global exchanges for institutional-grade accuracy.

Access 200+ global market indices, ETF profiles and sector allocations, and top gainers/losers/most active tickers. Pull company fundamentals, financial statements, P/E ratio, EPS, market cap, and dividend yield.

Ingest earnings call transcripts, track earnings and IPO calendars, monitor insider transactions and institutional holdings, and review stock splits and dividends. Score news sentiment by ticker, and analyze options chains, put-call ratios, and volume/open-interest ratios for market positioning and sentiment analysis.

Query 50+ technical indicators (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Bollinger Bands, VWAP, and more), plus advanced rolling and fixed-window analytics for volatility, correlation, and performance metrics, ideal for backtesting and building trading strategies.

Check forex and currency exchange rates, global commodity prices (gold, silver, oil, natural gas, agricultural goods), and economic indicators like GDP, CPI, inflation, unemployment, treasury yields, and the federal funds rate.

Built for portfolio analysis, valuation modeling, quantitative research, and agentic workflows, from quick ticker lookups to multi-step financial analysis.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5a6774ddc08191a0750a0d.longDescriptionZh:
任何股票、ETF、共同基金、期权、外汇、大宗商品和全球指数的实时和历史股票价格、报价和价格历史记录。获得全球主要交易所的许可，具有机构级准确性。

访问 200 多个全球市场指数、ETF 概况和行业分配，以及涨幅最大/跌幅最大/最活跃的股票。拉动公司基本面、财务报表、市盈率、每股收益、市值和股息收益率。

获取收益电话会议记录、跟踪收益和 IPO 日历、监控内幕交易和机构持股，并审查股票分割和股息。按股票对新闻情绪进行评分，并分析期权链、看跌期权比率以及交易量/未平仓合约比率，以进行市场定位和情绪分析。

查询 50 多种技术指标（RSI、MACD、移动平均线、布林带、VWAP 等），以及针对波动性、相关性和绩效指标的高级滚动和固定窗口分析，非常适合回溯测试和构建交易策略。

查看外汇和货币汇率、全球商品价格（黄金、白银、石油、天然气、农产品）以及 GDP、CPI、通货膨胀、失业率、国债收益率和联邦基金利率等经济指标。

专为投资组合分析、估值建模、定量研究和代理工作流程而构建，从快速股票查找到多步骤财务分析。

plugin_asdk_app_69491eceef3c8191beb70788.productIntro: Bigdata.com 是金融领域的人工智能基础层，将引用的金融研究直接引入 ChatGPT。研究股票和公司，关注投资组合的最新消息，并查询市场数据、基本面、SEC 文件、财报电话会议记录、经纪人和分析师研究、情绪信号和优质新闻，每个答案都基于真实、可引用的来源，而不是猜测。
plugin_asdk_app_69491eceef3c8191beb70788.productIntroEn: Bigdata.com is the AI grounding layer for finance, bringing cited financial research directly into ChatGPT. Research stocks and companies, follow the latest news on your portfolio, and query market data, fundamentals, SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, broker and analyst research, sentiment signals, and premium news, with every answer grounded in real, citable sources instead of gue…
plugin_asdk_app_69491eceef3c8191beb70788.longDescription:
Bigdata.com is the AI grounding layer for finance, bringing cited financial research directly into ChatGPT. Research stocks and companies, follow the latest news on your portfolio, and query market data, fundamentals, SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, broker and analyst research, sentiment signals, and premium news, with every answer grounded in real, citable sources instead of guesses.

Search billions of documents spanning 25+ years, including 10M+ new public news documents monthly, 200+ premium news sources such as Financial Times, Benzinga, MT Newswires, CNBC and more, filings across 50+ countries, 30+ years of fundamentals, expert interviews, and podcasts. RavenPack's financial knowledge graph resolves company and entity names automatically, so one plain-language question surfaces the right filings, transcripts, news, and data. No manual ticker matching, fabricated numbers, or invented quotes.

Beyond public content, upload and search your own private documents, including notes, internal research, artifacts, and files, alongside public filings and market data, so proprietary research and public sources can be used together in the same query.

Built for anyone making a financial decision, from individual investors researching a stock or tracking their portfolio to analysts at hedge funds, asset managers, and investment banks. Run an initiation report, compare two 10-Ks, prep a pre-earnings or pre-FOMC briefing, track a competitor, catch a sentiment shift before consensus does, or build a sourced brief before a call, all from one grounded search.

Connect in seconds. No setup, no code. You're searching cited financial data from your first prompt.
plugin_asdk_app_69491eceef3c8191beb70788.longDescriptionZh:
Bigdata.com 是金融领域的人工智能基础层，将引用的金融研究直接引入 ChatGPT。研究股票和公司，关注投资组合的最新消息，并查询市场数据、基本面、SEC 文件、财报电话会议记录、经纪人和分析师研究、情绪信号和优质新闻，每个答案都基于真实、可引用的来源，而不是猜测。

搜索跨越 25 年以上的数十亿份文档，包括每月 1000 万以上的新公共新闻文档、200 多个优质新闻来源（例如 Financial Times、Benzinga、MT Newswires、CNBC 等）、跨越 50 多个国家/地区的文件、30 多年的基本面、专家访谈和播客。 RavenPack 的财务知识图谱会自动解析公司和实体名称，因此一个简单的语言问题就会显示正确的文件、记录、新闻和数据。没有手动股票匹配、伪造的数字或发明的报价。

除了公共内容之外，还可以上传和搜索您自己的私人文档，包括笔记、内部研究、工件和文件，以及公共文件和市场数据，因此专有研究和公共来源可以在同一查询中一起使用。

专为任何做出财务决策的人而设计，从研究股票或跟踪其投资组合的个人投资者到对冲基金、资产管理公司和投资银行的分析师。运行启动报告、比较两个 10-K、准备财报前或联邦公开市场委员会 (FOMC) 前的简报、跟踪竞争对手、在达成共识之前捕捉情绪转变，或在电话会议前构建一份来源简报，所有这些都来自一次扎根搜索。

几秒钟内即可连接。无需设置，无需代码。您正在搜索第一个提示中引用的财务数据。

Analyze potential risks and stock projections for TSLA
Could you analyze the 2026 outlook for the S&P 500?

Stocktwits connects AI assistants to one of the world’s largest communities of traders and investors.

Search stocks, ETFs, crypto, futures, and other markets using natural language to access real-time market conversations, retail sentiment, trending symbols, Watcher activity, and community insights. 

Whether you’re researching an earnings reaction, monitoring sentiment around a ticker, tracking breaking news, or discovering emerging market themes and trade ideas, Stocktwits provides context behind market moves, not just price updates.
plugin_asdk_app_6a427a19b1f481919c5db138.longDescriptionZh:
Stocktwits 将人工智能助手与世界上最大的交易者和投资者社区之一连接起来。

使用自然语言搜索股票、ETF、加密货币、期货和其他市场，以访问实时市场对话、零售情绪、趋势符号、观察者活动和社区见解。 

无论您是研究盈利反应、监控股票市场情绪、跟踪突发新闻，还是发现新兴市场主题和交易想法，Stocktwits 都可以提供市场走势背后的背景信息，而不仅仅是价格更新。

Show me what's trending on Stocktwits

plugin_asdk_app_69a1c78a17c08191a2281f4b.name: Next Stock - Market Insights
plugin_asdk_app_69a1c78a17c08191a2281f4b.productIntro: Next Stock – 市场洞察帮助用户通过结构化分析和历史业绩指标探索股市数据。
plugin_asdk_app_69a1c78a17c08191a2281f4b.productIntroEn: Next Stock – Market Insights helps users explore stock market data through structured analysis and historical performance metrics.
plugin_asdk_app_69a1c78a17c08191a2281f4b.longDescription:
Next Stock – Market Insights helps users explore stock market data through structured analysis and historical performance metrics.

The app delivers short-term and long-term stock picks, categorized stock rankings, portfolio breakdowns, and educational market insights based on publicly available financial data.

Users can explore different investment styles such as growth, value, dividend, and conservative strategies, while accessing curated market summaries, earnings highlights, and financial transcripts.

Designed to support independent research and financial literacy, Next Stock – Market Insights provides clear, data-driven tools to help users better understand market trends and investment strategies. The app does not provide personalized financial advice.
plugin_asdk_app_69a1c78a17c08191a2281f4b.longDescriptionZh:
Next Stock – 市场洞察帮助用户通过结构化分析和历史业绩指标探索股市数据。

该应用程序提供短期和长期选股、股票分类排名、投资组合细分以及基于公开财务数据的教育市场洞察。

用户可以探索不同的投资风格，例如增长、价值、股息和保守策略，同时访问精选的市场摘要、收益亮点和财务记录。

Next Stock – Market Insights 旨在支持独立研究和金融知识，提供清晰的数据驱动工具，帮助用户更好地了解市场趋势和投资策略。该应用程序不提供个性化的财务建议。

plugin_asdk_app_6a172fe86f5481919f73cbc3.productIntroEn: Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.
plugin_asdk_app_6a172fe86f5481919f73cbc3.longDescription:
Real-time prices, market cap, and volume for millions of crypto assets tracked by CoinMarketCap, from major cryptocurrencies to long-tail DEX tokens across every major chain.

Beyond prices: technical analysis (RSI, MACD, moving averages, Fibonacci levels, pivot points), on-chain metrics like holder distribution and supply breakdowns, and global market signals including BTC dominance, Fear & Greed Index, altcoin season gauge, leverage stats, and ETF flows.

Discover trending crypto narratives, upcoming macro events that move markets, breaking crypto news, and semantic search across crypto concepts, whitepapers, and project documentation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a172fe86f5481919f73cbc3.longDescriptionZh:
CoinMarketCap 跟踪的数百万种加密资产的实时价格、市值和交易量，从主要加密货币到每个主要链上的长尾 DEX 代币。

除了价格之外：技术分析（RSI、MACD、移动平均线、斐波那契水平、枢轴点）、持有者分布和供应细分等链上指标，以及全球市场信号，包括 BTC 主导地位、恐惧与贪婪指数、山寨币季节指标、杠杆统计数据和 ETF 流量。

发现趋势加密叙述、即将发生的影响市场的宏观事件、重大加密新闻以及跨加密概念、白皮书和项目文档的语义搜索。

plugin_asdk_app_69ea7a42a898819188d2e85a.name: YNAB: Get Good At Money
plugin_asdk_app_69ea7a42a898819188d2e85a.productIntro: 担心钱吗？可能是因为你不擅长理财。这不是性格缺陷，而是技能差距！
plugin_asdk_app_69ea7a42a898819188d2e85a.productIntroEn: Worried about money? It might be because you’re bad at money. That’s not a character flaw—it’s a skills gap!
plugin_asdk_app_69ea7a42a898819188d2e85a.longDescription:
Worried about money? It might be because you’re bad at money. That’s not a character flaw—it’s a skills gap!

YNAB is here to help you get good at money so you’ll never worry about money again.

Get access to custom tools & expert guidance on topics like saving, paying off debt, managing money with a partner, irregular income, and more—all prepared by the real humans behind the cult favorite money app, YNAB, which has helped millions of people get good at money.

Ask a question to get started and watch your money stress melt away. You’ve got this!
plugin_asdk_app_69ea7a42a898819188d2e85a.longDescriptionZh:
担心钱吗？可能是因为你不擅长理财。这不是性格缺陷，而是技能差距！

YNAB 致力于帮助您精通金钱，让您再也不用为金钱而烦恼。

获取有关储蓄、偿还债务、与合作伙伴一起理财、不规律收入等主题的定制工具和专家指导，所有这些都是由备受喜爱的理财应用程序 YNAB 背后的真人准备的，该应用程序已帮助数百万人精通理财。

提出一个问题即可开始，然后看着您的金钱压力消失。你已经得到了这个！

How do I talk to my partner about money without fighting?

plugin_asdk_app_69c3322462288191a4b198f3.productIntro: 使用 Moneytree 数据询问有关您的财务状况的问题。
plugin_asdk_app_69c3322462288191a4b198f3.productIntroEn: Ask questions about your finances using your Moneytree data.
plugin_asdk_app_69c3322462288191a4b198f3.developerName: マネーツリー株式会社
plugin_asdk_app_69c3322462288191a4b198f3.longDescription:
Ask questions about your finances using your Moneytree data.

After connecting your account, you can use ChatGPT to explore your balances and transactions in a simple, conversational way. Understand your spending patterns, track subscriptions, and review recent activity—all based on your actual financial data.

By looking across multiple transactions at once, the app helps you spot trends and habits that are hard to see on your own, making it easier to reflect on your spending and plan ahead.
plugin_asdk_app_69c3322462288191a4b198f3.longDescriptionZh:
使用 Moneytree 数据询问有关您的财务状况的问题。

连接帐户后，您可以使用 ChatGPT 以简单的对话方式探索您的余额和交易。了解您的支出模式、跟踪订阅并查看最近的活动——所有这些都基于您的实际财务数据。

通过同时查看多笔交易，该应用程序可以帮助您发现自己难以发现的趋势和习惯，从而更轻松地反思您的支出并提前计划。

plugin_asdk_app_6a71afcb8c6081919e422e5c.productIntro: Bybit 是全球领先的加密货币交易所。该插件直接在您的 ChatGPT 对话中提供实时公开市场数据 - 无需帐户或 API 密钥。
plugin_asdk_app_6a71afcb8c6081919e422e5c.productIntroEn: Bybit is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange. This plugin provides real-time public market data directly in your ChatGPT conversations — no account or API key required.
plugin_asdk_app_6a71afcb8c6081919e422e5c.longDescription:
Bybit is a leading global cryptocurrency exchange. This plugin provides real-time public market data directly in your ChatGPT conversations — no account or API key required.

Capabilities:
• Real-time prices: Get the latest price, 24h change, and trading volume for any spot or futures pair on Bybit.
• K-line charts: Retrieve candlestick (OHLCV) data across multiple timeframes (1m to 1M), rendered as an interactive chart widget.
• Order book depth: View live bid/ask spread and market depth for any symbol.
• Contract specs: Look up minimum order quantity, tick size, and maximum leverage for any instrument.
• Funding rate: Check the current funding rate for USDT perpetual futures.

All data is sourced from Bybit's public REST API (v5). Provided for informational purposes only. Does not constitute investment advice, an offer, or a solicitation to engage in any transaction.
plugin_asdk_app_6a71afcb8c6081919e422e5c.longDescriptionZh:
Bybit 是全球领先的加密货币交易所。该插件直接在您的 ChatGPT 对话中提供实时公开市场数据 - 无需帐户或 API 密钥。

能力：
• 实时价格：获取Bybit上任何现货或期货对的最新价格、24小时变化以及交易量。
• K 线图表：检索跨多个时间范围（1m 到1M）的烛台(OHLCV) 数据，呈现为交互式图表小部件。
• 订单簿深度：查看任何品种的实时买/卖价差和市场深度。
• 合约规格：查找任何工具的最小订单数量、价格变动大小和最大杠杆。
• 资金费率：查看USDT永续合约当前的资金费率。

所有数据均源自Bybit的公共REST API（v5）。仅供参考。不构成投资建议、要约或参与任何交易的招揽。

plugin_asdk_app_698cc05c31308191b8d5e3ff.longDescription:
Token Terminal MCP brings institutional-grade blockchain data into ChatGPT.

Query standardized onchain financial and usage metrics across 100+ blockchains, 1,200+ applications, and 3,000+ tokenized assets — using natural language.

The MCP connects ChatGPT directly to Token Terminal’s data layer, which transforms raw blockchain activity into clean and comparable metrics.

With Token Terminal MCP, you can:

• Analyze the usage and activity of any blockchain
• Analyze any tokenized asset or application through 25+ different metrics
• Get access to full historical data
• Answer research questions without dashboards or SQL

Built for investors, analysts, developers, and researchers who want reliable blockchain data in a clean and standardized format.

A Token Terminal account is required. A free tier is available.
plugin_asdk_app_698cc05c31308191b8d5e3ff.longDescriptionZh:
令牌终端 MCP 将机构级区块链数据引入 ChatGPT。

使用自然语言查询 100 多个区块链、1,200 多个应用程序和 3,000 多个代币化资产的标准化链上财务和使用指标。

MCP 将 ChatGPT 直接连接到 Token Terminal 的数据层，将原始区块链活动转换为干净且可比较的指标。

使用令牌终端 MCP，您可以：

• 分析任何区块链的使用和活动
• 通过超过 25 种不同指标分析任何代币化资产或应用程序
• 访问完整的历史数据
• 无需仪表板或 SQL 即可回答研究问题

专为需要干净、标准化格式的可靠区块链数据的投资者、分析师、开发人员和研究人员而设计。

需要一个令牌终端帐户。提供免费套餐。

plugin_asdk_app_693850f6312c8191be5a026b.productIntroEn: PitchBook provides structured access to private capital market data across companies, investors, funds, deals, limited partners, and people. It returns normalized fields such as firmographics, financing rounds, deal terms, ownership information, financials, fund performance metrics when available, LP commitments, investor portfolios, and team details with associated source metadata.
plugin_asdk_app_693850f6312c8191be5a026b.longDescription: PitchBook provides structured access to private capital market data across  companies, investors, funds, deals, limited partners, and people. It returns normalized fields such as  firmographics, financing rounds, deal terms, ownership information, financials, fund performance  metrics when available, LP commitments, investor portfolios, and team details with associated source  metadata. Use this connector when a query requires factual private market information or retrieval of  structured data related to private companies, investment activity, or market participants. It supports  queries that involve identifying entities, summarizing historical activity, or assembling datasets for  further analysis.
plugin_asdk_app_693850f6312c8191be5a026b.longDescriptionZh: PitchBook provides structured access to private capital market data across  companies, investors, funds, deals, limited partners, and people.它返回标准化字段，例如公司结构、融资轮次、交易条款、所有权信息、财务状况、可用的基金绩效指标、有限合伙人承诺、投资者投资组合以及团队详细信息以及相关源元数据。当查询需要真实的私人市场信息或检索与私人公司、投资活动或市场参与者相关的结构化数据时，请使用此连接器。 It supports  queries that involve identifying entities, summarizing historical activity, or assembling datasets for  further analysis.

plugin_asdk_app_698b5e8ebac88191aff08639.name: Remitly
plugin_asdk_app_698b5e8ebac88191aff08639.productIntro: 您可以在汇款前使用 Chatgpt 中的 Remitly 来计划汇款。您可以询问有关交货时间、费用、费率等的问题。
plugin_asdk_app_698b5e8ebac88191aff08639.productIntroEn: You can use Remitly within Chatgpt to plan your money transfer before you send. You can ask questions about delivery times, fees, rates and more.
plugin_asdk_app_698b5e8ebac88191aff08639.longDescription:
You can use Remitly within Chatgpt to plan your money transfer before you send. You can ask questions about delivery times, fees, rates and more.

Remitly is trusted by millions of customers who rely on it to send money home, donate or have local currency while traveling abroad. Our customers and their recipients are located in over 170 countries across the globe, and Remitly offers 24/7 customer support.

You can try asking:
- What's the best rate for sending 50 usd to India from USA
- What delivery methods are supported sending USA to Mexico?
- Where can I pickup cash near Monterrey, Mexico?
- What's the fastest way to send $399 from USA to Mexico?
plugin_asdk_app_698b5e8ebac88191aff08639.longDescriptionZh:
您可以在汇款前使用 Chatgpt 中的 Remitly 来计划汇款。您可以询问有关交货时间、费用、费率等的问题。

Remitly 受到数百万客户的信赖，他们依靠它来汇款回家、捐赠或在出国旅行时拥有当地货币。我们的客户及其收件人遍布全球 170 多个国家/地区，Remitly 提供 24/7 客户支持。

你可以尝试询问：
- 从美国汇款 50 美元到印度的最优惠汇率是多少
- 从美国寄到墨西哥支持哪些递送方式？
- 墨西哥蒙特雷附近哪里可以领取现金？
- 从美国汇款 399 美元到墨西哥最快的方式是什么？

plugin_asdk_app_699835ec8b9c8191b2c6cda1.productIntro: 询问有关您的 Kubera 产品组合的问题。
plugin_asdk_app_699835ec8b9c8191b2c6cda1.productIntroEn: Ask questions about your Kubera portfolio.
plugin_asdk_app_699835ec8b9c8191b2c6cda1.longDescription:
Ask questions about your Kubera portfolio.

Connect your Kubera account to access your live balance sheet data, including net worth, assets, liabilities, and allocation.

The assistant uses this data to answer questions, surface patterns, and explain what’s in your portfolio.

Example questions:

- What is my current net worth?
- What stands out in my balance sheet?
- Where am I overly concentrated?
- Summarize my assets, liabilities, and entities
- What questions should I ask my advisor?
- Update my Tesla shares to 100 units

Kubera is the Balance Sheet for those who manage their own wealth. https://www.kubera.com/

助理使用这些数据来回答问题、揭示模式并解释你的投资组合中的内容。

示例问题：

- 我目前的净资产是多少？
- 我的资产负债表中什么最突出？
- 我哪里过于集中了？
- 总结我的资产、负债和实体
- 我应该问我的顾问哪些问题？

plugin_asdk_app_6a207f00eed0819181227b2e.name: IOL invertironline
plugin_asdk_app_6a207f00eed0819181227b2e.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Invertironline 经纪账户，并直接在对话中交易阿根廷市场。在 BYMA 上提取股票、债券、CEDEAR 和期权的实时报价和订单簿，包括希腊期权在内的完整期权链。下达买卖订单、设置止损和止盈水平，以及认购或赎回共同基金 (FCI)。查看您的投资组合持有量、结算条件下的现金余额以及最近的账户活动。每个订单在提交前都会经过验证，因此您始终会在执行任何操作之前确认价格、佣金和所需的任何宣誓声明。
plugin_asdk_app_6a207f00eed0819181227b2e.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your Invertironline brokerage account and trade Argentine markets directly in conversation. Pull real-time quotes and order books for stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, and options on BYMA, with full options chains including Greeks. Place buy and sell orders, set stop loss and take profit levels, and subscribe to or redeem mutual funds (FCI).
plugin_asdk_app_6a207f00eed0819181227b2e.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to your Invertironline brokerage account and trade Argentine markets directly in conversation. Pull real-time quotes and order books for stocks, bonds, CEDEARs, and options on BYMA, with full options chains including Greeks. Place buy and sell orders, set stop loss and take profit levels, and subscribe to or redeem mutual funds (FCI). plugin_asdk_app_6a57f2af314c8191a8d4009d.longDescription:

read-only. Ask about balances, transactions, holdings, and spending across all your

"What did I spend on groceries last month?"
"Which subscriptions am I paying for, and what do they cost per year?"

"Compare my checking account balance today with the start of the month."
"Are any of my bank connections failing?"

Synci aggregates accounts across thousands of institutions:
- Banks in Europe and the UK via GoCardless Bank Account Data
- Banks in New Zealand via Akahu
- Investment brokerages and crypto exchanges via SnapTrade

All connected accounts are visible through one MCP server, in their native currencies.

帐户集中在一处：

plugin_asdk_app_699727751b1c819193883394.productIntro: FactSet 模型上下文协议 (MCP) 是一种基于 API 的开放标准，旨在无缝连接不同平台上的财务数据、分析模型和应用程序。通过实现流畅的互操作性，MCP 使投资团队能够轻松分享见解、简化工作流程并增强协作，无论其工具或技术堆栈如何。借助 MCP，公司可以有效地集成新的解决方案、推动创新并最大限度地提高其财务运营的价值，从而确保在整个投资过程中做出一致的、基于背景的决策。
plugin_asdk_app_699727751b1c819193883394.productIntroEn: FactSet Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open, API-based standard designed to seamlessly connect financial data, analytics models, and applications across different platforms. By enabling smooth interoperability, MCP empowers investment teams to easily share insights, streamline workflows, and enhance collaboration regardless of their tools or technology stacks.
plugin_asdk_app_699727751b1c819193883394.longDescription: FactSet Model Context Protocol (MCP) is an open, API-based standard designed to seamlessly connect financial data, analytics models, and applications across different platforms. By enabling smooth interoperability, MCP empowers investment teams to easily share insights, streamline workflows, and enhance collaboration regardless of their tools or technology stacks. With MCP, firms can integrate new solutions efficiently, drive innovation, and maximize the value of their financial operations—ensuring consistent, context-rich decision-making throughout the investment process.

plugin_asdk_app_69e33452f0bc819187a8482d.name: Rallies
plugin_asdk_app_69e33452f0bc819187a8482d.productIntro: Rallies 是一款针对股票市场的人工智能研究应用程序，基于实时数据而不是陈旧的网络结果。用简单的英语询问任何美国股票行情，并获得以实时价格、基本面、收益、SEC 文件、期权流、技术、分析师行动、内幕活动和对冲基金仓位为支持的答案。
plugin_asdk_app_69e33452f0bc819187a8482d.productIntroEn: Rallies is an AI research app for the stock market, built on live data instead of stale web results. Ask about any US ticker in plain English and get answers backed by real-time prices, fundamentals, earnings, SEC filings, options flow, technicals, analyst actions, insider activity, and hedge fund positioning.
plugin_asdk_app_69e33452f0bc819187a8482d.longDescription:
Rallies is an AI research app for the stock market, built on live data instead of stale web results. Ask about any US ticker in plain English and get answers backed by real-time prices, fundamentals, earnings, SEC filings, options flow, technicals, analyst actions, insider activity, and hedge fund positioning.

Connect your brokerage to ask questions about your own portfolio; what drove today's move, where your risk concentrates, how a holding compares to its peers — without juggling six tabs or spreadsheets.

What you can do:

Chat with any ticker or your full portfolio
Work from live charts with indicators (RSI, MACD, 20/50 MA)
Analyze earnings history, estimates, and surprises
Screen by price action, fundamentals, or technical setups
Review options flow, darkpool prints, short interest, insider and politician trades
Track your net worth and holdings across connected accounts
Follow AI Arena, where frontier models run live portfolios in public with transparent reasoning

Rallies is a research tool and does not execute trades.
plugin_asdk_app_69e33452f0bc819187a8482d.longDescriptionZh:
Rallies 是一款针对股票市场的人工智能研究应用程序，基于实时数据而不是陈旧的网络结果。用简单的英语询问任何美国股票行情，并获得以实时价格、基本面、收益、SEC 文件、期权流、技术、分析师行动、内幕活动和对冲基金仓位为支持的答案。

连接您的经纪公司，询问有关您自己的投资组合的问题；是什么推动了今天的走势，你的风险集中在哪里，持股与同行相比如何——无需处理六个选项卡或电子表格。

你可以做什么：

与任何股票或您的完整投资组合聊天
使用带有指标的实时图表（RSI、MACD、20/50 MA）
分析盈利历史、预测和意外
按价格行为、基本面或技术设置进行筛选
审查期权流程、暗池打印、空头利息、内幕交易和政客交易
跟踪您关联账户的净资产和持有量
关注 AI Arena，前沿模型以透明的推理方式公开运行实时投资组合

集会是一种研究工具，并不执行交易。

plugin_asdk_app_69ddce2022b48191a4e54461.longDescription:
Reading SEC filings is time-consuming. Financial Summarizer Pro does it for you. 

Type any US ticker symbol and the app retrieves the company's latest annual and quarterly filings from SEC EDGAR, extracts the key financial data, and presents it as a clean, structured summary — the kind an analyst would put together, in a fraction of the time.

plugin_asdk_app_6a037e4f480081919938b01d.productIntro: 您的个人财务顾问，手头有完整的分类账。通过语音、照片或聊天记录费用，并让 Manilo 对其进行分类。按类别或期间设置预算，并通过主动检查保持正轨。计划经常性收入和支出，并在任何时间范围内跟踪您的支出。问“这个月我在餐饮上是否超支了？”或“第三季度我能节省多少钱？”并获得基于您的真实数据的建议，而不是通用的提示。 30 多种工具，涵盖账户、交易、预算、类别和收据。个人拥有。当你需要的时候可以分享。

Personally owned. Shareable when you want.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6163dea5748191a30a6472.name: Crunchbase
plugin_asdk_app_6a6163dea5748191a30a6472.productIntro: 值得信赖的私人市场情报，就在您的对话中。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6163dea5748191a30a6472.productIntroEn: Trusted private market intelligence, right inside your conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6163dea5748191a30a6472.longDescription:
Trusted private market intelligence, right inside your conversation.

Crunchbase MCP brings private market data and predictive signals into the AI tools and agents you already use. Built for investors, go-to-market teams, product builders, and anyone else who needs answers, not just search results.

Ask in plain English. No code, no technical training. The MCP figures out the filters, fields, and connections you might not have known to ask for, and returns a complete, sourced answer. Most other MCP servers only offer raw search and list data.

Supercharge your workflow. Identify high-growth companies, run diligence in seconds, and act on opportunities before other firms catch on, or give your customers foresight into market movements directly in your product, without the engineering lift.

Build lists you can return to. Save companies as you find them. A search today becomes a pipeline you monitor over time.

Predictions you can act on. Forecasts of what a company is likely to do next such as: funding, acquisition, IPO, growth, shutdown, or headcount cuts, plus an estimated current valuation. Every prediction carries a confidence tier, so you can rank an entire market by likelihood instead of reading profiles one at a time. Powered by 15M+ predictions refreshed weekly.

Why Crunchbase? The only dataset combining the aggregated activity of 80M users, 1,000+ public sources, and 600k+ data team members, VC partners, and subject-matter experts.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6163dea5748191a30a6472.longDescriptionZh:
值得信赖的私人市场情报，就在您的对话中。

Crunchbase MCP 将私人市场数据和预测信号引入您已经使用的 AI 工具和代理中。专为投资者、上市团队、产品构建者以及任何需要答案（而不仅仅是搜索结果）的人而打造。

用简单的英语询问。没有代码，没有技术培训。 MCP 找出您可能不知道要求的过滤器、字段和连接，并返回完整的来源答案。大多数其他 MCP 服务器仅提供原始搜索和列表数据。

增强您的工作流程。识别高增长公司，在几秒钟内进行尽职调查，并在其他公司抓住机会之前采取行动，或者让您的客户直接在您的产品中预见市场动向，而无需工程提升。

建立您可以返回的列表。保存您找到的公司。如今，搜索已成为您随时间监控的管道。

您可以采取行动的预测。对公司下一步可能采取的行动的预测，例如：融资、收购、首次公开募股、增长、关闭或裁员，以及估计的当前估值。每个预测都带有一个置信度等级，因此您可以根据可能性对整个市场进行排名，而不是一次阅读一个市场概况。由每周刷新超过 1500 万个预测提供支持。

为什么选择 Crunchbase？唯一结合了 8000 万用户、1,000 多个公共来源以及 60 万多个数据团队成员、风险投资合作伙伴和主题专家的聚合活动的数据集。
defaultPrompts: Find US companies categorized as “AI Infrastructure” with a latest Series A or B round in the past 12 months.
Compare Wiz, Snyk, and Lacework by funding, investors, valuation, growth score, and heat score.

defaultPromptsZh: 查找过去 12 个月内进行过最新 A 轮或 B 轮融资的被归类为“人工智能基础设施”的美国公司。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6fc95ba1f0819190aa1d20.name: StrategyTune
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fc95ba1f0819190aa1d20.productIntro: StrategyTune 是一个交易策略回测平台，该插件让 ChatGPT 可以实际操作它。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fc95ba1f0819190aa1d20.productIntroEn: StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fc95ba1f0819190aa1d20.longDescription:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6fc95ba1f0819190aa1d20.longDescriptionZh:
StrategyTune 是一个交易策略回测平台，该插件让 ChatGPT 可以实际操作它。

ChatGPT 可以编写并保存您构建的部分 - 图表指标、可重复使用的市场条件（StrategyTune 将其称为信号和过滤器）以及完整的交易策略 - 然后在 StrategyTune 的沙盒云中针对真实的历史市场数据逐笔运行它们。一个简单的策略可以在几秒钟内回测一年的历史，因此您可以快速迭代。

它不仅限于自动化策略回测。 ChatGPT 可以在同一沙箱中运行自定义研究代码：计算情况发生的频率、测量特定时刻的值、收集您自己的统计数据并在运行期间写入日志。您说出要检查的内容，ChatGPT 会编写代码，运行它，读回输出，并告诉您发现了什么。

运行结束后，您将获得完整的报告——绩效统计数据以及背后的各个交易。 ChatGPT 还可以使用您已经打开的 StrategyTune 图表：读取柱形图和每个指标的计算值、添加和配置指标、在时间线上标记这些条件，以便您可以准确地看到它们何时保持，以及切换工具或时间范围。读取计算值还可以让它调试自己的工作：如果它编写的指标在图表上看起来错误，它可以检查线条后面的实际数字而不是猜测。

一切都基于历史数据。该插件不会连接到经纪人、下实时订单或提供投资建议。

plugin_asdk_app_6a383168e69881918059edd8.productIntro: StockLens 每晚对 9,500 多只股票进行评分，涵盖五个领域：基本面、技术面、风险、情绪和宏观。询问任何股票并获取其最新的综合得分、其背后的领域得分以及得分运行中出现的优势和挑战。无需登录。
plugin_asdk_app_6a383168e69881918059edd8.productIntroEn: StockLens scores 9,500+ stocks every night across five domains: Fundamental, Technical, Risk, Sentiment, and Macro. Ask about any ticker and get its latest composite score, the domain scores behind it, and the strengths and challenges the scoring run surfaced. No sign-in needed.
plugin_asdk_app_6a383168e69881918059edd8.longDescription:
StockLens scores 9,500+ stocks every night across five domains: Fundamental, Technical, Risk, Sentiment, and Macro. Ask about any ticker and get its latest composite score, the domain scores behind it, and the strengths and challenges the scoring run surfaced. No sign-in needed.

Find your next idea instead of checking one ticker at a time. Discover Stocks screens the whole nightly-analyzed universe by region, exchange, sector, industry, market cap, or volume and ranks the results by any StockLens score, so "the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ" is a single question. Free accounts browse with scores hidden; Pro and Max unlock the ranked results.

When one stock matters, start a full analysis on demand, follow its progress, and read the result. Plus Analysis adds an AI narrative. And one question tells you how every stock on your watchlist scored last night.

Try:
- "How does NVDA score on StockLens?"
- "Show me the five highest-scored Technology stocks on NASDAQ from last night's run"
- "Run a StockLens analysis on GOOGL"
- "How do the stocks on my StockLens watchlist score?"

Analyses, discovery, and your watchlist connect to your StockLens account over OAuth. For informational and educational purposes only, not investment advice.

plugin_asdk_app_69d5272920808191b932805b.longDescription:
Double manages the month-end close. It replaces spreadsheets and scattered checklists with a single system connected to your GL or ERP: tasks, team assignments, and close status all in one place.

Create and reassign tasks, turn meeting notes into action items, and draft status updates for your team or clients, with changes writing back to Double in real time. You control what ChatGPT can read or update in your account.

plugin_asdk_app_696f6caca330819182455857.name: Buy Or Rent Simulator
plugin_asdk_app_696f6caca330819182455857.productIntro: 通过全面的购买与租赁模拟器做出最明智的房地产决策。该应用程序提供客观的、数据驱动的分析，以确定购买房产是否真的比在其他地方租赁和投资更有利可图。
plugin_asdk_app_696f6caca330819182455857.productIntroEn: Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.
plugin_asdk_app_696f6caca330819182455857.longDescription:
Make the most informed real estate decision with a comprehensive Buy vs. Rent simulator. This app provides an objective, data-driven analysis to determine if buying a property is truly more profitable than renting and investing your capital elsewhere.

By integrating historical and projected IMF inflation data for your specific country, the simulator tracks the real value of your money year after year. It provides a complete financial breakdown from your first mortgage payment to the final resale, ensuring you stay objective based on your unique project.

Key features:
- Uses country-specific IMF inflation data for realistic long-term projections
- Compares the cost of buying with potential returns of alternative investments (stock market, savings, etc.)
- No account or registration required — start simulating immediately
- Toggle advanced parameters and view a full amortization table to understand every payment of your mortgage

Adjustable parameters:
- Property: Purchase price, notary fees, renovation costs, and agency fees
- Financing: Down payment, loan duration, mortgage rate, insurance, and prepayment penalties
- Rental: Monthly rent and projected annual rent increases
- Market Logic: Resale horizon, country-specific inflation (IMF), and alternative investment yield
- Costs: Local property taxes and maintenance

Get a clear, visual report on your break-even point and see exactly when ownership starts to pay off.
plugin_asdk_app_696f6caca330819182455857.longDescriptionZh:
通过全面的购买与租赁模拟器做出最明智的房地产决策。该应用程序提供客观的、数据驱动的分析，以确定购买房产是否真的比在其他地方租赁和投资更有利可图。

通过历史整合和您所在国家/地区的预测国际货币基金组织通胀数据，模拟器可以年复一年地跟踪您的资金的实际价值。它提供了从您的第一笔抵押贷款付款到最终转售的完整财务明细，确保您根据自己的独特项目保持客观。

主要特点：
- 使用特定国家的国际货币基金组织通胀数据进行现实的长期预测
- 将购买成本与另类投资（股票市场、储蓄等）的潜在回报进行比较
- 无需帐户或注册 - 立即开始模拟
- 切换高级参数并查看完整的摊销表以了解您的抵押贷款的每笔付款

可调参数：
- 房产：购买价、公证费、装修费、中介费
- 融资：首付、贷款期限、抵押贷款利率、保险和提前还款罚款
- 租金：月租金和预计年租金上涨
- 市场逻辑：转售期限、特定国家通胀（IMF）和另类投资收益率
- 成本：当地财产税和维护费

获得关于收支平衡点的清晰、直观的报告，并准确了解所有权何时开始获得回报。

defaultPromptsZh: 我应该购买 225,000 欧元的房产还是继续以 1150 欧元/月的价格租房？

plugin_asdk_app_6a21e73e0710819187cded8a.name: REPSLog
plugin_asdk_app_6a21e73e0710819187cded8a.productIntro: REPSLog 帮助房地产专业人士记录和审查计入美国税务目的房地产专业身份 (REPS) 的工作时间。连接您的 REPSLog 帐户，您可以使用简单语言添加时间日志（例如，“记录今天显示橡树街房产的 2 小时”），然后按房产、类别、参与者或日期范围询问您的时间。
plugin_asdk_app_6a21e73e0710819187cded8a.productIntroEn: REPSLog helps real estate professionals log and review the work hours that count toward Real Estate Professional Status (REPS) for U.S. tax purposes. Connect your REPSLog account and you can add a time log in plain language (for example, "log 2 hours showing the Oak Street property today"), then ask for your hours back by property, category, participant, or date range.
plugin_asdk_app_6a21e73e0710819187cded8a.longDescription:
REPSLog helps real estate professionals log and review the work hours that count toward Real Estate Professional Status (REPS) for U.S. tax purposes. Connect your REPSLog account and you can add a time log in plain language (for example, "log 2 hours showing the Oak Street property today"), then ask for your hours back by property, category, participant, or date range.

The connector can create a time log and read your existing data: list your properties, categories, and participants, pull individual logs, and get summaries of total hours. Everything is scoped to your own authenticated REPSLog account. It does not access or share other users' data.

Requires a REPSLog account with an active Premium subscription. That subscription is purchased separately in the standalone REPSLog mobile and web apps, not through ChatGPT. Logs created here sync to those apps, so your records stay in one place for IRS documentation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a21e73e0710819187cded8a.longDescriptionZh:
REPSLog 帮助房地产专业人士记录和审查计入美国税务目的房地产专业身份 (REPS) 的工作时间。连接您的 REPSLog 帐户，您可以使用简单语言添加时间日志（例如，“记录今天显示橡树街房产的 2 小时”），然后按房产、类别、参与者或日期范围询问您的时间。

连接器可以创建时间日志并读取现有数据：列出您的属性、类别和参与者，提取单个日志并获取总小时数摘要。一切都仅限于您自己经过身份验证的 REPSLog 帐户。它不会访问或共享其他用户的数据。

需要具有有效高级订阅的 REPSLog 帐户。该订阅是在独立的 REPSLog 移动和 Web 应用程序中单独购买的，而不是通过 ChatGPT 购买。此处创建的日志会同步到这些应用程序，因此您的记录会保留在一个地方作为 IRS 文档。
defaultPrompts: How close am I to my REPS hours goal?
Break down my REPS hours by property.
Show me my REPS dashboard for this year.
defaultPromptsZh: 我离 REPS 时间目标有多近？
按财产细分我的 REPS 小时数。
显示我今年的 REPS 仪表板。

plugin_asdk_app_6962131222a8819195dca005.productIntro: Kredit 是一家专注于阿联酋的信用卡比较网站，可帮助您快速找到符合您实际消费方式的信用卡。在一个地方，您可以浏览多家银行的优惠并并排比较关键详细信息，例如现金返还率、奖励、欢迎奖金、年费、资格要求和核心福利（旅行福利、休息室使用权、餐饮折扣等）。
plugin_asdk_app_6962131222a8819195dca005.productIntroEn: Kredit is a UAE-focused credit card comparison website that helps you quickly find cards that match how you actually spend. In one place, you can browse offers from multiple banks and compare key details side by side — like cashback rates, rewards, welcome bonuses, annual fees, eligibility requirements, and core benefits (travel perks, lounge access, dining discounts, and more).
plugin_asdk_app_6962131222a8819195dca005.longDescription:
Kredit is a UAE-focused credit card comparison website that helps you quickly find cards that match how you actually spend. In one place, you can browse offers from multiple banks and compare key details side by side — like cashback rates, rewards, welcome bonuses, annual fees, eligibility requirements, and core benefits (travel perks, lounge access, dining discounts, and more).

Instead of digging through scattered pages, Kredit makes it easier to narrow your options with simple filters and clear explanations of what each feature means in practice. Whether you’re looking for everyday savings on groceries and fuel, better value on flights and hotels, or a low-fee card to keep things simple, you can sort and compare cards based on what matters most to you.
plugin_asdk_app_6962131222a8819195dca005.longDescriptionZh:
Kredit 是一家专注于阿联酋的信用卡比较网站，可帮助您快速找到符合您实际消费方式的信用卡。在一个地方，您可以浏览多家银行的优惠并并排比较关键详细信息，例如现金返还率、奖励、欢迎奖金、年费、资格要求和核心福利（旅行福利、休息室使用权、餐饮折扣等）。

Kredit 无需挖掘分散的页面，而是通过简单的过滤器和对每个功能在实践中含义的清晰解释，让您更轻松地缩小选择范围。无论您是在寻找日常杂货和燃油方面的节省、更超值的航班和酒店价格，还是为了简单起见而使用低费用卡，您都可以根据对您来说最重要的内容对卡进行分类和比较。

plugin_asdk_app_69eb5ba662bc8191bce093ca.name: ForInvest
plugin_asdk_app_69eb5ba662bc8191bce093ca.productIntro: Forinvest MCP：实时市场情报和交易集成
plugin_asdk_app_69eb5ba662bc8191bce093ca.productIntroEn: Forinvest MCP: Real-Time Market Intelligence & Trading Integration
plugin_asdk_app_69eb5ba662bc8191bce093ca.developerName: ForInvest Yazılım ve Teknoloji Hizmetleri A.Ş.
plugin_asdk_app_69eb5ba662bc8191bce093ca.longDescription:
Forinvest MCP: Real-Time Market Intelligence & Trading Integration

Connect your AI assistant directly to the heartbeat of global financial markets. The Forinvest MCP (Model Context Protocol) app transforms ChatGPT into a powerful financial agent with 22 MCP tools, providing secure, low-latency access to:

Live Market Data: Instant access to BIST, VIOP, global indices, commodities, and crypto prices.

Advanced Analytics: Professional-grade technical analysis tools and financial indicators at your fingertips.

Smart Portfolio Insights: Seamlessly retrieve and analyze portfolio data with institutional precision.

Seamless Connectivity: Built on the MCP standard for secure, bidirectional communication between ChatGPT and Forinvest's robust financial infrastructure.

Whether you're tracking real-time price movements or seeking deep market analysis, Forinvest MCP provides the reliable data layer needed for informed decision-making.

We provide a next-generation financial ecosystem, offering real-time Borsa Istanbul (BIST) data, AI-driven stock analysis, and comprehensive financial tools. Our platform streamlines investment processes by integrating deep-dive balance sheet metrics, brokerage expectations, and instant access to public disclosure (KAP) documents.

Data collected: ForInvest account credentials (for OAuth authentication), symbol codes and date ranges you query, and session identifiers. Tool inputs and outputs are not stored beyond the active session. Financial data returned by tools is sent back to ChatGPT for display. No personal data is sold or used for advertising.

Privacy Policy: https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html
plugin_asdk_app_69eb5ba662bc8191bce093ca.longDescriptionZh:
Forinvest MCP：实时市场情报和交易集成

将您的人工智能助手直接连接到全球金融市场的心跳。 Forinvest MCP（模型上下文协议）应用程序将 ChatGPT 转变为具有 22 个 MCP 工具的强大金融代理，提供安全、低延迟的访问：

实时市场数据：即时访问 BIST、VIOP、全球指数、商品和加密货币价格。

高级分析：专业级技术分析工具和财务指标触手可及。

智能投资组合洞察：以机构精度无缝检索和分析投资组合数据。

无缝连接：基于 MCP 标准构建，可在 ChatGPT 和 Forinvest 强大的金融基础设施之间进行安全、双向通信。

无论您是跟踪实时价格变动还是寻求深入的市场分析，Forinvest MCP 都能提供做出明智决策所需的可靠数据层。

我们提供下一代金融生态系统，提供实时伊斯坦布尔证券交易所 (BIST) 数据、人工智能驱动的股票分析和全面的金融工具。我们的平台通过集成深入的资产负债表指标、经纪预期和即时访问公开披露 (KAP) 文件来简化投资流程。

收集的数据：ForInvest 帐户凭据（用于 OAuth 身份验证）、您查询的符号代码和日期范围以及会话标识符。工具输入和输出不会存储在活动会话之外。工具返回的财务数据被发送回ChatGPT进行显示。不会出售个人数据或将其用于广告。

隐私政策：https://mcp.forinvest.com/privacy.html

defaultPromptsZh: BIST 30 基本面分析和报告

plugin_asdk_app_69513da1b04881919f74ae07.productIntro: SecureLend 帮助用户在一处比较多个类别的贷款和融资选项。
plugin_asdk_app_69513da1b04881919f74ae07.productIntroEn: SecureLend helps users compare loan and financing options across multiple categories in one place.
plugin_asdk_app_69513da1b04881919f74ae07.longDescription:
SecureLend helps users compare loan and financing options across multiple categories in one place.

Users can review and compare business loans, personal loans, mortgages, auto financing, student loans, and other financing scenarios. SecureLend provides calculators and comparison tools to help users understand estimated rates, payments, and trade-offs. SecureLend does not collect sensitive personal information and only gathers limited prequalification details when necessary. SecureLend is designed to operate without authentication, and all features are accessible without sign-in.

SecureLend does not provide loans or make credit decisions. All results are informational only. When users choose to apply, they are guided to third-party providers and explicitly consent before any information is shared.

SecureLend is designed as a modular financial comparison platform and may expand to additional financial products over time.
plugin_asdk_app_69513da1b04881919f74ae07.longDescriptionZh:
SecureLend 帮助用户在一处比较多个类别的贷款和融资选项。

用户可以查看和比较商业贷款、个人贷款、抵押贷款、汽车融资、学生贷款和其他融资场景。 SecureLend 提供计算器和比较工具，帮助用户了解估计费率、付款和权衡。 SecureLend 不会收集敏感的个人信息，仅在必要时收集有限的资格预审详细信息。 SecureLend 的设计无需身份验证即可运行，无需登录即可使用所有功能。

SecureLend 不提供贷款或做出信贷决策。所有结果仅供参考。当用户选择申请时，他们会被引导至第三方提供商并在共享任何信息之前明确同意。

SecureLend 被设计为模块化金融比较平台，随着时间的推移可能会扩展到其他金融产品。

plugin_asdk_app_6a283782f9d48191a3422b95.productIntroEn: Answers about U.S. public companies grounded in primary SEC filings, with every figure linked back to its source on SEC EDGAR. plugin_asdk_app_6a283782f9d48191a3422b95.longDescription: Answers about U.S. public companies grounded in primary SEC filings, with every figure linked back to its source on SEC EDGAR. Pull exact as-filed XBRL facts and multi-period financial statements, track a metric across fiscal periods, screen and rank 5,500+ companies by financials, compare peers, read filing sections (risk factors, MD&A, earnings), and full-text search SEC EDGAR. Coverage: 10-K/10-Q (and amendments), 8-K, 20-F/40-F/6-K (foreign issuers that file with the SEC), and DEF 14A proxy statements. Not covered: insider/ownership filings (Forms 3/4/5, 13D/G), institutional holdings (13F), or registration/offering prospectuses (S-1, 424B). Updated daily from SEC EDGAR; daily end-of-day prices from a market-data feed. Informational research tool, not investment advice. Free up to 500 queries/day.

plugin_asdk_app_69987578d8a48191b241aa0e.productIntro: Allianz Direct 西班牙汽车保险浏览器提供了一种透明的方式来可视化和了解 ChatGPT 中的 Allianz Direct 汽车保险选项。该工具可帮助您了解汽车保险保单的结构，重点是清晰度和定制化。使用此应用程序设计潜在的策略配置，了解保护详细信息，并在无需任何承诺的情况下获得估计价格。
plugin_asdk_app_69987578d8a48191b241aa0e.productIntroEn: The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization.
plugin_asdk_app_69987578d8a48191b241aa0e.longDescription:
The Allianz Direct Spain Car Insurance Explorer offers a transparent way to visualize and understand Allianz Direct car insurance options within ChatGPT. This tool helps you see how a car insurance policy could be structured, focusing on clarity and customization. Use this app to design a potential policy configuration, learn about protection details, and get an estimated price without any commitment.

Key Features:
• Detailed Coverage Analysis: Receive detailed breakdowns of what is included and what can be included in an Allianz Direct policy for a specific type of car.

• Clarified Terms: Request immediate definitions of insurance concepts (e.g., "additional coverage" or "exclusions") to ensure you fully understand the terminology used.

• Interactive Customization: Understand policy parameters, such as liability limits or specific coverage inclusions, to see how they influence the insurance estimate.

How it works:

Simply describe your car's characteristics and what you need (e.g., "A basic third-party car insurance for a Seat Ibiza"). The app will generate a corresponding non-binding policy outline. You can then ask the assistant for information about the coverage, request modifications to the details, or ask for explanations of specific clauses to see how the coverage adapts to your needs and what options are available. If you wish to proceed, the app will request the necessary details and provide a price estimate. For an official quote or policy issuance, users are directed to Allianz Direct's official purchasing channels.

Note: This tool is for informational and exploration purposes only, providing estimates based on the details shared in the chat. Official policy issuance requires verification through Allianz Direct Spain's official website. The insurance part of the Service that Allianz Direct operates is subject to human oversight by Allianz; you may contact human advisors at any time through Allianz Direct's official channels. 

Please bear in mind that AI systems may produce outputs that are inaccurate, incomplete or not fully adapted to specific circumstances, and the accuracy of any indicative quotation depends directly on the accuracy and completeness of the information provided.

Important: Do NOT provide payment data (bank account numbers, IBANs, payment card details), national identity documents (DNI/NIE), passport numbers or any other sensitive personal identification data through this chat. Such data should only be provided through Allianz Direct's secure contracting environment. 

Data required for quotation: To generate an indicative quotation, the Service will request the following information: date of birth, driving license details, vehicle data (registration plate, date of first registration and type of use), postcode, estimated annual mileage and payment frequency preference. The Service does not collect national identification documents or any special categories of personal data.
plugin_asdk_app_69987578d8a48191b241aa0e.longDescriptionZh:
Allianz Direct 西班牙汽车保险浏览器提供了一种透明的方式来可视化和了解 ChatGPT 中的 Allianz Direct 汽车保险选项。该工具可帮助您了解汽车保险保单的结构，重点是清晰度和定制化。使用此应用程序设计潜在的策略配置，了解保护详细信息，并在无需任何承诺的情况下获得估计价格。

主要特点：
• 详细的承保范围分析：接收有关特定类型汽车的 Allianz Direct 保单中包含的内容和可以包含的内容的详细细目。

• 澄清术语：要求立即定义保险概念（例如“附加承保范围”或“除外责任”），以确保您完全理解所使用的术语。

• 交互式定制：了解保单参数，例如责任限额或特定承保范围，了解它们如何影响保险估算。

工作原理：

只需描述您的汽车的特点和您的需求（例如，“Seat Ibiza 的基本第三方汽车保险”）。该应用程序将生成相应的非约束性政策大纲。然后，您可以向助理询问有关承保范围的信息，请求修改详细信息，或要求对特定条款进行解释，以了解承保范围如何适应您的需求以及有哪些选项可用。如果您想继续，该应用程序将请求必要的详细信息并提供估计价格。如需官方报价或保单签发，用户可前往 Allianz Direct 的官方购买渠道。

注意：此工具仅用于提供信息和探索目的，根据聊天中共享的详细信息提供估计。官方保单签发需要通过 Allianz Direct Spain 官方网站进行验证。 Allianz Direct 运营的服务的保险部分受到 Allianz 的人工监督；您可以随时通过 Allianz Direct 的官方渠道联系人工顾问。 

请记住，人工智能系统可能会产生不准确、不完整或不完全适应特定情况的输出，任何指示性报价的准确性直接取决于所提供信息的准确性和完整性。
重要提示：请勿通过此聊天提供付款数据（银行帐号、IBAN、支付卡详细信息）、国民身份证件 (DNI/NIE)、护照号码或任何其他敏感的个人身份数据。此类数据只能通过 Allianz Direct 的安全签约环境提供。 

报价所需数据：为了生成指示性报价，服务将要求提供以下信息：出生日期、驾驶执照详细信息、车辆数据（车牌、首次注册日期和使用类型）、邮政编码、预计年里程和付款频率偏好。该服务不收集国民身份证件或任何特殊类别的个人数据。

plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1d6b65d48191ae6458f5.name: UK Property Valuation
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1d6b65d48191ae6458f5.productIntro: 想知道英国的房屋值多少钱吗？该应用程序可帮助您使用真实售价和能源性能证书在 ChatGPT 中探索这一点，而不是根据列表网站进行猜测。
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1d6b65d48191ae6458f5.productIntroEn: Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside ChatGPT using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1d6b65d48191ae6458f5.longDescription:
Wondering what a UK home is worth? This app helps you explore that inside ChatGPT using real sold prices and energy-performance certificates — not guesswork from listing sites.

Give it an address or postcode and you get a clear property report: recent sales nearby, certificate ratings and floor area where available, a map of the area, and how local prices compare on a per-square-foot basis. You can also search certificates by postcode — useful if you care about energy ratings (for example homes rated E to G when planning retrofit work).

The data is official UK open information: Land Registry transaction prices and the public EPC register, for England and Wales. The app is for research only. It does not list homes for sale, take payments, book viewings, file EPC paperwork, or replace a formal surveyor's valuation or mortgage decision. For major financial choices, use the report as a starting point and speak to a qualified professional where you need one.
plugin_asdk_app_6a0c1d6b65d48191ae6458f5.longDescriptionZh:
想知道英国的房屋值多少钱吗？该应用程序可帮助您使用真实售价和能源性能证书在 ChatGPT 中探索这一点，而不是根据列表网站进行猜测。

给它一个地址或邮政编码，你就会得到一份清晰的房产报告：附近最近的销售情况、证书评级和建筑面积（​​如果有）、该地区的地图以及当地每平方英尺价格的比较。您还可以按邮政编码搜索证书 - 如果您关心能源评级（例如在计划改造工作时评级为 E 到 G 的房屋），这很有用。

该数据是英国官方公开信息：英格兰和威尔士的土地登记处交易价格和公共 EPC 登记处。该应用程序仅供研究之用。它不会列出待售房屋、收取付款、看书、提交 EPC 文件或取代正式测量师的估价或抵押决策。对于重大的财务选择，请以该报告为起点，并在需要时与合格的专业人士交谈。

plugin_asdk_app_6a3a611198a08191a97463e7.description: 对 DATEV 的受控访问
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a611198a08191a97463e7.productIntro: Klardaten DATEV-Connector 通过 ChatGPT 为授权用户提供对 DATEV 会计、薪资、文档管理、订单管理和主数据的受控访问。它支持引导式发现、范围列表和详细信息查找、财务报告、DMS 元数据和内容搜索、文档检索、订单检查、工资快照和主数据访问。通过单独批准的OAuth权限，它可以创建未提交的记账序列；它无法最终确定它们。 DMS 内容搜索仅适用于符合条件的帐户。访问仅限于经过身份验证的用户允许的 DATEV 数据和操作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a611198a08191a97463e7.productIntroEn: Klardaten DATEV-Connector gives authorized users controlled access to DATEV accounting, payroll, document management, order management, and master data through ChatGPT. It supports guided discovery, scoped list and detail lookups, financial reporting, DMS metadata and content search, document retrieval, order inspection, payroll snapshots, and master-data access.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a611198a08191a97463e7.longDescription: Klardaten DATEV-Connector gives authorized users controlled access to DATEV accounting, payroll, document management, order management, and master data through ChatGPT. It supports guided discovery, scoped list and detail lookups, financial reporting, DMS metadata and content search, document retrieval, order inspection, payroll snapshots, and master-data access. With a separately approved OAuth permission, it can create uncommitted accounting sequences; it cannot finalize them. DMS content search is available only for eligible accounts. Access is limited to the DATEV data and operations permitted for the authenticated user.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3a611198a08191a97463e7.longDescriptionZh: Klardaten DATEV-Connector 通过 ChatGPT 为授权用户提供对 DATEV 会计、薪资、文档管理、订单管理和主数据的受控访问。它支持引导式发现、范围列表和详细信息查找、财务报告、DMS 元数据和内容搜索、文档检索、订单检查、工资快照和主数据访问。通过单独批准的OAuth权限，它可以创建未提交的记账序列；它无法最终确定它们。 DMS 内容搜索仅适用于符合条件的帐户。访问仅限于经过身份验证的用户允许的 DATEV 数据和操作。

plugin_asdk_app_6994e1a4aa40819184610919.name: Sacra
plugin_asdk_app_6994e1a4aa40819184610919.productIntro: 将 Sacra 研究和数据引入 ChatGPT，将成长型和 IPO 前技术公司的可信数据运用到您的聊天、投资备忘录、会议准备等中。
plugin_asdk_app_6994e1a4aa40819184610919.productIntroEn: Bring Sacra research & data into ChatGPT to use trusted data on growth & pre-IPO technology companies into your chats, investment memos, meeting prep and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6994e1a4aa40819184610919.longDescription:
Bring Sacra research & data into ChatGPT to use trusted data on growth & pre-IPO technology companies into your chats, investment memos, meeting prep and more.

All Sacra research & data is available including:

* company & market reports and expert interviews accessible via search
* revenue estimates & models as structured data
* round-by-round funding data including valuation and price per share

For investors, VCs & corp dev: produce investmemo first drafts, quickly answer diligence questions, build comps, compare business models, track funding and key milestones, and pull the most relevant context from Sacra coverage—without hopping between tabs.

For founders & operators: map competitors, understand category dynamics, sanity-check positioning, and generate crisp briefs you can drop into a memo, deck, or internal update.

For analysts: turn messy questions into structured outputs (bulleted takeaways, peer lists, “what changed?” updates) grounded in your Sacra data.

Available to all Sacra users from free through standard, pro and platform, with usage limits determined by the plan level.
plugin_asdk_app_6994e1a4aa40819184610919.longDescriptionZh:
将 Sacra 研究和数据引入 ChatGPT，将成长型和 IPO 前技术公司的可信数据运用到您的聊天、投资备忘录、会议准备等中。

所有 Sacra 研究和数据均可用，包括：

* 可通过搜索访问公司和市场报告以及专家访谈
* 作为结构化数据的收入估算和模型
* 各轮融资数据，包括估值和每股价格

对于投资者、风险投资家和公司开发人员来说：制作投资备忘录初稿、快速回答尽职调查问题、构建比较、比较商业模式、跟踪资金和关键里程碑，并从 Sacra 报道中提取最相关的背景信息，而无需在选项卡之间跳转。

对于创始人和运营商：绘制竞争对手地图、了解品类动态、合理性检查定位，并生成清晰的简报，您可以将其放入备忘录、幻灯片或内部更新中。

对于分析师：将杂乱的问题转化为基于 Sacra 数据的结构化输出（项目符号要点、同行列表、“发生了什么变化？”更新）。

所有 Sacra 用户均可免费使用、标准版、专业版和平台版，使用限制由计划级别决定。

Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6a2ba382208191b163e604.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出计费问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷方票据缺口、按计费节奏计算的生命周期价值、试用转换。

plugin_asdk_app_6952ead1831481918360e2c2.longDescription:
The Veterans United Home Loans VA loan calculator helps Veterans and service members estimate their monthly mortgage payment. Whether you're buying a home or refinancing, it gives you a clear, complete payment picture without needing to know the fine print.

Calculator provided by Veterans United Home Loans. NMLS 1907 (www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org). Private Lender; Not endorsed or sponsored by the Dept. of Veterans Affairs or any government agency. Licensed in all 50 States. Equal Housing Opportunity.

Interest rates displayed in this calculator are shown for illustrative purposes only. Your rate may differ based on a variety of factors, including your credit score and the current market conditions. Taxes and Insurance amounts are estimates based on the loan amount.

计算器由退伍军人联合住房贷款提供。 NMLS 1907（www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org）。私人贷款人；未得到退伍军人事务部或任何政府机构的认可或赞助。在所有 50 个州获得许可。平等的住房机会。

plugin_asdk_app_6a215179debc8191a28dd0f3.description: 提供 GenAI 就绪数据
plugin_asdk_app_6a215179debc8191a28dd0f3.productIntro: Moody's Credit MCP 通过全面信用分析所需的 GenAI 数据和研究为人工智能应用程序和分析工作流程提供支持。
plugin_asdk_app_6a215179debc8191a28dd0f3.productIntroEn: Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.
plugin_asdk_app_6a215179debc8191a28dd0f3.longDescription:
Moody's Credit MCP powers AI applications and analytics workflows with GenAI-ready data and research needed for comprehensive credit analysis.

Moody's Credit MCP provides a unified layer across core credit data categories commonly used in risk assessment, offering financial analysis, default risk metrics, and qualitative insights. It combines comprehensive entity information, such as financials, ownership, and management, with Moody's Ratings proprietary ratings and research, and probability of default metrics, all enhanced by unstructured data like company filings, earnings transcripts, news, and macroeconomic trends.

By bringing structured and unstructured credit inputs together in a single interface, Moody's Credit MCP enables faster data-to-insight workflows, supporting more rigorous, consistent credit assessment and continuous monitoring of entities, markets, and portfolios.

Data includes:
- Global entity firmographics and identifiers
- Entity hierarchies and ownership structures
- Detailed global entity financials
- Moody's Ratings credit ratings and research
- Expected default frequency
- Economic data and research
- News and media
- Annual reports

Use Moody's Credit MCP for:
- Credit Analysis - access comprehensive credit risk data and research to assess creditworthiness and compare risk across issuers and instruments
- Risk Management - monitor credit risk through forward-looking measures and scenario analysis
- Relationship Management - quickly evaluate credit health to support informed engagement and credit structuring
- Ratings Advisory - align issuer details with ratings methodologies and peer benchmarks
- Investment Research - get data-driven assessments to evaluate relative value and risk
- Market Analysis - analyze sector trends and credit risk signals to assess broader market conditions
plugin_asdk_app_6a215179debc8191a28dd0f3.longDescriptionZh:
Moody's Credit MCP 通过全面信用分析所需的 GenAI 数据和研究为人工智能应用程序和分析工作流程提供支持。

穆迪信用 MCP 提供了风险评估中常用的核心信用数据类别的统一层，提供财务分析、违约风险指标和定性见解。它将财务、所有权和管理等全面的实体信息与穆迪评级专有的评级和研究以及违约概率指标相结合，所有这些都通过公司文件、收益记录、新闻和宏观经济趋势等非结构化数据得到增强。

通过将结构化和非结构化信用输入整合到一个界面中，穆迪信用 MCP 实现了更快的数据到洞察工作流程，支持更严格、一致的信用评估以及对实体、市场和投资组合的持续监控。

数据包括：
- 全球实体公司特征和标识符
- 实体层次结构和所有权结构
- 详细的全球实体财务状况
- 穆迪评级信用评级和研究
- 预期违约频率
- 经济数据和研究
- 新闻和媒体
- 年度报告

使用穆迪信用 MCP 来：
- 信用分析 - 访问全面的信用风险数据和研究，以评估信用度并比较发行人和工具的风险
- 风险管理——通过前瞻性措施和情景分析监控信用风险
- 关系管理 - 快速评估信用健康状况以支持知情参与和信用结构
- 评级咨询 - 使发行人详细信息与评级方法和同行基准保持一致
- 投资研究 - 获取数据驱动的评估来评估相对价值和风险
- 市场分析 - 分析行业趋势和信用风险信号以评估更广泛的市场状况

Create a Sector Brief for the pharmaceutical sector.
defaultPromptsZh: 为<公司>创建同行分析报告，从穆迪获取其顶级信用同行并构建完整报告。
列出穆迪涵盖美国人工智能政策的最新文件
为制药行业创建行业简介。

plugin_asdk_app_6990fc7f07cc8191989cb4df.name: Akaunting
plugin_asdk_app_6990fc7f07cc8191989cb4df.productIntro: Akaunting 帮助小型企业和自由职业者在一个地方处理日常会计。创建和发送发票，记录收入和支出，并保持帐户的井然有序的视图，以便您始终了解您的业务状况。
plugin_asdk_app_6990fc7f07cc8191989cb4df.productIntroEn: Akaunting helps small businesses and freelancers handle everyday accounting in one place. Create and send invoices, record income and expenses, and keep an organised view of your accounts so you always know where your business stands.
plugin_asdk_app_6990fc7f07cc8191989cb4df.longDescription:
Akaunting helps small businesses and freelancers handle everyday accounting in one place. Create and send invoices, record income and expenses, and keep an organised view of your accounts so you always know where your business stands.

With Akaunting, you can invoice customers and track payment status, log expenses with categories and tags, and connect bank accounts to streamline reconciliation. You can also run financial reports, such as profit & loss and cash flow, to understand performance over time.

Designed for practical bookkeeping, Akaunting gives you a clear, straightforward way to stay on top of billing, costs, and reporting — without extra complexity.
plugin_asdk_app_6990fc7f07cc8191989cb4df.longDescriptionZh:
Akaunting 帮助小型企业和自由职业者在一个地方处理日常会计。创建和发送发票，记录收入和支出，并保持帐户的井然有序的视图，以便您始终了解您的业务状况。

借助 Akaunting，您可以向客户开具发票并跟踪付款状态、按类别和标签记录支出，以及连接银行账户以简化对账。您还可以运行财务报告，例如损益和现金流量，以了解一段时间内的绩效。

Akaunting 专为实用簿记而设计，为您提供了一种清晰、直接的方式来掌握计费、成本和报告，而无需额外的复杂性。

show my cash flow
show my expenses by category
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我的损益
显示我的现金流
按类别显示我的支出

plugin_asdk_app_69a5c0184ae48191a37b0a05.productIntro: 借助 Cube MCP 服务器，您可以： - 从实际、预算、预测、差异等中查询实时 Cube 数据 - 要求 AI 生成棋盘、运行方差分析或使用真实的 Cube 数据构建财务摘要 - 直接通过人工智能聊天深入了解交易级细节和维度细分 - 保持全面的安全性：Cube 基于角色的访问控制 (RBAC) 安全模型对每个 AI 请求强制执行您的用户权限。如果你在 Cube 中看不到它，那么 AI 也看不到它
plugin_asdk_app_69a5c0184ae48191a37b0a05.productIntroEn: With the Cube MCP Server, you can: - Query live Cube data from actuals, budgets, forecasts, variances, and more - Ask an AI to generate board decks, run variance analysis, or build financial summaries using your real Cube data - Drill into transaction-level detail and dimension breakdowns directly from an AI chat - Maintain full security: Cube's role-based access control (RBAC) security…
plugin_asdk_app_69a5c0184ae48191a37b0a05.longDescription:
With the Cube MCP Server, you can:
- Query live Cube data from actuals, budgets, forecasts, variances, and more
- Ask an AI to generate board decks, run variance analysis, or build financial summaries using your real Cube data
- Drill into transaction-level detail and dimension breakdowns directly from an AI chat
- Maintain full security: Cube's role-based access control (RBAC) security model enforces your user permissions on every AI request. If you can't see it in Cube, the AI can't see it either
plugin_asdk_app_69a5c0184ae48191a37b0a05.longDescriptionZh:
借助 Cube MCP 服务器，您可以：
- 从实际、预算、预测、差异等中查询实时 Cube 数据
- 要求 AI 生成棋盘、运行方差分析或使用真实的 Cube 数据构建财务摘要
- 直接通过人工智能聊天深入了解交易级细节和维度细分
- 保持全面的安全性：Cube 基于角色的访问控制 (RBAC) 安全模型对每个 AI 请求强制执行您的用户权限。如果你在 Cube 中看不到它，那么 AI 也看不到它

plugin_asdk_app_6a8175e3469081918210ab85.name: TraderSpy
plugin_asdk_app_6a8175e3469081918210ab85.productIntro: TraderSpy 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时加密货币期货数据，因此您可以询问市场情况，而不是在交易所之间跳来跳去。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8175e3469081918210ab85.productIntroEn: TraderSpy connects ChatGPT to live crypto futures data, so you can ask about the market instead of tab-hopping between exchanges.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8175e3469081918210ab85.longDescription:
TraderSpy connects ChatGPT to live crypto futures data, so you can ask about the market instead of tab-hopping between exchanges.

Ask what the AI signal engine has published for a coin and you get the entry, the take-profit ladder, the stop and what actually happened to earlier signals — not just a direction. Ask what the whales are doing and you get real positions held by top-performing traders on Binance, Hyperliquid, Bybit and OKX, plus a leaderboard scored on PnL, win rate, ROI and consistency. Prices, candles and 13 technical indicators are one question away, and with your own account connected you can ask how far a position sits from liquidation.

Every tool is read-only. TraderSpy cannot place, close or modify an order and has no withdrawal or transfer tool — it answers questions, you place your own trades. A free account is enough to start.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8175e3469081918210ab85.longDescriptionZh:
TraderSpy 将 ChatGPT 连接到实时加密货币期货数据，因此您可以询问市场情况，而不是在交易所之间跳来跳去。

询问人工智能信号引擎已发布的代币信息，您会得到入场点、止盈阶梯、止损点以及早期信号实际发生的情况，而不仅仅是一个方向。询问鲸鱼在做什么，您可以获得币安、Hyperliquid、Bybit 和 OKX 上表现最好的交易者持有的真实头寸，以及在盈亏、胜率、投资回报率和一致性方面得分的排行榜。价格、蜡烛图和 13 种技术指标只需一问即可，通过连接您自己的账户，您可以询问仓位距清算还有多远。

每个工具都是只读的。 TraderSpy 无法下达、关闭或修改订单，也没有提款或转账工具——它回答问题，您下达自己的交易。一个免费帐户足以开始。
defaultPrompts: What are the latest AI crypto signals, and how did the last ten resolve?
Which coins are the top Hyperliquid traders long right now?
Give me RSI, MACD and ATR for BTC on the 4h.
defaultPromptsZh: 最新的人工智能加密信号是什么？最近十个信号是如何解决的？
目前顶级 Hyperliquid 交易员多头持有哪些代币？
给我 4 小时 BTC 的 RSI、MACD 和 ATR。

plugin_asdk_app_6a32a7da351c81919db830cd.name: Granatum Financeiro
plugin_asdk_app_6a32a7da351c81919db830cd.productIntro: Granatum Financeiro 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 Granatum Empresarial 帐户，以自然语言查阅财务报告、调查条目、记录动向并了解现金状况。 该应用程序允许您按期间分析损益表，监控现金流量，按类别打开条目下钻，查阅会计科目表、银行账户、成本中心、付款方式和人员登记，以及在账户有多个公司时选择公司。 通过用户授予的额外授权，它还允许您创建、编辑和删除条目。
plugin_asdk_app_6a32a7da351c81919db830cd.productIntroEn: O Granatum Financeiro conecta o ChatGPT à conta Granatum Empresarial do usuário para consultar relatórios financeiros, investigar lançamentos, registrar movimentos e entender a situação de caixa em linguagem natural.
plugin_asdk_app_6a32a7da351c81919db830cd.longDescription:
O Granatum Financeiro conecta o ChatGPT à conta Granatum Empresarial do usuário para consultar relatórios financeiros, investigar lançamentos, registrar movimentos e entender a situação de caixa em linguagem natural.
O app permite analisar DRE por período, acompanhar Fluxo de Caixa, abrir drill-down de lançamentos por categoria, consultar o plano de contas, as contas bancárias, os centros de custo, as formas de pagamento e o cadastro de pessoas, e selecionar empresas quando a conta tiver múltiplas empresas.
Com autorização adicional concedida pelo usuário, também permite criar, editar e excluir lançamentos.

* A edição e exclusão cobrem lançamentos simples; séries, lançamentos compostos e transferências seguem pela interface do Granatum.
plugin_asdk_app_6a32a7da351c81919db830cd.longDescriptionZh:
Granatum Financeiro 将 ChatGPT 连接到用户的 Granatum Empresarial 帐户，以自然语言查阅财务报告、调查条目、记录动向并了解现金状况。
该应用程序允许您按期间分析损益表，监控现金流量，按类别打开条目下钻，查阅会计科目表、银行账户、成本中心、付款方式和人员登记，以及在账户有多个公司时选择公司。
通过用户授予的额外授权，它还允许您创建、编辑和删除条目。

* 编辑和删除涵盖单个条目；系列、复合释放和传输均通过 Granatum 界面进行。
defaultPrompts: Como foi meu resultado nos últimos três meses e o que mais pesou nas despesas?

Bajaj Broking MCP Connector brings your trading and portfolio information into OpenAI-compatible MCP experiences. plugin_asdk_app_697f92324c5c8191a38a856f.name: TaxHeaven
plugin_asdk_app_697f92324c5c8191a38a856f.description: 计算英国税并检查 MTD
plugin_asdk_app_697f92324c5c8191a38a856f.productIntro: TaxHeaven 使用 HMRC 公布的费率，在 ChatGPT 内为自营职业者、自由职业者、个体商人和房东提供即时英国税务答案。
plugin_asdk_app_697f92324c5c8191a38a856f.productIntroEn: TaxHeaven gives self-employed workers, freelancers, sole traders, and landlords instant UK tax answers using HMRC-published rates, right inside ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_697f92324c5c8191a38a856f.longDescription:
TaxHeaven gives self-employed workers, freelancers, sole traders, and landlords instant UK tax answers using HMRC-published rates, right inside ChatGPT.

8 tools cover the full self-employed tax journey:
• Calculate income tax, National Insurance, and take-home pay (England and Scotland)
• Check if Making Tax Digital (MTD) applies to you and when it starts
• See all your tax deadlines with countdown timers
• Work out your payments on account and how much to save monthly
• Add or remove VAT, compare the Flat Rate Scheme, check registration thresholds
• Find out if an expense is tax-deductible under HMRC rules
• Calculate capital allowances on business equipment and vehicles
• Scan receipts and categorise them for your tax return

All calculations use official HMRC rates for 2024-25 through 2026-27. No sign-up required, no data stored, MTD compliance completely free from HMRC-recognised software.
plugin_asdk_app_697f92324c5c8191a38a856f.longDescriptionZh:
TaxHeaven 使用 HMRC 公布的费率，在 ChatGPT 内为自营职业者、自由职业者、个体商人和房东提供即时英国税务答案。

8 种工具涵盖了自营职业者的整个纳税过程：
• 计算所得税、国民保险和实得工资（英格兰和苏格兰）
• 检查税务数字化 (MTD) 是否适用于您以及何时开始
• 使用倒计时器查看所有纳税截止日期
• 计算出您的账户付款以及每月节省多少钱
• 添加或删除增值税、比较统一费率方案、检查注册门槛
• 了解根据 HMRC 规则，某项费用是否可以免税
• 计算商业设备和车辆的资本补贴
• 扫描收据并将其分类以用于纳税申报表

所有计算均使用 2024-25 至 2026-27 年的官方 HMRC 税率。无需注册，无需存储数据，MTD 合规性完全不受 HMRC 认可的软件的影响。

plugin_asdk_app_69fcc1c31b2081919069e1f5.productIntro: Facile.it Energia 可以帮助您比较意大利的天然气和电力供应。您无需访问每个提供商的网站或解读令人困惑的费率表，而是可以根据您的实际消费和位置查看最佳可用优惠，所有这些都在一个屏幕上。
plugin_asdk_app_69fcc1c31b2081919069e1f5.productIntroEn: Facile.it Energia helps you compare gas and electricity offers in Italy. Instead of visiting each provider's website or deciphering confusing rate sheets, you can see the best available offers based on your actual consumption and location, all in one screen.
plugin_asdk_app_69fcc1c31b2081919069e1f5.longDescription:
Facile.it Energia helps you compare gas and electricity offers in Italy. Instead of visiting each provider's website or deciphering confusing rate sheets, you can see the best available offers based on your actual consumption and location, all in one screen.

Tell Facile.it Energia what you need - electricity, gas, or both - and it shows you a simple form to enter your city and household consumption. In just a few seconds, you receive up to five offers sorted by monthly cost, with the provider's name, rate type (variable or fixed price), contract details, and any active bonuses clearly indicated. Each offer links directly to the provider's page on Facile.it, so you can proceed whenever you're ready.

If you want a more precise estimate, Facile.it Energia can redirect you to the section of Facile.it where you can upload a recent bill for a tailored comparison. Facile.it Energia covers exclusively the Italian residential energy market - it does not handle business contracts, insurance, mortgages, or other Facile.it products, and it does not process payments or manage existing contracts.
plugin_asdk_app_69fcc1c31b2081919069e1f5.longDescriptionZh:
Facile.it Energia 可以帮助您比较意大利的天然气和电力供应。您无需访问每个提供商的网站或解读令人困惑的费率表，而是可以根据您的实际消费和位置查看最佳可用优惠，所有这些都在一个屏幕上。

告诉 Facile.it Energia 您需要什么 - 电力、天然气或两者 - 它会向您显示一个简单的表格来输入您的城市和家庭消费。在短短几秒钟内，您将收到最多五个按月费用排序的报价，并清楚地标明提供商的名称、费率类型（可变或固定价格）、合同详细信息以及任何有效奖金。每个优惠都直接链接到 Facile.it 上的提供商页面，因此您可以随时继续。

如果您想要更准确的估算，Facile.it Energia 可以将您重定向到 Facile.it 的部分，您可以在其中上传最近的账单以进行定制比较。 Facile.it Energia 专门覆盖意大利住宅能源市场 - 它不处理商业合同、保险、抵押贷款或其他 Facile.it 产品，也不处理付款或管理现有合同。

plugin_asdk_app_69a06d6769508191b2378a0e.name: OakbrookOne
plugin_asdk_app_69a06d6769508191b2378a0e.productIntro: ChatGPT 中的 OakbrookOne 可帮助您探索如何通过简单的对话将多笔债务转化为每月付款。
plugin_asdk_app_69a06d6769508191b2378a0e.productIntroEn: OakbrookOne in ChatGPT helps you explore how turning multiple debts into one monthly payment could work for you - through a simple conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_69a06d6769508191b2378a0e.longDescription:
OakbrookOne in ChatGPT helps you explore how turning multiple debts into one monthly payment could work for you - through a simple conversation. 

Share details about the debts you’re managing and see illustrative repayment scenarios. You can understand how combining balances into one structured plan might affect your monthly payment and overall repayment timeline. 

If you choose to proceed, you can continue your application securely on Oakbrook’s website. OakbrookOne will arrange repayment directly with your existing creditors if your application is approved. 

OakbrookOne provides general information and example calculations only. Eligibility, loan terms and creditor repayment are subject to Oakbrook’s standard lending assessment.
plugin_asdk_app_69a06d6769508191b2378a0e.longDescriptionZh:
ChatGPT 中的 OakbrookOne 可帮助您探索如何通过简单的对话将多笔债务转化为每月付款。 

分享有关您正在管理的债务的详细信息，并查看说明性的还款方案。您可以了解将余额合并到一个结构化计划中可能会如何影响您的每月付款和总体还款时间表。 

如果您选择继续，您可以在 Oakbrook 网站上安全地继续您的申请。如果您的申请获得批准，OakbrookOne 将直接与您现有的债权人安排还款。 

OakbrookOne 仅提供一般信息和示例计算。资格、贷款条款和债权人还款均须遵守奥克布鲁克的标准贷款评估。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7b4c3982d081918af606c1.productIntro: 连接您的 GoCardless 帐户以查找付款、客户、授权、付款和退款，并采取创建付款、发放退款和取消授权等操作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b4c3982d081918af606c1.productIntroEn: Connect your GoCardless account to look up payments, customers, mandates, payouts, and refunds, and to take actions such as creating payments, issuing refunds and cancelling mandates.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b4c3982d081918af606c1.longDescription:
Connect your GoCardless account to look up payments, customers, mandates, payouts, and refunds, and to take actions such as creating payments, issuing refunds and cancelling mandates.

You choose what permissions to authorise when you connect. Money-moving actions show a preview and wait for your confirmation. Sensitive data such as customer email addresses are partly hidden before the model sees them. Bank account details are never shared.

Building on the GoCardless API? Ask for integration guidance and code samples, and connect to Sandbox to test.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b4c3982d081918af606c1.longDescriptionZh:
连接您的 GoCardless 帐户以查找付款、客户、授权、付款和退款，并采取创建付款、发放退款和取消授权等操作。

您可以选择连接时授予的权限。资金转移操作会显示预览并等待您的确认。客户电子邮件地址等敏感数据在模型看到之前已被部分隐藏。银行帐户详细信息永远不会被共享。

基于 GoCardless API 构建？请求集成指南和代码示例，并连接到沙箱进行测试。
