plugin_asdk_app_6a340850cfb88191af4a91da.name: D&B Risk Analytics
plugin_asdk_app_6a340850cfb88191af4a91da.productIntro: 执行由 D&B Commercial Graph™ 支持的风险工作流程
plugin_asdk_app_6a340850cfb88191af4a91da.productIntroEn: Execute risk workflows powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™
plugin_asdk_app_6a340850cfb88191af4a91da.longDescription:
Execute risk workflows powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com.

Dun & Bradstreet empowers teams to execute risk workflows such as KYC/KYB, entity resolution, screening, alert triage, and more using relationship-aware business context from the D&B Commercial Graph™. Verified risk data, anchored in the global standard D-U-N-S® Number business identifier, and policy-driven logic provide the foundation for consistent decisioning across systems of record and scalable risk operations in regulated environments.

You can use D&B Risk Analytics to:

Verify and onboard suppliers:
"Can you verify and cross-check the data from my vendor outreach form for <Company Name> for accuracy?"
Initiate third-party screening:
"Load this <Company Name> and initiate screening"
Assess overall risk:
"What is the overall risk rating for <Company Name>, and what are the key drivers behind it?"
Trace beneficial ownership:
"Who ultimately owns and controls <Company Name>, and are any owners or directors located in high-risk or sanctioned jurisdictions?"
Generate KYB decision reports:
"Give me a full KYB decision report for <Company Name> — should we approve, refer, or decline?"

Note: Requires D&B Risk Analytics license.
plugin_asdk_app_6a340850cfb88191af4a91da.longDescriptionZh:
执行由 D&B Commercial Graph™ 支持的风险工作流程

如有疑问，请联系 OpenAILeads@dnb.com。

Dun & Bradstreet 使团队能够使用 D&B Commercial Graph™ 中的关系感知业务环境来执行风险工作流程，例如 KYC/KYB、实体解析、筛选、警报分类等。基于全球标准 D-U-N-S® 编号业务标识符的经过验证的风险数据和策略驱动的逻辑为跨记录系统和受监管环境中可扩展风险操作的一致决策奠定了基础。

您可以使用 D&B Risk Analytics 来：

验证并加入供应商：
“您能否验证并交叉检查我的<公司名称>供应商外展表格中的数据的准确性？”
启动第三方筛查：
“加载此<公司名称>并启动筛选”
评估总体风险：
“<公司名称>的总体风险评级是多少，其背后的关键驱动因素是什么？”
追踪受益所有权：
“谁最终拥有和控制<公司名称>，是否有任何所有者或董事位于高风险或受制裁的司法管辖区？”
生成 KYB 决策报告：
“给我一份关于<公司名称>的完整 KYB 决策报告——我们应该批准、推荐还是拒绝？”

注意：需要 D&B 风险分析许可证。

plugin_asdk_app_6a01e9707b0c81918daa8496.productIntro: Seguro Match 帮助西班牙用户在 ChatGPT 中比较真实的家庭、汽车和摩托车保险报价。模型打开引导报价向导；嵌入式小部件收集所需的详细信息（通过目录和地址查找），根据授权保险公司系统运行报价，并显示可比较的报价和承保详细信息。要跳过表单，用户可以将当前的保单文档拖放到小部件中 - 它仅在服务器端进行处理（提取的文本仅用于预填写报价，从不发送到模型）。最终结账在 seguromatch.com 上进行； ChatGPT 内没有购买任何东西。
plugin_asdk_app_6a01e9707b0c81918daa8496.productIntroEn: Seguro Match helps users in Spain compare real home, car, and motorcycle insurance quotes in ChatGPT. The model opens a guided quote wizard; the embedded widget collects the required details (with catalog and address lookups), runs the quotes against authorized insurer systems, and shows comparable offers and coverage details.
plugin_asdk_app_6a01e9707b0c81918daa8496.developerName: Tuio Partners Correduría de Seguros, S.L.
plugin_asdk_app_6a01e9707b0c81918daa8496.longDescription: Seguro Match helps users in Spain compare real home, car, and motorcycle insurance quotes in ChatGPT. The model opens a guided quote wizard; the embedded widget collects the required details (with catalog and address lookups), runs the quotes against authorized insurer systems, and shows comparable offers and coverage details. To skip the form, users can drag and drop their current policy document into the widget — it is processed server-side only (extracted text used solely to pre-fill the quote, never sent to the model). Final checkout happens on seguromatch.com; nothing is purchased inside ChatGPT.

plugin_asdk_app_6a66f31612ac81919762182c.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出计费问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷方票据缺口、按计费节奏计算的生命周期价值、试用转换。
plugin_asdk_app_6a66f31612ac81919762182c.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.
plugin_asdk_app_6a66f31612ac81919762182c.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT to your live Chargebee subscription, invoice, customer, and payment data. Ask billing questions in natural language and get answers immediately: renewal risk, payment failure patterns, credit note gaps, LTV by billing cadence, trial conversion.

These cross-references work because Chargebee holds the full commercial event chain in one linked data model - payment events, plan changes, invoice records, cancellation reasons - all connected, all timestamped.
plugin_asdk_app_6a66f31612ac81919762182c.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 连接到您的实时 Chargebee 订阅、发票、客户和付款数据。用自然语言提出计费问题并立即获得答案：续订风险、付款失败模式、贷方票据缺口、按计费节奏计算的生命周期价值、试用转换。

这些交叉引用之所以有效，是因为 Chargebee 在一个链接的数据模型中保存了完整的商业事件链 - 付款事件、计划变更、发票记录、取消原因 - 所有这些都相互连接，都带有时间戳。

plugin_asdk_app_69c539c0d1288191831e1d2d.longDescription:
MT Newswires brings real-time global financial news directly into Codex — providing original, unbiased and comprehensive multi-asset class coverage of capital markets and economies in over 180 topics.

Powered by a global newsroom trusted by the largest banks, brokerages, professional trading, wealth management and research applications globally, every story is built for AI — so you get answers grounded in live market intelligence, not stale data.

plugin_asdk_app_6a7762af20c881919eadbba7.longDescription: Bull AI brings company documents and data for NSE/BSE-listed Indian companies into ChatGPT and Codex. plugin_asdk_app_699c42263f2481918fbe4d7a.productIntroEn: Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within ChatGPT through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.
plugin_asdk_app_699c42263f2481918fbe4d7a.longDescription:
Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance allows pilots to receive non owned aircraft renters insurance quotes directly within ChatGPT through a fast, guided conversational experience. Built specifically for aviation renters, it replaces traditional insurance forms with a simple flow and delivers a clear quote summary in seconds.

Key Features: - Real time renters insurance quotes are displayed in a structured quote summary. - Flexible coverage options include daily, weekly, monthly, or annual policies. - A transparent breakdown of liability limits and coverages is provided.

When ready to proceed, users are securely redirected to SkyWatch’s web portal to complete purchase, with previously entered information preserved.

How Does It Work?
Pilots answer a short series of aviation specific questions about their experience and coverage needs. The app generates a personalized quote and displays a detailed summary directly within ChatGPT. Users can adjust duration and review updated pricing instantly before being securely redirected to SkyWatch’s official web portal to complete policy issuance.

Who Is This For?
Student and licensed pilots who rent or borrow non owned aircraft.
Pilots who need flexible, short term coverage before a lesson, checkout, or rental flight.

Important Information:
 This app provides renters aviation insurance quotes based on the information shared during the conversation. Final pricing, eligibility, and policy issuance occur through SkyWatch’s official web platform and remain subject to underwriting review and applicable state requirements.
plugin_asdk_app_699c42263f2481918fbe4d7a.longDescriptionZh:
Skywatch Renters Aviation Insurance 允许飞行员通过快速、引导式对话体验直接在 ChatGPT 内接收非自有飞机租赁者保险报价。它专为航空租赁者打造，以简单的流程取代了传统的保险表格，并在几秒钟内提供清晰的报价摘要。

主要特点： - 实时租户保险报价以结构化报价摘要显示。 - 灵活的承保选项包括每日、每周、每月或每年保单。 - 提供责任限额和承保范围的透明明细。

当准备好继续操作时，用户将被安全地重定向到 SkyWatch 的门户网站以完成购买，并保留之前输入的信息。

它是如何运作的？
飞行员回答一系列有关其经验和覆盖范围需求的航空具体问题。该应用程序生成个性化报价并直接在 ChatGPT 中显示详细摘要。用户可以立即调整期限并查看更新的定价，然后安全地重定向到 SkyWatch 的官方门户网站以完成保单签发。

这是给谁的？
租赁或借用非自有飞机的学生和有执照的飞行员。
在上课、结帐或租赁航班之前需要灵活的短期保险的飞行员。

重要信息：
 该应用程序根据对话期间共享的信息为租客提供航空保险报价。最终定价、资格和保单签发通过 SkyWatch 的官方网络平台进行，并仍需接受承保审查和适用的州要求。

plugin_asdk_app_6a19c12f33e48191bbf02b9d.name: D&B Finance Analytics
plugin_asdk_app_6a19c12f33e48191bbf02b9d.productIntro: 使用值得信赖的 D&B 数据和分析来实现人工智能驱动的信用决策、投资组合监控和风险管理工作流程。
plugin_asdk_app_6a19c12f33e48191bbf02b9d.productIntroEn: Enable AI-powered credit decisioning, portfolio monitoring, and risk management workflows using trusted D&B data and analytics.
plugin_asdk_app_6a19c12f33e48191bbf02b9d.longDescription:
Enable AI-powered credit decisioning, portfolio monitoring, and risk management workflows using trusted D&B data and analytics. 

For inquiries, please contact OpenAILeads@dnb.com

D&B Finance Analytics empowers finance and credit teams to verify businesses, evaluate financial and predictive risk, accelerate credit decisions, monitor portfolio health, and take action through AI assistants, agents, and enterprise applications. By combining trusted D&B business intelligence, financial risk insights, predictive analytics, and workflow capabilities, organizations can bring credit and portfolio management processes directly into AI-driven workflows. 

Anchored by the global standard D‑U‑N‑S® Number and powered by the D&B Commercial Graph™, D&B Finance Analytics helps organizations reduce ambiguity, improve consistency, and make more confident commercial credit decisions at scale. It also enables teams to move from insight to action through portfolio management and workflow capabilities available within D&B Finance Analytics. 

Use D&B Finance Analytics to: 

Evaluate credit recommendation: 
"What is the recommended credit limit for [Company Name], and what factors contributed to that recommendation?" 

Assess business risk: 
"Summarize the financial risk, payment behavior, and predictive risk indicators for [Company Name]." 

Monitor portfolio health: 
"Which customers in my portfolio show elevated risk or signs of deterioration?" 

Prioritize risk management activities: 
"Which customers should I review first based on recent alerts, exposure, and risk changes?" 

Analyze ownership and corporate linkage: 
"Show the ownership structure and related entities for [Company Name]." 

Take action on portfolio: 
"Create a folder named [Folder Name], move [Company Name] to the folder and assign Alert Profile [Alert Profile Name] to the folder." 

Note: Requires a D&B Finance Analytics license.
plugin_asdk_app_6a19c12f33e48191bbf02b9d.longDescriptionZh:
使用值得信赖的 D&B 数据和分析来实现人工智能驱动的信用决策、投资组合监控和风险管理工作流程。 

如有疑问，请联系 OpenAILeads@dnb.com

D&B Finance Analytics 使财务和信贷团队能够验证业务、评估财务和预测风险、加速信贷决策、监控投资组合健康状况，并通过人工智能助手、代理和企业应用程序采取行动。通过结合值得信赖的 D&B 商业智能、财务风险洞察、预测分析和工作流程功能，组织可以将信贷和投资组合管理流程直接引入人工智能驱动的工作流程中。 

D&B Finance Analytics 以全球标准 D‑U‑N‑S® Number 为基础，并由 D&B Commercial Graph™ 提供支持，可帮助组织减少歧义、提高一致性，并大规模地做出更自信的商业信贷决策。它还使团队能够通过 D&B Finance Analytics 中提供的投资组合管理和工作流程功能将洞察转化为行动。 

使用 D&B Finance Analytics 来： 

评估信用推荐： 
“[公司名称] 的建议信用额度是多少？哪些因素促成了该建议？” 

评估业务风险： 
“总结[公司名称]的财务风险、付款行为和预测风险指标。” 

监控投资组合健康状况： 
“我的投资组合中哪些客户表现出较高的风险或恶化的迹象？” 

优先考虑风险管理活动： 
“根据最近的警报、暴露情况和风险变化，我应该首先审查哪些客户？” 

分析所有权和公司关联： 
“显示[公司名称]的所有权结构和相关实体。” 

对投资组合采取行动： 
“创建一个名为 [文件夹名称] 的文件夹，将 [公司名称] 移至该文件夹，并将警报配置文件 [警报配置文件名称] 分配给该文件夹。” 

注意：需要 D&B Finance Analytics 许可证。

plugin_asdk_app_69958093d50c81919718be4f.productIntro: Billabex 是一个人工智能驱动的应收账款和发票收集平台，可帮助财务团队直接从 ChatGPT 管理客户付款跟进。
plugin_asdk_app_69958093d50c81919718be4f.productIntroEn: Billabex is an AI-powered accounts receivable and invoice collection platform that helps finance teams manage customer payment follow-up directly from ChatGPT.
plugin_asdk_app_69958093d50c81919718be4f.longDescription:
Billabex is an AI-powered accounts receivable and invoice collection platform that helps finance teams manage customer payment follow-up directly from ChatGPT. 

Review customer accounts, contacts, invoices, credit notes, credit allocations, outstanding balances, overdue receivables, incoming emails, outgoing emails, payment communications, and account tasks in one place. 

Identify unpaid invoices and silent customers, inspect complete account and communication histories, monitor collection priorities, update customer and billing records, manage contacts, pause or resume automated payment reminders, respond to tasks raised by the AI agent, prepare scheduled communications, and send personalized payment reminder emails. 

Billabex centralizes receivables management, customer communication, invoice follow-up, credit control, and debt collection workflows so businesses can reduce late payments, improve cash flow visibility, save time on repetitive collection work, and maintain professional customer relationships.
plugin_asdk_app_69958093d50c81919718be4f.longDescriptionZh:

Billabex 集中应收账款管理、客户沟通、发票跟进、信用控制和收债工作流程，使企业可以减少逾期付款、提高现金流可见性、节省重复收款工作的时间并维持专业的客户关系。

plugin_asdk_app_69499c05441c8191bb997b5e.longDescription:

  - View onramp, offramp, and swap account details

  - "List all onramp accounts using USDC on Base"

plugin_asdk_app_6a510ec2e83c8191a9b62395.productIntro: 立即了解是否值得添加乙醇（酒精）或汽油。您在加油站输入每种燃料每升的价格，计算器将应用 70% 规则：如果乙醇价格除以汽油价格低于 0.70，则乙醇是值得的；如果乙醇价格除以汽油价格低于 0.70，则乙醇是值得的；否则，汽油是更好的选择。您还可以输入每种燃料的效率（公里/升），以进行更精确的每公里成本计算。无需注册，也不会收集个人数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a510ec2e83c8191a9b62395.productIntroEn: Find out instantly whether it's worth filling up with ethanol (alcohol) or gasoline. You enter the price per liter of each fuel at your gas station and the calculator applies the 70% rule: if the ethanol price divided by the gasoline price is below 0.70, ethanol is worth it; otherwise, gasoline is the better choice.
plugin_asdk_app_6a510ec2e83c8191a9b62395.longDescription: Find out instantly whether it's worth filling up with ethanol (alcohol) or gasoline. You enter the price per liter of each fuel at your gas station and the calculator applies the 70% rule: if the ethanol price divided by the gasoline price is below 0.70, ethanol is worth it; otherwise, gasoline is the better choice. You can also enter each fuel's efficiency (km/l) for an even more precise cost-per-kilometer calculation. No sign-up and no personal data collected.

Nella Finance AI is a read-only financial intelligence assistant for businesses and their accountants. Connect supported accounting platforms and ask questions about cash, performance, KPIs, unusual movements, management information and estimated tax positions directly from ChatGPT.

Nella provides clear summaries based on the latest available accounting data and identifies when professional accounting judgement may be required. It does not make payments, post transactions or change accounting records. Tax projections and financial insights are estimates and should not be treated as regulated financial, investment or tax advice.

GREI combines global property search and insights to help investors compare opportunities by budget, location, property type, size, rooms, floor, renovation status, and nearby signals such as metro, beach, universities, healthcare, and cultural venues.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5d0f08a1448191bacc5f73.productIntro: Amok 使 ChatGPT 能够直接接触柬埔寨的银行业、金融科技和技术监管——这是来自官方来源的逐字证据，从未被解释过。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5d0f08a1448191bacc5f73.productIntroEn: Amok gives ChatGPT direct access to Cambodia's banking, fintech, and technology regulation — as verbatim evidence from official sources, never paraphrased.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5d0f08a1448191bacc5f73.longDescription:
Amok gives ChatGPT direct access to Cambodia's banking, fintech, and technology regulation — as verbatim evidence from official sources, never paraphrased.

Ask about bank licensing and prudential rules, technology risk management, liquidity risk, payment systems and Bakong, AML/CFT, or fintech policy. Amok searches a corpus built from Cambodia's official sources — the National Bank of Cambodia's laws, prakas, and guidelines, and the Securities and Exchange Regulator of Cambodia — and returns the exact provisions: precise Article citations, current validity, and an official source link on every result so you can verify the original wording yourself. When something is missing from the corpus, Amok says so instead of guessing.

The corpus is in English. Ask in any language — ChatGPT translates and answers grounded in the official text. Results support research and compliance work; they are not a substitute for legal counsel. Free, no account needed.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5d0f08a1448191bacc5f73.longDescriptionZh:

plugin_asdk_app_6a7736cf2a908191b4878640.productIntro: REIzer 以投资者的方式承销房地产交易。给它一个价格和一些数字，它会返回 0-100 分、对该策略重要的指标、显示破坏交易的压力场景、它为您填写的每个假设以及可共享的报告链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7736cf2a908191b4878640.productIntroEn: REIzer underwrites a real-estate deal the way an investor would. Give it a price and a few numbers and it returns a 0–100 score, the metrics that matter for that strategy, stress scenarios showing what breaks the deal, every assumption it filled in for you, and a shareable report link.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7736cf2a908191b4878640.longDescription:
REIzer underwrites a real-estate deal the way an investor would. Give it a price and a few numbers and it returns a 0–100 score, the metrics that matter for that strategy, stress scenarios showing what breaks the deal, every assumption it filled in for you, and a shareable report link.

It covers long-term rental, short-term rental, BRRRR, fix-and-flip, multifamily and new construction. It can compare all six against the same property to find its best use, and solve backwards for the highest price you could pay and still hit your return targets.

Results are software estimates, not financial advice.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7736cf2a908191b4878640.longDescriptionZh:
REIzer 以投资者的方式承销房地产交易。给它一个价格和一些数字，它会返回 0-100 分、对该策略重要的指标、显示破坏交易的压力场景、它为您填写的每个假设以及可共享的报告链接。

它涵盖长期租赁、短期租赁、BRRRR、固定和翻转、多户住宅和新建建筑。它可以将所有六个房产与同一房产进行比较，以找到其最佳用途，并向后求解您可以支付的最高价格，同时仍然达到您的回报目标。

结果是软件估计，而不是财务建议。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7bac9063c081919f75e83d.longDescription:
This connector lets ChatGPT and Codex securely read from and write to Xero.

Some things you can do:
• Connect multiple Xero companies to the same agent (great for booking intercompany JEs)
• Choose read-only or read-write access separately for each company
• Inspect full native invoice and bill line items, contact details, and paginated Xero results
• Create accounts, arbitrary Xero transactions, and draft fixed assets
• Bulk-create invoices or import credit card transactions
• Upload, list, and download supporting attachments
• Automatically fill in your firm-specific reporting template

• 检查完整的本机发票和账单行项目、联系方式和分页 Xero 结果
• 创建账户、任意Xero交易以及起草固定资产
• 批量创建发票或导入信用卡交易
• 上传、列出和下载支持附件

plugin_asdk_app_6a838001a29c8191b020fa64.productIntro: 从报价发现到购买无缝衔接。回答一些有关您旅行的问题即可获得个性化的 CoverMe® 旅行保险报价，然后继续访问 CoverMe.com，您的信息将保留在其中，以帮助您快速轻松地购买保险。 在获得报价之前 为了生成您的旅行保险报价，我们会要求您提供出生日期、居住省份、旅行目的地、旅行日期和旅行费用等信息。宏利使用通过此插件收到的信息来生成您的报价、评估资格并支持旅行保险报价和购买流程。请仅提供所要求的信息，除非在报价过程中特别要求，否则请勿共享其他信息。
plugin_asdk_app_6a838001a29c8191b020fa64.productIntroEn: Seamlessly go from quote discovery to purchase. Answer a few questions about your trip to receive a personalized CoverMe® Travel Insurance quote, then continue to CoverMe.com, where your information carries over to help make purchasing coverage quick and easy.
plugin_asdk_app_6a838001a29c8191b020fa64.longDescription:
Seamlessly go from quote discovery to purchase. Answer a few questions about your trip to receive a personalized CoverMe® Travel Insurance quote, then continue to CoverMe.com, where your information carries over to help make purchasing coverage quick and easy.  
Before You Get Your Quote
To generate your travel insurance quote, we'll ask for information such as your date of birth, province of residence, travel destination, travel dates, and trip cost. Manulife uses the information received through this plugin to generate your quote, assess eligibility, and support the travel insurance quote and purchase process. Please provide only the information requested, and do not share additional information unless specifically requested as part of the quote process.
This plugin is available through ChatGPT, which is provided by OpenAI and is subject to OpenAI's terms, privacy practices, account settings, and data-handling practices.
This tool is intended only to help you request a travel insurance quote. It cannot be used to submit or manage a claim, request emergency or travel assistance, or send urgent or time-sensitive communications to Manulife. It supports single-trip coverage for one traveller. If you have pre-existing medical conditions, are looking for multi-trip or group coverage, or are not a Canadian citizen or resident, this tool may not be suitable for your needs. Do not use this tool to provide detailed medical information, health histories, treatment information, or other sensitive personal information. If you provide information about other individuals, please make sure you have their permission to do so.  
This experience helps you obtain a travel insurance quote and does not provide professional insurance advice. 
The quote provided is for informational purposes only and is not an insurance contract or guarantee of coverage.
For more information about how your information is collected, used, and protected, please review our Canadian Privacy Policy and Legal Information & Disclosures.
plugin_asdk_app_6a838001a29c8191b020fa64.longDescriptionZh:
从报价发现到购买无缝衔接。回答一些有关您旅行的问题即可获得个性化的 CoverMe® 旅行保险报价，然后继续访问 CoverMe.com，您的信息将保留在其中，以帮助您快速轻松地购买保险。  
在获得报价之前
为了生成您的旅行保险报价，我们会要求您提供出生日期、居住省份、旅行目的地、旅行日期和旅行费用等信息。宏利使用通过此插件收到的信息来生成您的报价、评估资格并支持旅行保险报价和购买流程。请仅提供所要求的信息，除非在报价过程中特别要求，否则请勿共享其他信息。
该插件可通过 ChatGPT 获得，ChatGPT 由 OpenAI 提供，并受 OpenAI 的条款、隐私惯例、帐户设置和数据处理惯例的约束。
此工具仅用于帮助您请求旅行保险报价。它不能用于提交或管理索赔、请求紧急或旅行援助，或向宏利发送紧急或时间敏感的通信。它支持一名旅行者的单次旅行承保。如果您已有健康状况、正在寻求多次旅行或团体保险，或者不是加拿大公民或居民，则此工具可能不适合您的需求。请勿使用此工具提供详细的医疗信息、健康史、治疗信息或其他敏感个人信息。如果您提供其他人的信息，请确保您已获得他们的许可。  
此经验可帮助您获得旅行保险报价，但不提供专业的保险建议。 
所提供的报价仅供参考，并非保险合同或承保范围保证。
有关如何收集、使用和保护您的信息的更多信息，请查看我们的加拿大隐私政策以及法律信息和披露。

plugin_asdk_app_699b954a193c81918eb4bfad.productIntroEn: Who it's for: U.S. rideshare and gig economy drivers — Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, and similar platforms. Whether you're a full-time driver or earning on the side, TaxMadeEazy helps you discover deductions you might be missing.
plugin_asdk_app_699b954a193c81918eb4bfad.longDescription:
Who it's for: U.S. rideshare and gig economy drivers — Uber, Lyft, DoorDash, Instacart, and similar platforms. Whether you're a full-time driver or earning on the side, TaxMadeEazy helps you discover deductions you might be missing.

What it does: Explore an interactive checklist of IRS-sourced tax deductions tailored to rideshare and gig drivers. Mark deductions as "already claimed" or "didn't know about" and watch your estimated savings grow in real time with our savings meter.

How it works:
- Browse deduction categories (mileage, vehicle expenses, phone & technology, health insurance, and more)
- Mark each deduction to build your personalized summary
- See estimated savings based on your selections
- Connect with a verified CPA who specializes in rideshare taxes for professional guidance

What it doesn't do: TaxMadeEazy is informational only. It does not file taxes, calculate refunds, or provide professional tax advice. All deduction information is sourced from IRS publications and is provided for educational purposes. Always consult a qualified tax professional before making tax decisions.

Free, no signup required. Start exploring your deductions immediately — no account creation, no payment, no strings attached.
plugin_asdk_app_699b954a193c81918eb4bfad.longDescriptionZh:
适用人群：美国拼车和零工经济司机——Uber、Lyft、DoorDash、Instacart 和类似平台。无论您是全职司机还是兼职司机，TaxMadeEazy 都可以帮助您发现可能缺少的扣除额。

用途：探索针对共享出行和零工司机量身定制的由国税局提供的税收减免互动清单。将扣除额标记为“已申报”或“不知道”，并通过我们的储蓄表实时观察您的预计储蓄增长情况。

工作原理：
- 浏览扣除类别（里程、车辆费用、电话和技术、健康保险等）
- 标记每项扣除以构建您的个性化摘要
- 根据您的选择查看预计节省的费用
- 与专门从事拼车税的经过验证的注册会计师联系以获得专业指导

它不做什么：TaxMadeEazy 仅供参考。它不报税、计算退款或提供专业的税务建议。所有扣除信息均来自国税局出版物，并用于教育目的。在做出税务决定之前，请务必咨询合格的税务专业人士。

免费，无需注册。立即开始探索您的扣除额 - 无需创建帐户，无需付款，无任何附加条件。
defaultPrompts: What rideshare tax deductions am I missing?

plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8e021b148191aa85f697.productIntro: 每个交易连接器都会让您的人工智能变得更加强大。 Tally 让它负责。你的人工智能是分析师；塔利是风险官。 Tally 为 ChatGPT 提供了一份可以操作但永远不会重写的交易日志：每笔交易都以预先注册的论文开始，并在进入之前编写退出规则，24 小时的冷静期将信念与资本分开，违反规则的退出需要永久保留在记录中的书面理由。要求进行检查，ChatGPT 会向您介绍每一篇活跃的论文，根据您的退出标准记录新的证据，并标记任何客观触发的内容。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8e021b148191aa85f697.productIntroEn: Every trading connector makes your AI more capable. Tally makes it accountable. Your AI is the analyst; Tally is the risk officer. Tally gives ChatGPT a trading journal it can operate but never rewrite: every trade starts as a pre-registered thesis with exit rules written before entry, a 24-hour cooling-off separates conviction from capital, and rule-breaking exits require a written just…
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8e021b148191aa85f697.longDescription: Every trading connector makes your AI more capable. Tally makes it accountable. Your AI is the analyst; Tally is the risk officer. Tally gives ChatGPT a trading journal it can operate but never rewrite: every trade starts as a pre-registered thesis with exit rules written before entry, a 24-hour cooling-off separates conviction from capital, and rule-breaking exits require a written justification that stays on the record forever. Ask for a checkup and ChatGPT briefs you on every active thesis, logs fresh evidence against your exit criteria, and flags anything that has objectively triggered. Every closed trade mints a public receipt — entry, exit, result, and your reasoning, word for word. Tally never executes trades.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7b8e021b148191aa85f697.longDescriptionZh: 每个交易连接器都会让您的人工智能变得更加强大。 Tally 让它负责。你的人工智能是分析师；塔利是风险官。 Tally 为 ChatGPT 提供了一份可以操作但永远不会重写的交易日志：每笔交易都以预先注册的论文开始，并在进入之前编写退出规则，24 小时的冷静期将信念与资本分开，违反规则的退出需要永久保留在记录中的书面理由。要求进行检查，ChatGPT 会向您介绍每一篇活跃的论文，根据您的退出标准记录新的证据，并标记任何客观触发的内容。每一笔成交的交易都会留下一份公开收据——逐字逐句地记录进场、出场、结果和你的推理。 Tally 从不执行交易。

plugin_asdk_app_6a79013a1fb4819182b4358e.name: RateZip Deposit/Mortgage Rates
plugin_asdk_app_6a79013a1fb4819182b4358e.description: 当前美国年利率和贷款利率
plugin_asdk_app_6a79013a1fb4819182b4358e.productIntro: RateZip 存款和抵押贷款利率为您的助手提供来自 RateZip 涵盖的来源的当前、带时间戳、来源归因的美国消费者利率信息：高收益储蓄和货币市场年利率、按期限的 CD 年利率、固定抵押贷款利率和年利率以及房屋净值/HELOC 年利率。每个数字都包括观察时间、来源和新鲜度状态；其服务窗口之外的数据将被保留，而不是显示为当前数据。对于存款比较，输入余额，RateZip 将应用每个帐户已发布的余额等级。
plugin_asdk_app_6a79013a1fb4819182b4358e.productIntroEn: RateZip Deposit and Mortgage Rates gives your assistant current, timestamped, source-attributed US consumer rate information from sources covered by RateZip: high-yield savings and money-market APYs, CD APYs by term, fixed-mortgage rates and APRs, and home-equity/HELOC APRs.
plugin_asdk_app_6a79013a1fb4819182b4358e.longDescription: RateZip Deposit and Mortgage Rates gives your assistant current, timestamped, source-attributed US consumer rate information from sources covered by RateZip: high-yield savings and money-market APYs, CD APYs by term, fixed-mortgage rates and APRs, and home-equity/HELOC APRs. Each figure includes when it was observed, its source, and a freshness status; data outside its serving window is withheld rather than presented as current. For deposit comparisons, enter a balance and RateZip will apply each account’s published balance tier. For mortgage context, enter a loan amount to compare it with applicable conforming and jumbo limits. Rates and APYs can change, and published information is not an offer, rate lock, approval, earnings guarantee, personalized lender quote, or financial advice. RateZip does not open accounts, submit applications, underwrite credit, or conduct transactions. Operated by Peklava LLC d/b/a RateZip, NMLS ID 1592292. Equal Housing Opportunity.
plugin_asdk_app_6a79013a1fb4819182b4358e.longDescriptionZh: RateZip 存款和抵押贷款利率为您的助手提供来自 RateZip 涵盖的来源的当前、带时间戳、来源归因的美国消费者利率信息：高收益储蓄和货币市场年利率、按期限的 CD 年利率、固定抵押贷款利率和年利率以及房屋净值/HELOC 年利率。每个数字都包括观察时间、来源和新鲜度状态；其服务窗口之外的数据将被保留，而不是显示为当前数据。对于存款比较，输入余额，RateZip 将应用每个帐户已发布的余额等级。对于抵押贷款情况，输入贷款金额，将其与适用的合规限额和巨额限额进行比较。利率和年利率可能会发生变化，发布的信息不是要约、利率锁定、批准、收益保证、个性化贷方报价或财务建议。 RateZip 不开设账户、提交申请、承保信贷或进行交易。由 Peklava LLC d/b/a RateZip 运营，NMLS ID 1592292。平等住房机会。

plugin_asdk_app_695bd9bdd1208191a778cfd5.productIntro: 往国外汇款？ Monito 可帮助您在几秒钟内比较国际汇款服务，以便您始终获得最佳的汇率、最低的费用和最快的交付。
plugin_asdk_app_695bd9bdd1208191a778cfd5.productIntroEn: Sending money abroad? Monito helps you compare international money transfer services in seconds so you always get the best exchange rate, lowest fees, and fastest delivery.
plugin_asdk_app_695bd9bdd1208191a778cfd5.longDescription:
Sending money abroad? Monito helps you compare international money transfer services in seconds so you always get the best exchange rate, lowest fees, and fastest delivery.

Instead of checking dozens of apps and bank websites, Monito compares trusted providers like Wise, Revolut, Western Union, Remitly, Skrill, OFX, and more — all in one place. 

Monito's comparison engine is already trusted by millions of users to find the cheapest provider for their transfer and avoid hidden fees and bad exchange rates. 

Whether you’re sending money to family, paying overseas bills, or making international payments, Monito shows you the smartest option every time.
plugin_asdk_app_695bd9bdd1208191a778cfd5.longDescriptionZh:
往国外汇款？ Monito 可帮助您在几秒钟内比较国际汇款服务，以便您始终获得最佳的汇率、最低的费用和最快的交付。

Monito 无需检查数十个应用程序和银行网站，而是在一个地方比较 Wise、Revolut、Western Union、Remitly、Skrill、OFX 等值得信赖的提供商。 

Monito 的比较引擎已经受到数百万用户的信赖，可以找到最便宜的转账提供商，并避免隐藏费用和不良汇率。 

无论您是向家人汇款、支付海外账单还是进行国际支付，Monito 每次都会向您展示最明智的选择。

plugin_asdk_app_698ce69e6d6c8191bcfac9ad.name: Meshed Cover
plugin_asdk_app_698ce69e6d6c8191bcfac9ad.productIntro: 直接在 ChatGPT 中获取针对英国的定制商业保险报价。回答一些有关您业务的重点问题，此应用程序将： • 评估您的网络风险状况 • 确定相关掩护（包括数据泄露响应、勒索软件、业务中断、网络勒索和监管防御） • 生成量身定制的英国网络保险报价 • 概述关键限制、超出范围和可选扩展 • 强调可能影响定价的风险管理考虑因素
plugin_asdk_app_698ce69e6d6c8191bcfac9ad.productIntroEn: Get tailored business insurance quotes for the UK directly in ChatGPT. Answer a few focused questions about your business, and this app will: • Assess your cyber risk profile • Identify relevant cover (including data breach response, ransomware, business interruption, cyber extortion, and regulatory defence) • Generate tailored UK cyber insurance quotes • Outline key limits, excesses, an…
plugin_asdk_app_698ce69e6d6c8191bcfac9ad.longDescription:
Get tailored business insurance quotes for the UK directly in ChatGPT. Answer a few focused questions about your business, and this app will:
	•	Assess your cyber risk profile
	•	Identify relevant cover (including data breach response, ransomware, business interruption, cyber extortion, and regulatory defence)
	•	Generate tailored UK cyber insurance quotes
	•	Outline key limits, excesses, and optional extensions
	•	Highlight risk management considerations that may impact pricing

Once you’re ready, you can seamlessly move from quote to active broking support with Meshed. A specialist cyber insurance team will review your requirements, refine coverage, negotiate with insurers, and guide you through to policy placement.
plugin_asdk_app_698ce69e6d6c8191bcfac9ad.longDescriptionZh:
直接在 ChatGPT 中获取针对英国的定制商业保险报价。回答一些有关您业务的重点问题，此应用程序将：
	• 评估您的网络风险状况
	• 确定相关掩护（包括数据泄露响应、勒索软件、业务中断、网络勒索和监管防御）
	• 生成量身定制的英国网络保险报价
	• 概述关键限制、超出范围和可选扩展
	• 强调可能影响定价的风险管理考虑因素

准备好后，您可以使用 Meshed 从报价无缝过渡到主动经纪支持。专业的网络保险团队将审查您的要求、完善承保范围、与保险公司协商并指导您完成保单投保。
defaultPrompts: Can I get a Cyber Insurance quote?
defaultPromptsZh: 我可以获得网络保险报价吗？

plugin_asdk_app_6a75b3c25e848191a9b44c89.productIntro: TickerLayer 将实时和历史的全球市场数据直接引入 ChatGPT。获取全球市场的股票、外汇、加密货币、指数、ETF、大宗商品和政府债券收益率。
plugin_asdk_app_6a75b3c25e848191a9b44c89.productIntroEn: TickerLayer brings real-time and historical global market data directly into ChatGPT. Access stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, commodities and government bond yields across markets worldwide.
plugin_asdk_app_6a75b3c25e848191a9b44c89.longDescription:
TickerLayer brings real-time and historical global market data directly into ChatGPT. Access stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, indices, ETFs, commodities and government bond yields across markets worldwide.

Stocks & ETFs: Get live market snapshots, bid/ask quotes, latest trades, previous closes and historical OHLCV data for US and international equities and ETFs.

Forex & crypto: Check real-time currency pairs and cryptocurrency prices, compare markets and retrieve historical price data across custom date ranges.

Indices & commodities: Follow major global stock indices, gold, oil and other supported commodities with current market data and historical aggregates.

Government bonds: Check the latest US and major European government bond yields across supported maturities, including US Treasury yields.

Market hours: See whether markets are open, closed, in pre-market or post-market, and check trading sessions, holidays and early closures across supported regions.

Ask natural-language questions such as “How is Nvidia trading today?”, “Compare Bitcoin and gold over the last year”, “What is USD/TRY now?” or “What is the latest US 10-year Treasury yield?” and get answers backed by TickerLayer market data.

Built for investors, analysts, traders, developers and anyone who needs real-time or historical multi-asset financial market data inside ChatGPT.

plugin_asdk_app_6a5fe4f8dc9881919a2a3083.productIntro: In Practice 为基本面投资者进行初步研究。我们采访了您正在分析的公司的前经营者和高管，然后将这些对话转化为结构化的、引用的研究。
plugin_asdk_app_6a5fe4f8dc9881919a2a3083.productIntroEn: In Practise runs primary research for fundamental investors. We interview the former operators and executives who ran the companies you're analysing, then turn those conversations into structured, cited research.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5fe4f8dc9881919a2a3083.longDescription:
In Practise runs primary research for fundamental investors. We interview the former operators and executives who ran the companies you're analysing, then turn those conversations into structured, cited research.

This connector brings that library into ChatGPT. You can:

- Search thousands of expert interviews across public and private companies, sectors and business models
- Read full interviews and analysis, with verbatim quotes you can attribute to each source
- Look up companies and the moats behind them, assessed with the 7 Powers framework: scale economies, network effects, counter-positioning, switching costs, branding, cornered resource and process power
- Track the companies you care about with a personal watchlist

Ask ChatGPT about a company, a competitor or an end market, and it pulls the relevant primary-source view from people who were actually in the room, rather than a summary scraped from the web.

Access requires an In Practise library subscription. Learn more at inpractise.com.
plugin_asdk_app_6a5fe4f8dc9881919a2a3083.longDescriptionZh:
In Practice 为基本面投资者进行初步研究。我们采访了您正在分析的公司的前经营者和高管，然后将这些对话转化为结构化的、引用的研究。

该连接器将该库引入 ChatGPT。您可以：

- 搜索数千名涉及上市公司和私营公司、行业和商业模式的专家访谈
- 阅读完整的采访和分析，并逐字引用，您可以将其归因于每个来源
- 查找公司及其背后的护城河，并使用七大权力框架进行评估：规模经济、网络效应、反向定位、转换成本、品牌、垄断资源和流程能力
- 通过个人观察列表跟踪您关心的公司

向 ChatGPT 询问有关公司、竞争对手或终端市场的信息，它会从实际在场的人那里获取相关的主要来源观点，而不是从网络上抓取的摘要。

访问需要订阅 In Practice 库。请访问 inpractise.com 了解更多信息。

plugin_asdk_app_6a2a589865a88191933e9bad.name: OptionsAhoy
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a589865a88191933e9bad.productIntro: 现在就锻炼或者等待。卖出或持有。首先出售哪些拍品。每个问题都有适合您具体情况的正确答案，并且取决于替代最低税 (AMT)、持有期、州税和提前缴纳税款的时间价值在几年内如何相互作用。这就是经验法则失效的地方。用简单的语言询问，OptionsAhoy 会返回答案，并附上每年的时间表。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a589865a88191933e9bad.productIntroEn: Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a589865a88191933e9bad.longDescription:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed against the federal tax code plus all fifty states and the District of Columbia. The 2026 federal constants match IRS Revenue Procedure 2025-32. Federal cases reproduce to the cent against the independently maintained PSL Tax-Calculator, and state results reproduce to the cent against OpenTaxSolver across California, New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Massachusetts. That proof recomputes live in your browser at optionsahoy.com/verification.

This matters because language models are confident and wrong at exactly this task. In a published benchmark, five frontier models were given the same multi-year ISO problem, three runs each. All five overstated the after-tax value of their own proposed schedules, by 1.6x to 17.6x against the provable optimum. One model claimed $3.9M, $5.2M, and $13.0M on three runs of identical input. The prompt and full transcripts are public at optionsahoy.com/benchmark. The arithmetic here is deterministic instead: the same inputs on the same date give the same answer every time, with no model inference anywhere in the number.

Free, no account, no API key, and your figures are not retained. United States tax logic only. This is a planning calculator, not tax advice.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2a589865a88191933e9bad.longDescriptionZh:
现在就锻炼或者等待。卖出或持有。首先出售哪些拍品。每个问题都有适合您具体情况的正确答案，并且取决于替代最低税 (AMT)、持有期、州税和提前缴纳税款的时间价值在几年内如何相互作用。这就是经验法则失效的地方。用简单的语言询问，OptionsAhoy 会返回答案，并附上每年的时间表。

1. 在哪一年行使哪种激励股票期权（ISO），以压低 AMT 并在以后收回信用。我们会根据您的税务状况进行多年优化。

2. 是出售归属限制性股票单位（RSU）还是持有以获得长期资本收益，以及十二个月悬崖的实际价值是多少。我们向您展示最佳解决方案。

3. 哪些既得 RSU 手数要出售，按什么顺序出售，以及相对于出售最旧的优先（您的经纪商 UI 将提供的默认顺序）可以节省什么。这听起来像是一个微小的优化。如果集中头寸的销售额为 725,000 美元，最佳订单与经纪商违约订单之间的差距可能会超过 100,000 美元的税金。

4. 非合格股票期权（NSO）是更好地行使和出售，还是行使和持有。

5. 您的股票是否通过了合格小型企业股票（QSBS）的六项法定测试。最好尽早检查是否有可能节省税收，因为规则刚刚发生了变化。

6. 单个头寸给您带来的风险有多大，以及抛售、持有或对冲各自的成本是多少。我们会计算并比较三年内的不同策略，并考虑到您的税收。

7. 保护性看跌期权或零成本项圈的价格是多少。如果您需要保护您的资产，您可能会考虑进行对冲。但哪一个呢？我们让您轻松做出决定。

8. 如何在截止日期前以最少的税款将您的部分资产转换为目标金额的税后现金。我们根据您的投入和风险承受能力进行优化，然后您选择，就像投资公司那样。
每个结果都是根据联邦税法以及所有五十个州和哥伦比亚特区计算的。 2026 年联邦常量与 IRS 收入程序 2025-32 相符。针对独立维护的 PSL 税务计算器的联邦案件可精确到分，加利福尼亚州、纽约州、新泽西州、宾夕法尼亚州和马萨诸塞州针对 OpenTaxSolver 的州结果可精确到分。该证明会在您的浏览器中重新计算，网址为 optionsahoy.com/verification。

这很重要，因为语言模型在这项任务上是自信的，但却是错误的。在发布的基准测试中，五个前沿模型面临相同的多年 ISO 问题，每个模型运行三次。所有五个人都高估了自己提议的时间表的税后价值，比可证明的最佳值高出 1.6 倍到 17.6 倍。一个模型在三轮相同的输入中分别获得了 390 万美元、520 万美元和 1300 万美元的收入。提示和完整记录在 optionsahoy.com/benchmark 上公开。这里的算术是确定性的：同一日期的相同输入每次都会给出相同的答案，数字中的任何地方都没有模型推断。

免费，无需帐户，无需API密钥，并且您的数据不会被保留。仅限美国税收逻辑。这是一个规划计算器，而不是税务建议。

plugin_asdk_app_6a7f681718308191a94b5841.name: PointBagel
plugin_asdk_app_6a7f681718308191a94b5841.productIntro: PointBagel 会跟踪您的美国信用卡和积分，并对其进行数学计算。连接它，ChatGPT 可以回答有关您自己钱包的问题：哪张卡在购买时赚得最多，您的积分值多少钱，年费是否仍在赚取，以及哪些转账奖金现在有效。答案来自您的实际卡和支出，并根据 PointBagel 的计划、转让合作伙伴和积分值的验证数据进行定价，而不是来自模型的内存。
plugin_asdk_app_6a7f681718308191a94b5841.productIntroEn: PointBagel keeps track of your U.S. credit cards and points, and does the math on them. Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own wallet: which card earns the most on a purchase, what your points are worth, whether an annual fee is still earning its keep, and which transfer bonuses are live right now.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7f681718308191a94b5841.longDescription:
PointBagel keeps track of your U.S. credit cards and points, and does the math on them. Connect it and ChatGPT can answer questions about your own wallet: which card earns the most on a purchase, what your points are worth, whether an annual fee is still earning its keep, and which transfer bonuses are live right now. The answers come from your actual cards and spending, priced with PointBagel's verified data on programs, transfer partners, and point values, not from a model's memory.

The connection is read-only. ChatGPT can see your cards, balances, and spending, but nothing can move points or money. Point values are estimates, and the answers say so.

You'll need a PointBagel account with your cards added. Setup takes a few minutes at pointbagel.com.
plugin_asdk_app_6a7f681718308191a94b5841.longDescriptionZh:
PointBagel 会跟踪您的美国信用卡和积分，并对其进行数学计算。连接它，ChatGPT 可以回答有关您自己钱包的问题：哪张卡在购买时赚得最多，您的积分值多少钱，年费是否仍在赚取，以及哪些转账奖金现在有效。答案来自您的实际卡和支出，并根据 PointBagel 的计划、转让合作伙伴和积分值的验证数据进行定价，而不是来自模型的内存。

该连接是只读的。 ChatGPT 可以查看您的卡、余额和支出，但无法转移积分或金钱。点值是估计值，答案也是如此。

您需要一个已添加卡的 PointBagel 帐户。在 pointbagel.com 上安装需要几分钟。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8b8b0fdcd481919f5a5ccb.productIntro: PocketSmith 是一款领先的个人理财软件，受到 190 个国家/地区超过 380,000 名用户的信赖。我们帮助世界各地的家庭首席财务官掌控他们的资金并实现他们的财务目标。凭借强大的预测、多货币支持和灵活的预算工具，PocketSmith 提供了高度可定制的资金管理方法。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b8b0fdcd481919f5a5ccb.productIntroEn: PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b8b0fdcd481919f5a5ccb.longDescription:
PocketSmith is a leading personal finance software, trusted by over 380,000 users in 190 countries. We help Household CFOs around the world take control of their money and achieve their financial goals. With powerful forecasting, multi-currency support, and flexible budgeting tools, PocketSmith offers a highly customizable approach to money management.

This connector lets ChatGPT have full secure access to your PocketSmith data, so that you can work with your finances in plain language.

Understand your money: search, filter and categorize your transactions in plain language. Investigate patterns across all your accounts, check balances, and review your categories, labels and saved searches.

Go beyond "what did I spend?": uncover unusual merchant and timing patterns, see what your spending reveals about your priorities and turn years of financial data into answers, stories and decisions that feel relevant to your life.

Get answers to questions like: "why does my cash flow dip next month?", "what changed our net worth most this year?" and "what does our spending suggest we valued, and which choices bought us the most joy, ease or security?"

Keep your budget in check: review budget performance, analyze spending trends across periods, find recurring expenses, plus access monthly reviews and financial health snapshots.

Plan ahead: use PocketSmith's forecasting engine to predict future cashflow and net worth, and manage the budget events that map out your future.

Keep things tidy: categorize your transactions, create new category rules, manage files and sync bank feeds.

Seamlessly jump to PocketSmith: describe the report you need to see in PocketSmith, and you'll get a deep link to that exact report in PocketSmith.

ChatGPT connects to PocketSmith via OAuth - when you connect, you sign in with PocketSmith and can revoke access any time. A read-only version of this connector is also available, if you don't want Claude to ever modify your data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8b8b0fdcd481919f5a5ccb.longDescriptionZh:
PocketSmith 是一款领先的个人理财软件，受到 190 个国家/地区超过 380,000 名用户的信赖。我们帮助世界各地的家庭首席财务官掌控他们的资金并实现他们的财务目标。凭借强大的预测、多货币支持和灵活的预算工具，PocketSmith 提供了高度可定制的资金管理方法。

此连接器使 ChatGPT 能够完全安全地访问您的 PocketSmith 数据，以便您可以用简单的语言处理您的财务状况。

了解您的资金：用简单的语言搜索、过滤和分类您的交易。调查所有帐户的模式、检查余额并查看您的类别、标签和保存的搜索。

超越“我花了什么？”：发现不寻常的商家和时间模式，了解您的支出揭示了您的优先事项，并将多年的财务数据转化为与您的生活相关的答案、故事和决策。

获得以下问题的答案：“为什么我的现金流下个月会下降？”、“今年我们的净资产变化最大的是什么？” “我们的支出表明我们看重什么？哪些选择给我们带来了最大的快乐、轻松或安全感？”

控制预算：审查预算绩效、分析各个时期的支出趋势、查找经常性支出，以及访问每月审查和财务健康状况快照。

提前计划：使用 PocketSmith 的预测引擎来预测未来的现金流和净资产，并管理规划您未来的预算事件。

保持整洁：对交易进行分类、创建新的类别规则、管理文件并同步银行信息流。

无缝跳转到 PocketSmith：描述您需要在 PocketSmith 中查看的报告，您将在 PocketSmith 中获得指向该确切报告的深层链接。

ChatGPT 通过 OAuth 连接到 PocketSmith - 连接后，您可以使用 PocketSmith 登录，并且可以随时撤销访问权限。如果您不希望 Claude 修改您的数据，还可以使用此连接器的只读版本。

plugin_asdk_app_6a84227d2edc8191826953ec.name: Dr. Klein
plugin_asdk_app_6a84227d2edc8191826953ec.productIntro: Dr. Klein 抵押贷款计算器可计算抵押贷款利率、每月抵押付款、剩余贷款余额以及抵押贷款的总利息成本。购房价格、首付、还款率等融资细节均可单独调整。根据输入的数据，计算器提供各种融资报价，可以一目了然地进行比较。 Dr. Klein 抵押贷款计算器适用于规划购买房产、新建项目或再融资的抵押贷款。 该计算基于 600 多家贷款合作伙伴的最新条款和条件。由于最终融资条款取决于个人情况，计算结果仅供参考。完成计算后，可以直接向克莱因博士请求个性化融资报价。
plugin_asdk_app_6a84227d2edc8191826953ec.productIntroEn: The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator calculates mortgage interest rates, monthly mortgage payments, the remaining loan balance, and the total interest costs of a mortgage. The property purchase price, down payment, repayment rate, and other financing details can be adjusted individually.
plugin_asdk_app_6a84227d2edc8191826953ec.longDescription:
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator calculates mortgage interest rates, monthly mortgage payments, the remaining loan balance, and the total interest costs of a mortgage. The property purchase price, down payment, repayment rate, and other financing details can be adjusted individually. Based on the entered data, the calculator provides various financing offers that can be compared side by side at a glance.
The Dr. Klein Mortgage Calculator is suitable for planning a mortgage for the purchase of a property, a new-build project, or a refinancing.
The calculations are based on the latest terms and conditions of more than 600 lending partners. As the final financing terms depend on individual circumstances, the calculated results are provided for guidance only. After completing the calculation, a personalized financing offer can be requested directly from Dr. Klein.

plugin_asdk_app_6a60b3a5a5888191b3d51cb6.name: Moody's Growth and Strategy
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b3a5a5888191b3d51cb6.description: 推动 GTM 增长的见解
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b3a5a5888191b3d51cb6.productIntro: 穆迪增长与战略 MCP 通过提供 GenAI 就绪的数据、分析和见解来为上市执行提供信息，从而支持人工智能驱动的销售、营销和收入运营。它将企业结构、所有权、关系和市场数据集整合到一个统一的情报层中，以帮助团队识别机会、确定客户优先级并支持更有效的客户参与。
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b3a5a5888191b3d51cb6.productIntroEn: Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer enga…
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b3a5a5888191b3d51cb6.longDescription:
Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP supports AI-driven sales, marketing, and revenue operations by providing GenAI-ready data, analytics, and insights to inform go-to-market execution. It brings together firmographic, ownership, relationship, and market datasets into a unified intelligence layer to help teams identify opportunities, prioritize accounts, and support more effective customer engagement. 
 
The solution combines comprehensive Moody’s entity intelligence, including global company profiles, hierarchies, and ownership linkages, with augmented signals such as news, market activity, and risk indicators. This integrated view helps organizations gain additional visibility into total addressable markets, identify whitespace opportunities, and align sales and marketing strategies around high-value prospects. 
 
By bringing together structured company data and contextual insights into a single interface, Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP helps streamline data-to-insight workflows and supports improvements in targeting precision, pipeline quality, and revenue outcomes. 
 
Data includes: 
- Global company firmographics and identifiers 
- Corporate hierarchies and ownership structures 
- Industry classifications and segmentation 
- Financial indicators and company scale metrics 
- News, market signals, and company events 
- Risk indicators and early warning signals 
- Economic data and research 

 Use Moody’s Growth & Strategy MCP for: 
- GTM Planning – define and size target markets with comprehensive company coverage  
- Account Prioritization – identify and prioritize high-value prospects and customers and support more sophisticated opportunity scoring by combining company-level data with market-level indicators. 
- Territory Design – support geographic and account planning by highlighting industries, regions or countries with stronger growth prospects 
- Pipeline Acceleration – surface in-market signals and help support timely engagement based on macroeconomic trends, investment activity, hiring trends or sector-level forecasts 
- Cross-Sell & Upsell – help identify whitespace within existing customer portfolios and support AI-generated account briefs that incorporate industry outlooks, economic scenarios, and strategic talking points 
- CRM Enrichment – enrich account and lead records with company data and insights 
- Marketing Segmentation – develop data-driven audience segments using company, market, and relationship insights
plugin_asdk_app_6a60b3a5a5888191b3d51cb6.longDescriptionZh:
穆迪增长与战略 MCP 通过提供 GenAI 就绪的数据、分析和见解来为上市执行提供信息，从而支持人工智能驱动的销售、营销和收入运营。它将企业结构、所有权、关系和市场数据集整合到一个统一的情报层中，以帮助团队识别机会、确定客户优先级并支持更有效的客户参与。 
 
该解决方案将全面的穆迪实体情报（包括全球公司概况、层次结构和所有权联系）与新闻、市场活动和风险指标等增强信号相结合。这种集成视图可帮助组织获得对整个潜在市场的更多可见性，识别空白机会，并围绕高价值前景调整销售和营销策略。 
 
通过将结构化的公司数据和背景洞察整合到一个界面中，穆迪增长与战略 MCP 有助于简化数据到洞察的工作流程，并支持提高定位精度、渠道质量和收入成果。 
 
数据包括： 
- 全球公司的公司结构和标识符 
- 公司层级和所有权结构 
- 行业分类和细分 
- 财务指标和公司规模指标 
- 新闻、市场信号和公司活动 
- 风险指标和预警信号 
- 经济数据和研究 

 使用穆迪增长与战略 MCP 来： 
- GTM 规划 – 通过全面的公司覆盖范围来定义目标市场并确定其规模  
- 客户优先级——识别并优先考虑高价值的潜在客户和客户，并通过将公司级数据与市场级指标相结合来支持更复杂的机会评分。 
- 区域设计——通过突出具有更强增长前景的行业、地区或国家来支持地理和客户规划 
- 渠道加速 – 揭示市场信号并帮助支持基于宏观经济趋势、投资活动、招聘趋势或行业级预测的及时参与 
- 交叉销售和追加销售 – 帮助识别现有客户组合中的空白，并支持人工智能生成的客户简介，其中包含行业前景、经济情景和战略谈话要点 
- CRM 丰富 – 利用公司数据和见解丰富客户和潜在客户记录
- 营销细分——利用公司、市场和关系洞察开发数据驱动的受众群体

plugin_asdk_app_6a797ad042008191aacd2960.name: Whisper Money
plugin_asdk_app_6a797ad042008191aacd2960.productIntro: Whisper Money 是一款隐私至上的个人理财应用程序：您的财务数据是您自己的，并且永远不会与第三方共享。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您自己的 Whisper Money 帐户，这样您就可以用简单的语言分析您的资金，而无需点击仪表板。
plugin_asdk_app_6a797ad042008191aacd2960.productIntroEn: Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.
plugin_asdk_app_6a797ad042008191aacd2960.longDescription:
Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.
plugin_asdk_app_6a797ad042008191aacd2960.longDescriptionZh:
Whisper Money 是一款隐私至上的个人理财应用程序：您的财务数据是您自己的，并且永远不会与第三方共享。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到您自己的 Whisper Money 帐户，这样您就可以用简单的语言分析您的资金，而无需点击仪表板。

提出诸如“上个月我在杂货上花了多少钱”、“今年我的净资产趋势是什么”、“哪些订阅让我精疲力尽”或“按类别细分第二季度”等问题 - 该应用程序会读取您的交易、账户、类别、标签、现金流和净资产，并用您的真实数字进行回答。您还可以通过对话保持账簿整洁：记录手动交易、重新分类和标记现有交易、记录手动账户余额以及管理类别、标签和自动化规则。

您同步的银行数据受到保护：从银行连接导入的交易可以进行分类和标记，但永远不会编辑或删除，并且余额只能记录在手动帐户上。您仍然可以将自己的手动交易添加到与银行关联的帐户中 - 同步永远不会删除它们。数据的范围仅限于您登录所用的帐户，包括您所属的任何共享空间。该应用程序仅读取和写入记账记录，它永远无法转移资金、付款或访问 Whisper Money 之外的任何账户。

需要付费（专业）计划的 Whisper Money 帐户。登录通过 Whisper Money 自己的 OAuth 流程进行 - ChatGPT 永远不会看到您的密码，并且可以随时从您的帐户设置撤销访问权限。

plugin_asdk_app_6a58f43ae5f4819196825666.description: 人工智能就绪的交易日志
plugin_asdk_app_6a58f43ae5f4819196825666.productIntro: PFT EdgeBook 将您的人工智能助手连接到您自己的交易日志。连接后，您的助手可以读取您的真实交易数据。只需用通俗易懂的语言询问您的表现，而不是翻阅电子表格。
plugin_asdk_app_6a58f43ae5f4819196825666.productIntroEn: PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.
plugin_asdk_app_6a58f43ae5f4819196825666.longDescription:
PFT EdgeBook connects your AI assistant to your own trading journal. Once linked, your assistant can read your real trading data. Just ask about your performance in plain language instead of digging through spreadsheets.

Ask things like "How did my breakout setups perform this month?", "Where am I losing the most?" or "Am I sticking to my own rules?" — and get answers based on your actual trades.

Your assistant can read:
- Trades — entries, exits, size, P&L, R-multiple, tags
- Statistics — win rate, profit factor, average win/loss
- Journal & notes — your daily reflections and voice notes
- Playbook — your setups and rules, to check compliance
- Prop-firm & broker accounts — balances, drawdown, transactions

Private and read-only by design. The connector can only read your data — it can never change or delete anything. You sign in securely with your PFT account (OAuth), every request is limited to your own data, and account numbers are masked. Your data is stored in the EU.

Requires an EdgeBook account (part of the PFT Terminal) with the AI add-on enabled.
plugin_asdk_app_6a58f43ae5f4819196825666.longDescriptionZh:
PFT EdgeBook 将您的人工智能助手连接到您自己的交易日志。连接后，您的助手可以读取您的真实交易数据。只需用通俗易懂的语言询问您的表现，而不是翻阅电子表格。

问诸如“这个月我的突破设置表现如何？”、“我在哪里损失最多？”之类的问题。或者“我遵守自己的规则吗？” — 并根据您的实际交易获得答案。

您的助理可以阅读：
- 交易 — 入场、出场、规模、盈亏、R 倍数、标签
- 统计数据——赢率、盈利系数、平均赢/输
- 日记和笔记——你的日常反思和语音笔记
- Playbook — 您的设置和规则，用于检查合规性
- 自营公司和经纪商账户——余额、提款、交易

设计上是私有且只读的。连接器只能读取您的数据 - 它永远无法更改或删除任何内容。您使用 PFT 帐户 (OAuth) 安全登录，每个请求仅限于您自己的数据，并且帐号被屏蔽。您的数据存储在欧盟。

需要启用 AI 插件的 EdgeBook 帐户（PFT 终端的一部分）。

plugin_asdk_app_6a322bc8a6a48191a99da9a9.description: 您的多合一人工智能助手
plugin_asdk_app_6a322bc8a6a48191a99da9a9.originalDescription: Your All in One AI Assistant
plugin_asdk_app_6a322bc8a6a48191a99da9a9.productIntro: 将 ChatGPT 与 Cashfree Payments 连接起来，并通过自然对话管理您的整个支付生态系统。立即访问商家仪表板数据 - 包括付款、订单、退款、结算、付款、支付链接、对账报告、交易活动和工作流程 - 无需在工具或仪表板之间跳转。
plugin_asdk_app_6a322bc8a6a48191a99da9a9.productIntroEn: Connect ChatGPT with Cashfree Payments and manage your entire payments ecosystem through natural conversation. Access merchant dashboard data instantly — including payments, orders, refunds, settlements, payouts, payment links, reconciliation reports, transaction activity, and workflows — without jumping between tools or dashboards.
plugin_asdk_app_6a322bc8a6a48191a99da9a9.longDescription:
Connect ChatGPT with Cashfree Payments and manage your entire payments ecosystem through natural conversation. Access merchant dashboard data instantly — including payments, orders, refunds, settlements, payouts, payment links, reconciliation reports, transaction activity, and workflows — without jumping between tools or dashboards.

Built for both operational visibility and developer workflows, the platform is evolving beyond dashboard actions to support the full suite of Cashfree Payments, Payouts, SecureID, PPI, and Partners APIs used in real-world integrations. From tracking live payment flows and debugging transactions to managing settlements and analyzing business performance, ChatGPT becomes your unified AI-powered Cashfree assistant for every payments-related task.
plugin_asdk_app_6a322bc8a6a48191a99da9a9.longDescriptionZh:
将 ChatGPT 与 Cashfree Payments 连接起来，并通过自然对话管理您的整个支付生态系统。立即访问商家仪表板数据 - 包括付款、订单、退款、结算、付款、支付链接、对账报告、交易活动和工作流程 - 无需在工具或仪表板之间跳转。

该平台专为运营可见性和开发人员工作流程而构建，不断发展超越仪表板操作，以支持现实世界集成中使用的全套无现金支付、支付、SecureID、PPI 和合作伙伴 API。从跟踪实时支付流程和调试交易到管理结算和分析业务绩效，ChatGPT 成为您的统一 AI 支持的 Cashfree 助手，可完成每项与支付相关的任务。

plugin_asdk_app_6a54e5d1fbe881919eddaddb.productIntro: Tusk Liquid 将人工智能助手连接到 CredCore 精心策划的公共信用协议数据数据库——从公开提交的信用协议中提取的契约、债务结构、定价、修订和义务。连接后，您可以查询交易条款，根据市场比较对契约包进行基准测试，跟踪修正案的变化，并将借款人与同行进行比较；助手检索值并编写答案。覆盖范围涵盖跨部门、结构和贷方的数千份协议。专为杠杆融资、私人信贷、CLO、DCM 和法律团队而构建。只读且仅供参考——不提供法律、贷款、投资或承保建议。

plugin_asdk_app_6a54e5d1fbe881919eddaddb.longDescription: Tusk Liquid connects AI assistants to CredCore's curated database of public credit-agreement data — covenants, debt structure, pricing, amendments, and obligations — extracted from publicly filed credit agreements. Once connected, you can query a deal's terms, benchmark covenant packages against market comps, track changes across amendments, and compare a borrower with its peers; the assistant retrieves the values and composes the answer. Coverage spans thousands of agreements across sectors, structures, and lenders. Built for leveraged-finance, private-credit, CLO, DCM, and legal teams. Read-only and informational only — not legal, lending, investment, or underwriting advice.

plugin_asdk_app_6a75db4073348191b50fd065.name: OnePro AI
plugin_asdk_app_6a75db4073348191b50fd065.productIntro: OnePro 将您的 ETF1 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，并让您可以访问同一数据库并 到您在平台上使用的相同分析引擎。
plugin_asdk_app_6a75db4073348191b50fd065.productIntroEn: O OnePro conecta sua conta ETF1 ao ChatGPT e dá acesso à mesma base de dados e aos mesmos motores de análise que você usa na plataforma.
plugin_asdk_app_6a75db4073348191b50fd065.longDescription:
O OnePro conecta sua conta ETF1 ao ChatGPT e dá acesso à mesma base de dados e
aos mesmos motores de análise que você usa na plataforma.

Consulta de ativos: fichas completas de ETFs brasileiros e globais, ações, BDRs,
FIIs, fundos CVM, debêntures, renda fixa pública e privada e índices,  custos,
patrimônio líquido, retornos históricos, alocação e composição. Screener com
filtros por classe, look-through da carteira de ETFs (inclusive ETFs de ETFs) e
lookup reverso ("quais ETFs carregam NVDA?").

Análise de carteira: seus portfólios salvos no OnePro, ou uma carteira informada
na conversa, avaliados por retorno, volatilidade, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
máximo, tempo de recuperação e correlação, contra benchmarks como CDI, IBOV,
IFIX, IMA-B e S&P 500. Inclui ranking entre carteiras, consistência em janelas
móveis de 10 anos e heatmap de CAGR real por ano inicial.

Motores de simulação: fronteira eficiente e carteira de máximo Sharpe;
probabilidade de atingir uma meta de patrimônio (goal-based investing); projeção
prospectiva de patrimônio por Monte Carlo; e plano de retirada da aposentadoria
com taxa segura (SWR), taxa perpétua (PWR) e estratégias clássico,
rebalanceado, bucket e dynamic spending com guardrails.

Todos os resultados vêm de um snapshot diário de dados, com a versão do dado
declarada em cada resposta, e os motores raciocinam em termos reais (R$ de hoje e dólar).
O conector é somente leitura: nenhuma operação altera dados da sua conta, e
nenhuma ordem de compra ou venda é executada. As análises são informativas e não
constituem recomendação de investimento.

Requer assinatura ativa do OnePro em etf1.com.br.
plugin_asdk_app_6a75db4073348191b50fd065.longDescriptionZh:
OnePro 将您的 ETF1 帐户连接到 ChatGPT，并让您可以访问同一数据库并
到您在平台上使用的相同分析引擎。

资产咨询：巴西和全球 ETF、股票、BDR 的完整表格
FII、CVM 基金、债券、公共和私人固定收益和指数、成本、
权益、历史回报、分配和构成。筛选器与
按类别筛选、浏览 ETF 投资组合（包括 ETF 的 ETF）以及
反向查找（“哪些 ETF 带有 NVDA？”）。

投资组合分析：您保存在 OnePro 中的投资组合，或知情的投资组合
在对话中，通过回报、波动性、夏普、索蒂诺、回撤进行评估
最大值、恢复时间和相关性，对照 CDI、IBOV 等基准，
IFIX、IMA-B 和 S&P 500。包括投资组合之间的排名、跨窗口的一致性
第一年的 10 年移动和实际 CAGR 热图。

模拟引擎：高效前沿和最大夏普组合；
实现股权目标的概率（基于目标的投资）；投影
通过蒙特卡洛的遗产视角；和退休提款计划
具有安全利率（SWR）、永续利率（PWR）和经典策略，
通过护栏重新平衡、桶状和动态支出。

所有结果均来自每日数据快照，带有数据版本
在每个答案中声明，引擎以实际价格进行推理（今天的 R$ 和美元）。
连接器是只读的：没有任何操作会更改您的帐户数据，并且
不执行任何买入或卖出订单。分析是有信息性的，但不是
构成投资建议。

需要在 etf1.com.br 上进行有效的 OnePro 订阅。

plugin_asdk_app_69fbbad7130481918f59b8a3.name: Theia Insights
plugin_asdk_app_69fbbad7130481918f59b8a3.productIntro: Theia Insights 将专业的主题股权研究引入 ChatGPT。询问结构性趋势：人工智能、机器人、清洁能源、网络安全；并显示曝光度最高的上市公司，按照研究驱动的曝光度分数而不是关键词匹配或自我报告的标签进行排名。
plugin_asdk_app_69fbbad7130481918f59b8a3.productIntroEn: Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into ChatGPT. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores rather than keyword matching or self-reported tags.
plugin_asdk_app_69fbbad7130481918f59b8a3.longDescription:
Theia Insights brings professional thematic equity research into ChatGPT. Ask about a structural trend: artificial intelligence, robotics, clean energy, cybersecurity; and surface the public companies most exposed, ranked by research-driven exposure scores rather than keyword matching or self-reported tags.

The data is built on the Theia Insights Industry Classification (TIIC): a five-level, one-to-many taxonomy mapping companies to 3,000+ investable themes based on what they actually do. Performance is tracked through Theme Watch Indices (TWI), with 10+ years of daily history across global regions.

What you can do in ChatGPT:

* Profile any company by ticker, ISIN, FIGI, or ticker — see its full thematic exposure from sector down to micro-theme.
* Screen for thematic exposure across public markets — find the companies most exposed to a given theme, sub-industry, or industry.
* Benchmark theme performance over time and rank themes by recent returns to identify leaders, laggards, and rotation trends.

Built for portfolio managers, research analysts, index providers, and allocators who need defensible, data-driven answers to thematic questions.
plugin_asdk_app_69fbbad7130481918f59b8a3.longDescriptionZh:
Theia Insights 将专业的主题股权研究引入 ChatGPT。询问结构性趋势：人工智能、机器人、清洁能源、网络安全；并显示曝光度最高的上市公司，按照研究驱动的曝光度分数而不是关键词匹配或自我报告的标签进行排名。

该数据基于 Theia Insights 行业分类 (TIIC)：一个五级、一对多的分类法，根据公司的实际业务将其映射到 3,000 多个可投资主题。通过主题观察指数 (TWI) 跟踪表现，该指数具有全球各地区 10 多年的每日历史记录。

您可以在 ChatGPT 中执行以下操作：

* 通过股票代码、ISIN、FIGI 或股票代码来介绍任何公司 — 查看其从行业到微观主题的完整主题曝光。
* 筛选公开市场中的主题曝光度 - 查找最受特定主题、子行业或行业影响的公司。
* 对一段时间内的主题表现进行基准测试，并根据最近的回报对主题进行排名，以确定领先者、落后者和轮换趋势。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8dbe324a8c8191b4bf7cf1.name: StackerScan
plugin_asdk_app_6a8dbe324a8c8191b4bf7cf1.productIntro: StackerScan 通过五个只读工具为 ChatGPT 提供实时贵金属市场数据。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8dbe324a8c8191b4bf7cf1.productIntroEn: StackerScan gives ChatGPT live precious-metals market data through five read-only tools.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8dbe324a8c8191b4bf7cf1.longDescription:
StackerScan gives ChatGPT live precious-metals market data through five read-only tools.

Current and previous-session spot prices for gold, silver, platinum, palladium, copper and nickel, in any supported currency and per troy ounce or gram. Rolling fine-metal-weighted median asking premiums over spot, observed from real marketplace listings rather than quoted by a dealer. Daily historical series for charting — one metal, the Goldback, or one PCGS-numbered coin at one grade. The latest Goldback premium multiple over its gold content, and the exchange rate that follows from it. And the live list of currency codes every request accepts — ISO 4217 fiat plus BTC and the metal codes.

No API key, account, or registration is required. StackerScan is not a dealer and sells no bullion; do not use it to buy or sell metal. Numismatic valuation is only available for coins with a PCGS number. Results are structured JSON mirroring the open HTTP API documented at https://www.stackerscan.com/openapi.json.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8dbe324a8c8191b4bf7cf1.longDescriptionZh:
StackerScan 通过五个只读工具为 ChatGPT 提供实时贵金属市场数据。

当前和前一交易日的黄金、白银、铂金、钯金、铜和镍的现货价格，以任何受支持的货币和每金衡盎司或克计算。滚动精金属加权平均要价相对于现货的溢价，是从真实市场列表中观察到的，而不是由经销商报价。用于图表的每日历史系列 — 一种金属、金背币或一种具有 PCGS 编号的某一等级的硬币。最新的 Goldback 黄金含量溢价倍数，以及由此得出的汇率。每个请求接受的货币代码的实时列表 - ISO 4217 法定货币加上 BTC 和金属代码。

无需 API 密钥、帐户或注册。 StackerScan 不是经销商，也不销售金条；不要用它来购买或出售金属。钱币估价仅适用于具有 PCGS 编号的硬币。结果是结构化 JSON，镜像 https://www.stackerscan.com/openapi.json 中记录的开放 HTTP API。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8e4922a09081918d4d9252.description: 阅读发票、现金和损益表
plugin_asdk_app_6a8e4922a09081918d4d9252.productIntro: Laabam.One 是一款多公司 ERP。将其连接到 ChatGPT，并用简单的语言询问您的一家公司：未清偿金额以及谁欠款最多，本月哪些发票未支付，您在银行帐户中的现金状况，一段时间内的损益，以及实际销售的产品。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8e4922a09081918d4d9252.productIntroEn: Laabam.One is a multi-company ERP. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about one of your companies in plain language: what is outstanding and who owes the most, which invoices are unpaid this month, your cash position across bank accounts, profit and loss for a period, and which products actually sell.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8e4922a09081918d4d9252.developerName: Laabam One Business Solutions (OPC) Private Limited
plugin_asdk_app_6a8e4922a09081918d4d9252.longDescription:
Laabam.One is a multi-company ERP. Connect it to ChatGPT and ask about one of your companies in plain language: what is outstanding and who owes the most, which invoices are unpaid this month, your cash position across bank accounts, profit and loss for a period, and which products actually sell.

Answers come from your live ledger rather than an export or a summary, so the figures match what you would see in the app. Amounts are returned in your company's own currency.

Every operation is read-only. Nothing creates, edits, deletes, sends a message, or moves money.

You authorise each connection yourself and fix it to exactly one company. The tools take no company argument, so a connection cannot be pointed at a different company. Your access is re-checked on every request, and you can revoke any connection at any time from Settings → Security → AI Connections.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8e4922a09081918d4d9252.longDescriptionZh:
Laabam.One 是一款多公司 ERP。将其连接到 ChatGPT，并用简单的语言询问您的一家公司：未清偿金额以及谁欠款最多，本月哪些发票未支付，您在银行帐户中的现金状况，一段时间内的损益，以及实际销售的产品。

答案来自您的实时分类账，而不是导出或摘要，因此这些数字与您在应用程序中看到的内容相符。金额以您公司自己的货币返回。

每个操作都是只读的。没有任何东西可以创建、编辑、删除、发送消息或转移资金。

您自己授权每个连接并将其固定到一个公司。这些工具不接受公司参数，因此连接不能指向不同的公司。您的访问权限会根据每个请求重新检查，您可以随时从“设置”→“安全”→“AI 连接”撤销任何连接。
defaultPrompts: What's outstanding right now, and who owes me the most?
Show me the unpaid invoices for this month
What's my cash position across all bank accounts?
defaultPromptsZh: 现在最突出的是什么？谁欠我最多？
显示本月未付的发票
我所有银行账户的现金状况如何？

plugin_asdk_app_6a6aca6d7a308191997f80eb.productIntro: HourProof 帮助短期和长期租赁业主保留同期材料参与记录以用于税务目的。通过 ChatGPT，用户可以记录发生的物业管理活动（“记录昨天在 Beach House 进行的 90 分钟的周转清洁”），使用日期、物业和类别过滤器查看他们的活动日志，根据他们的材料参与目标（STR 100 小时，LTR 750 小时）检查年初至今的时间和进度状态，并在重建执行的工作时交叉引用同步的客人预订。

plugin_asdk_app_6a6aca6d7a308191997f80eb.longDescription: HourProof helps short-term and long-term rental owners keep contemporaneous material-participation records for tax purposes. Through ChatGPT, users log property-management activities as they happen ("log 90 minutes of turnover cleaning at Beach House yesterday"), review their activity log with date, property, and category filters, check year-to-date hours against their material-participation goals (100 hours for STR, 750 for LTR) with on-pace status, and cross-reference synced guest reservations when reconstructing work performed. Activities logged through ChatGPT are labeled as agent-logged in the user's audit trail and sync to the HourProof mobile app.

Plugin_ad36b6c1a3dc8191ad894c75788d0766.originalDescription: Manage tax transactions, exemptions, returns, and reports
Plugin_ad36b6c1a3dc8191ad894c75788d0766.productIntro: 通过浏览器中的 Avalara 产品门户查看交易、负债、豁免、退货和报告。需要通过本地浏览器访问 ChatGPT Desktop 或桌面 Codex；不适用于 Web、移动或云支持的任务。进行所请求的记录和配置更改、生成报告并完成归档和付款工作流程，并明确批准后续操作。可用的工作流程取决于您的 Avalara 产品、公司配置、角色和权限。该插件由 OpenAI 构建和维护。它由计算机使用提供支持，不是 Avalara 提供的 API 或 MCP 集成。

plugin_asdk_app_6a82749917308191990c61d2.productIntro: Lexfi 使 ChatGPT 能够访问结构化财务数据以进行研究和分析。它通过统一的 MCP 连接涵盖股票、宏观经济、固定收益、机构持股、市场情绪、另类数据和全球市场。用户可以直接在对话中检索市场数据、公司信息、经济指标、所有权活动和财务信号。 Lexfi 是一家金融数据提供商，不执行交易或提供投资建议。
plugin_asdk_app_6a82749917308191990c61d2.productIntroEn: Lexfi gives ChatGPT access to structured financial data for research and analysis. plugin_asdk_app_6a650ef7c4f481918e5f2524.productIntroEn: Parity helps self-directed investors model and compare illustrative defined-outcome options strategies using current market data.
plugin_asdk_app_6a650ef7c4f481918e5f2524.longDescription:
Parity helps self-directed investors model and compare illustrative defined-outcome options strategies using current market data.

Choose a security, time horizon, and desired outcome parameters. Parity identifies an available expiration and options structure, then explains the estimated cost, downside protection, upside tradeoff, dividends, and liquidity in plain language.

Parity provides educational analysis only. It does not provide personalized investment advice, choose investments for users, connect brokerage accounts, or execute transactions. Results are illustrative and depend on market prices available when generated.
plugin_asdk_app_6a650ef7c4f481918e5f2524.longDescriptionZh:

Parity 仅提供教育分析。它不提供个性化的投资建议、为用户选择投资、连接经纪账户或执行交易。结果是说明性的，并且取决于生成时可用的市场价格。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8f6d7d50d081918787990d.name: RoboSystems
plugin_asdk_app_6a8f6d7d50d081918787990d.productIntro: RoboSystems 将会计和财务数据转化为 ChatGPT 可以直接查询的知识图谱。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8f6d7d50d081918787990d.productIntroEn: RoboSystems turns accounting and financial data into knowledge graphs ChatGPT can query directly.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8f6d7d50d081918787990d.longDescription:
RoboSystems turns accounting and financial data into knowledge graphs ChatGPT can query directly.

SEC EDGAR: every public company's XBRL filings as one queryable graph. Pull a company's financial statements by ticker or CIK, pivot reported facts across companies, periods and dimensions, resolve a concept like "revenue" to its XBRL element, and run full-text search across filing narratives, then read the exact section.

Every graph also exposes read-only Cypher, so a conversation can move from a question ("show me NVIDIA's latest income statement") to a raw traversal ("which 2025 10-Ks mention goodwill impairment?") without leaving ChatGPT.

RoboSystems customers can also connect their own RoboLedger graph, a QuickBooks-connected general ledger with XBRL-grade reporting, through the same app; the graph is chosen at sign-in.

Authorization is OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. Each user authorizes one graph, sees only what their role allows, and can revoke access at any time. Shared repositories such as SEC EDGAR are read-only. Open source (Apache-2.0): github.com/RoboFinSystems/robosystems
plugin_asdk_app_6a8f6d7d50d081918787990d.longDescriptionZh:
RoboSystems 将会计和财务数据转化为 ChatGPT 可以直接查询的知识图谱。

SEC EDGAR：将每家上市公司的 XBRL 文件作为一个可查询的图表。通过代码或 CIK 提取公司的财务报表，跨公司、期间和维度报告事实，将“收入”等概念解析为其 XBRL 元素，并在归档叙述中运行全文搜索，然后阅读确切的部分。

每个图表还公开了只读 Cypher，因此对话可以从问题（“显示 NVIDIA 的最新损益表”）转移到原始遍历（“2025 年 10-K 中哪一个提到了商誉减损？”），而无需离开 ChatGPT。

RoboSystems 客户还可以通过同一个应用程序连接自己的 RoboLedger 图表，这是一个与 QuickBooks 连接的总账，具有 XBRL 级报告；该图表是在登录时选择的。

授权是带有 PKCE 的 OAuth 2.1。每个用户授权一张图表，仅查看其角色允许的内容，并且可以随时撤销访问权限。共享存储库（例如 SEC EDGAR）是只读的。开源（Apache-2.0）：github.com/RoboFinSystems/robosystems

defaultPromptsZh: 显示 NVIDIA 最新的年度损益表

plugin_asdk_app_6973331cf07c8191990ca9fa.productIntroEn: EurolandApp allows users to explore and visualize company financial data through interactive charts generated from natural-language queries.
plugin_asdk_app_6973331cf07c8191990ca9fa.longDescription:
EurolandApp allows users to explore and visualize company financial data through interactive charts generated from natural-language queries.

The app provides access to structured financial information including balance sheets, income statements, cash flow statements, and key financial ratios. Users can request specific metrics or comparisons, and the app dynamically generates charts based on the selected data.

Current coverage includes publicly available financial data for Swedish companies. Additional regions and datasets will be added over time as coverage expands.
plugin_asdk_app_6973331cf07c8191990ca9fa.longDescriptionZh:
EurolandApp 允许用户通过自然语言查询生成的交互式图表来探索和可视化公司财务数据。

该应用程序提供对结构化财务信息的访问，包括资产负债表、损益表、现金流量表和关键财务比率。用户可以请求特定的指标或比较，应用程序会根据所选数据动态生成图表。

当前的报道包括瑞典公司的公开财务数据。随着覆盖范围的扩大，将添加更多区域和数据集。

plugin_asdk_app_6a78805811a4819183bf039f.longDescription:
B2B.nu is a Swedish ERP for small businesses: invoicing, bookkeeping, bank reconciliation, VAT, payroll and CRM. This app connects ChatGPT to the user's own B2B.nu company so they can ask questions in plain Swedish and get answers from live data — the current financial position, the income statement and balance sheet, the VAT basis for the next filing, which invoices are overdue, which costs have drifted, and what is due next.

With write access explicitly granted, it can create and post records: invoice drafts, customer payments, journal entries, supplier invoices, bank reconciliations and to-dos. Financial actions may create bookkeeping entries and update related invoice, expense or bank-transaction statuses. The app never transfers money, sends invoices automatically or deletes records; corrections are made by the user in B2B.nu.

Access is controlled by OAuth 2.1. The user picks which company to connect and which areas to share, and every tool is additionally checked against their own permissions in B2B.nu — the AI can never do more than the user can. Personal identity numbers, bank account numbers and bankgiro/IBAN details are never returned by any tool.
plugin_asdk_app_6a78805811a4819183bf039f.longDescriptionZh:
B2B.nu 是一款面向小型企业的瑞典 ERP：发票、簿记、银行对账、增值税、工资和 CRM。该应用程序将 ChatGPT 连接到用户自己的 B2B.nu 公司，这样他们就可以用简单的瑞典语提出问题，并从实时数据中获得答案 - 当前的财务状况、损益表和资产负债表、下一次申报的增值税基础、哪些发票逾期、哪些成本已经漂移以及下一步到期的金额。

通过明确授予写入权限，它可以创建和过帐记录：发票草稿、客户付款、日记帐分录、供应商发票、银行对账单和待办事项。财务行为可以创建簿记条目并更新相关发票、费用或银行交易状态。该应用程序绝不会转账、自动发送发票或删除记录；用户在 B2B.nu 中进行更正。

访问由 OAuth 2.1 控制。用户选择要连接的公司以及要共享的区域，并且每个工具都会根据自己在 B2B.nu 中的权限进行额外检查 - 人工智能永远不会比用户做的更多。任何工具都不会返回个人身份号码、银行账号和银行转帐/IBAN 详细信息。

plugin_asdk_app_6aa9789071f4819194e9d6b3.productIntro: Bizora 是一个人工智能原生税务研究平台。该连接器将 Bizora 的研究引擎引入 ChatGPT，因此您可以在实际工作中提出税务问题，并获得基于主要来源权威而不是二次评论的答案。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa9789071f4819194e9d6b3.productIntroEn: Bizora is an AI native tax research platform. This connector brings Bizora’s research engine into ChatGPT, so you can ask a tax question in the middle of your actual work and get an answer grounded in primary source authority rather than secondary commentary.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa9789071f4819194e9d6b3.longDescription:
Bizora is an AI native tax research platform. This connector brings Bizora’s research engine into ChatGPT, so you can ask a tax question in the middle of your actual work and get an answer grounded in primary source authority rather than secondary commentary.

Ask the question the way you would ask a colleague. Bizora interprets it, researches it against the governing authority, and returns a reasoned answer with citations you can open and verify yourself. Responses point back to the sources that control the issue, including the Internal Revenue Code, Treasury regulations, revenue rulings and revenue procedures, IRS guidance, and federal case law. State and international authority is included where the question calls for it.

Common uses:

- Researching a client position before you commit to it on a return
- Checking whether recent legislation or guidance changes an answer you already relied on
- Working through cross-border and multistate questions where the authority is scattered
- Building the technical support behind a memo, a client email, or a workpaper
- Getting oriented on an issue outside your usual specialty

Because the connector runs inside ChatGPT, the research sits alongside the rest of your work. You can pull up a client email, research the question it raises, and draft the reply in one thread.

Every tool in this connector is read only. Bizora retrieves and analyzes tax authority without creating, modifying, or deleting your client records or research source material. Research usage is metered against your Bizora account credit balance.

Bizora is a research tool, not a substitute for professional judgment. Review the cited authority before relying on any answer in client work.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa9789071f4819194e9d6b3.longDescriptionZh:
Bizora 是一个人工智能原生税务研究平台。该连接器将 Bizora 的研究引擎引入 ChatGPT，因此您可以在实际工作中提出税务问题，并获得基于主要来源权威而不是二次评论的答案。

像问同事一样提问。 Bizora 对其进行解释，针对管理机构进行研究，并返回一个合理的答案，并附上您可以自行打开和验证的引文。回应指向控制该问题的来源，包括《国内税收法》、财政部法规、税收裁决和税收程序、国税局指南和联邦判例法。当问题需要时，国家和国际权威也被包括在内。

常见用途：

- 在承诺回报之前研究客户的立场
- 检查最近的立法或指南是否改变了您已经依赖的答案
- 解决权力分散的跨境和多州问题
- 建立备忘录、客户电子邮件或工作文件背后的技术支持
- 关注你通常专业之外的问题

由于连接器在 ChatGPT 内部运行，因此该研究与您的其他工作并存。您可以调出一封客户电子邮件，研究其中提出的问题，然后在一个线程中起草回复。

此连接器中的每个工具都是只读的。 Bizora 检索并分析税务机关，而无需创建、修改或删除您的客户记录或研究源材料。研究使用量根据您的 Bizora 帐户信用余额进行计量。

Bizora 是一种研究工具，不能替代专业判断。在依赖客户工作中的任何答案之前，请先查看引用的权威。
