plugin_asdk_app_6a750a14f2d08191944bf8cd.name: Jawz
plugin_asdk_app_6a750a14f2d08191944bf8cd.description: 阅读市场，检查投资组合
plugin_asdk_app_6a750a14f2d08191944bf8cd.productIntro: 询问你的人工智能有关市场的信息，它会凭记忆回答：它在训练期间吸收的任何内容，但不知道今天是什么样子，也不知道你实际拥有什么。
plugin_asdk_app_6a750a14f2d08191944bf8cd.productIntroEn: Ask your AI about the market and it answers from memory: whatever it absorbed during training, with no idea what today looks like or what you actually own.
plugin_asdk_app_6a750a14f2d08191944bf8cd.longDescription:
Ask your AI about the market and it answers from memory: whatever it absorbed during training, with no idea what today looks like or what you actually own.

Jawz gives it both. You get a live market read and a published four-chapter process for thinking about a portfolio: See the World (what markets are doing right now), Understand the Book (what your positions are really exposed to), Decide (how to think through a specific choice), and Observe & Refine (what your past decisions actually did).

Things you can ask:
• "What's the current macro regime?"
• "What does this week's read mean for a portfolio with BTC, AAPL and GLD?"
• "Is my thesis on this position still intact?"
• "What's in this week's World Brief?"

Every answer ends with its sources and how fresh they are, so you can see exactly where each number came from and when it was last updated. The framework itself is public and versioned, with a changelog that says what changed and why, including the times it changed because it was wrong.

Jawz is free and needs no account. The market and portfolio tools work the moment you connect. An optional email sign-in exists only to remember your settings between sessions.

One thing Jawz deliberately will not do is tell you what to buy or sell. It shows what is true about the market and your positions, frames the decision, and leaves the decision to you. Jawz is information and framework, not investment advice.
plugin_asdk_app_6a750a14f2d08191944bf8cd.longDescriptionZh:
询问你的人工智能有关市场的信息，它会凭记忆回答：它在训练期间吸收的任何内容，但不知道今天是什么样子，也不知道你实际拥有什么。

Jawz 两者兼而有之。您可以获得实时市场阅读和已发布的四章流程来思考投资组合：查看世界（市场现在在做什么）、了解书本（您的仓位真正面临的风险）、决定（如何思考特定选择）以及观察和优化（您过去的决策实际上做了什么）。

您可以询问的事项：
• “当前的宏观政策是什么？”
• “本周的解读对于 BTC、AAPL 和 GLD 的投资组合意味着什么？”
• “我关于这个立场的论文还完好无损吗？”
• “本周的世界简报有哪些内容？”

每个答案都以其来源及其新鲜程度结尾，因此您可以准确地看到每个数字的来源以及上次更新的时间。该框架本身是公开的和版本化的，有一个变更日志，说明发生了什么变化以及为什么发生变化，包括因为错误而发生变化的次数。

Jawz 是免费的，不需要帐户。市场和投资组合工具在您连接后立即发挥作用。可选的电子邮件登录仅用于记住您在会话之间的设置。

Jawz 故意不会做的一件事就是告诉你买什么或卖什么。它显示了市场和您的仓位的真实情况，制定决策，并将决定权留给您。 Jawz 是信息和框架，而不是投资建议。

plugin_asdk_app_69eab26946c4819197dbba5a.longDescription:
Co-Invest lets you trade directly from ChatGPT.

Explore, analyze, and place trades across a wide range of assets through a simple conversational interface. Whether you’re tracking crypto, equities, commodities, FX, or market indexes, Co-Invest helps you move from idea to action without switching between multiple apps.

With 24/7 access, you can monitor opportunities, review positions, and execute trades whenever markets are moving. Ask questions in plain English, get relevant market context, and trade from the same chat where you’re already thinking through your next move.

Co-Invest is built for people who want a faster, more intuitive way to interact with markets: less tab-hopping, fewer complex menus, and a trading experience that feels natural from the first prompt.

Key features:

- Trade a broad range of assets from ChatGPT
- Access markets 24/7
- Ask questions and get market context in plain English
- View positions and portfolio details conversationally
- Move from research to execution in one workflow

Liquid Co-Invest brings trading into the conversation, making it easier to understand markets, act on ideas, and stay connected to your portfolio.
plugin_asdk_app_69eab26946c4819197dbba5a.longDescriptionZh:
Co-Invest 让您可以直接从 ChatGPT 进行交易。

通过简单的对话界面探索、分析各种资产并进行交易。无论您是跟踪加密货币、股票、大宗商品、外汇还是市场指数，Co-Invest 都可以帮助您将想法付诸行动，而无需在多个应用程序之间切换。

通过 24/7 访问，您可以在市场变动时监控机会、查看仓位并执行交易。用简单的英语提出问题，获取相关的市场背景，并在您已经考虑下一步行动的同一个聊天中进行交易。

Co-Invest 专为那些希望以更快、更直观的方式与市场互动的人们而打造：更少的选项卡跳转、更少的复杂菜单以及从第一个提示开始就感觉自然的交易体验。

主要特点：

- 从 ChatGPT 交易广泛的资产
- 24/7 进入市场
- 用简单的英语提出问题并了解市场背景
- 以对话方式查看头寸和投资组合详细信息
- 在一个工作流程中从研究转移到执行

Liquid Co-Invest 将交易带入对话中，让您更轻松地了解市场、根据想法采取行动并与您的投资组合保持联系。

The easiest way to find the right broadband deal is now on ChatGPT.

By connecting FindBroadband with ChatGPT, you can check the broadband deals available at your exact UK address, compare live prices from the top providers and full-fibre networks and see every deal priced by its true whole-contract cost, so a teaser price never hides the real one.

Try asking ChatGPT things like:
- am I overpaying? I'm with Sky at £44 a month for 100Mb
- find me full fibre under £30 with no mid-contract price rises
- my provider quoted £43 a month to renew, is that fair?

You can refine by budget, speed, contract length or provider just by asking. Once you've found the right deal, you complete your switch on findbroadbanddeals.com.

Ask where a deal stands, what changed since you last looked, which diligence questions are still open, and how well each figure is supported. You can also add deals and meeting notes, record diligence answers, and rewrite a memo section in plain language.

plugin_asdk_app_6a9aada63a6c8191a4f43135.name: MonitorBankRates
plugin_asdk_app_6a9aada63a6c8191a4f43135.productIntro: MonitorBankRates 自 2008 年以来一直跟踪银行和信用社利率。该插件将 ChatGPT 连接到为 MonitorBankRates.com 提供支持的同一实时数据库：来自 8,000 多家美国银行和信用社的约 150,000 个当前利率报价，每天根据每个机构自己发布的利率进行刷新。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9aada63a6c8191a4f43135.productIntroEn: MonitorBankRates has tracked bank and credit union rates since 2008. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the same live database that powers MonitorBankRates.com: about 150,000 current rate quotes from more than 8,000 U.S. banks and credit unions, refreshed daily from each institution's own published rates.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9aada63a6c8191a4f43135.longDescription:
MonitorBankRates has tracked bank and credit union rates since 2008. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the same live database that powers MonitorBankRates.com: about 150,000 current rate quotes from more than 8,000 U.S. banks and credit unions, refreshed daily from each institution's own published rates.

Ask for the best rates on CDs (3 to 60 months), high-yield savings, money market and checking accounts, mortgages, home equity loans and HELOCs, auto loans, personal loans, and credit cards — nationally or in your state — and get one best quote per institution with the minimum deposit and the date it was collected.

Check today's average rate for any product and whether it's moving up or down over the past week, month, or quarter. Look up any bank or credit union to see every rate it offers alongside its MonitorBankRates financial health grade, star rating, and Texas ratio from the latest FDIC or NCUA filing.

You can also pull the MBR Housing Affordability Index, updated daily with state rankings, and the annual Home and Auto Insurance Burden Indexes.

Every answer is dated, credited to MonitorBankRates.com, and linked to the matching page. No account or sign-in required.

this is from bankrate This tool specializes in providing current consumer banking rates and calculating savings projections. It is designed to be an objective, non-advisory resource.

Theirs is deliberately plain — reviewers in the finance category want to see "objective, non-advisory" spelled out, so it's worth borrowing that line. Yours can stay richer, but add it at the end:

MonitorBankRates has tracked bank and credit union rates since 2008. This plugin connects ChatGPT to the same live database that powers MonitorBankRates.com: about 150,000 current rate quotes from more than 8,000 U.S. banks and credit unions, refreshed daily from each institution's own published rates.

Ask for the best rates on CDs (3 to 60 months), high-yield savings, money market and checking accounts, mortgages, home equity loans and HELOCs, auto loans, personal loans, and credit cards — nationally or in your state — and get one best quote per institution with the minimum deposit and the date it was collected. Check the average rate for any product and how it has moved over the past week, month, or quarter. Look up any bank or credit union to see its current rates alongside its MonitorBankRates financial health grade, star rating, and Texas ratio from the latest FDIC or NCUA filing. Pull the MBR Housing Affordability Index and the Home and Auto Insurance Burden Indexes with state rankings.

Every answer is dated, credited to MonitorBankRates.com, and linked to the matching page. No account or sign-in required.

This tool provides published rate data and index values for comparison. It is an objective, non-advisory resource and does not provide financial advice or recommendations
plugin_asdk_app_6a9aada63a6c8191a4f43135.longDescriptionZh:
MonitorBankRates 自 2008 年以来一直跟踪银行和信用社利率。该插件将 ChatGPT 连接到为 MonitorBankRates.com 提供支持的同一实时数据库：来自 8,000 多家美国银行和信用社的约 150,000 个当前利率报价，每天根据每个机构自己发布的利率进行刷新。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8c141fde0481918deb107e.name: Lexplorer Swiss Tax Research
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c141fde0481918deb107e.productIntro: Lexplorer 通过经过验证的可引用来源搜索瑞士税法：联邦税法（DBG、MWSTG、StHG、VStG、印花税）、所有 26 个州的税法、24 个州的官方税务手册和行政实践、联邦行政实践（ESTV 和 SSK 通告、增值税出版物）以及评论和学术理论。 ChatGPT 以税务专业人士的方式规划研究：首先是法规，然后是行政实践和学说，对于州问题，则提供正确州的来源 - 每个关键陈述都带有精确的引用和原始来源的链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c141fde0481918deb107e.productIntroEn: Lexplorer searches Swiss tax law with verified, citable sources: federal tax acts (DBG, MWSTG, StHG, VStG, stamp duties), the tax acts of all 26 cantons, the official tax handbooks and administrative practice of 24 cantons, the federal administrative practice (ESTV and SSK circulars, VAT publications), plus commentary and academic doctrine.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c141fde0481918deb107e.longDescription: Lexplorer searches Swiss tax law with verified, citable sources: federal tax acts (DBG, MWSTG, StHG, VStG, stamp duties), the tax acts of all 26 cantons, the official tax handbooks and administrative practice of 24 cantons, the federal administrative practice (ESTV and SSK circulars, VAT publications), plus commentary and academic doctrine. ChatGPT plans the research the way a tax professional would: statute first, then administrative practice and doctrine, and for cantonal questions the sources of the right canton — every key statement with a precise citation and a link to the original source. Examples: "What does § 31 of the Zurich tax act (StG ZH) say?" · "How are dividends in kind treated for withholding tax? Include ESTV practice." · "How does the DBG regulate employee participations?" · "Compare the practice in the cantons of ZH and ZG." Built for tax advisors, fiduciaries, lawyers and in-house teams. Requires a Lexplorer account (login on first use) — more at lexplorer.ch.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8c141fde0481918deb107e.longDescriptionZh: Lexplorer 通过经过验证的可引用来源搜索瑞士税法：联邦税法（DBG、MWSTG、StHG、VStG、印花税）、所有 26 个州的税法、24 个州的官方税务手册和行政实践、联邦行政实践（ESTV 和 SSK 通告、增值税出版物）以及评论和学术理论。 ChatGPT 以税务专业人士的方式规划研究：首先是法规，然后是行政实践和学说，对于州问题，则提供正确州的来源 - 每个关键陈述都带有精确的引用和原始来源的链接。示例：“苏黎世税法 (StG ZH) 第 31 条有何规定？” · “如何处理实物股息的预扣税？包括 ESTV 做法。” ·“DBG 如何规范员工参与？” · “比较 ZH 州和 ZG 州的做法。”专为税务顾问、受托人、律师和内部团队而设计。需要 Lexplorer 帐户（首次使用时登录）——更多信息请访问 lexplorer.ch。
defaultPrompts: Was sagt § 31 StG ZH? Mit aktuellem Wortlaut und Fundstelle.
Was gilt bei der Verrechnungssteuer für Naturaldividenden? Mit ESTV-Praxis.
Vergleiche die Besteuerung von Mitarbeiterbeteiligungen in den Kantonen ZH und ZG.

plugin_asdk_app_6a2675ace6088191a87d1805.productIntro: Validis 将 ChatGPT 连接到从公司源分类账中提取的交易级会计数据。无论底层会计系统如何，都可以通过单一一致的模式搜索和选择业务，提取标准化总账、应收账款、应付账款和试算表数据。运行内置分析，包括财务比率、AR 和 AP 账龄、营运资金、收入质量、账本完整性和欺诈指标，或直接查询基础数据。专为需要快速、可靠地访问人工智能工作流程中的财务数据的贷方、审计师和财务团队而设计。
plugin_asdk_app_6a2675ace6088191a87d1805.productIntroEn: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardised general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system.
plugin_asdk_app_6a2675ace6088191a87d1805.longDescription: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardised general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system. Run built-in analytics including financial ratios, AR and AP aging, working capital, revenue quality, ledger integrity, and fraud indicators, or query the underlying data directly. Designed for lenders, auditors, and finance teams who need fast, reliable access to financial data inside their AI workflows.

plugin_asdk_app_6a931a20f68c8191b2d8051f.productIntro: 连接您的 MONVELOP 帐户以在对话中了解您的个人预算。要求提供每月财务概览、按信封列出的支出明细、最近的交易、定期订阅或预算期间的比较。
plugin_asdk_app_6a931a20f68c8191b2d8051f.productIntroEn: Connect your MONVELOP account to understand your personal budget in conversation. Ask for a monthly financial overview, a spending breakdown by envelope, recent transactions, recurring subscriptions, or a comparison between budget periods.
plugin_asdk_app_6a931a20f68c8191b2d8051f.longDescription:
Connect your MONVELOP account to understand your personal budget in conversation. Ask for a monthly financial overview, a spending breakdown by envelope, recent transactions, recurring subscriptions, or a comparison between budget periods.

MONVELOP tools are read-only. They cannot create, edit, or delete financial data, initiate payments or transfers, connect a bank, or execute investments. Results are limited to your authenticated MONVELOP account and the permissions you approve.
plugin_asdk_app_6a931a20f68c8191b2d8051f.longDescriptionZh:
连接您的 MONVELOP 帐户以在对话中了解您的个人预算。要求提供每月财务概览、按信封列出的支出明细、最近的交易、定期订阅或预算期间的比较。

MONVELOP 工具是只读的。他们无法创建、编辑或删除财务数据、发起付款或转账、连接银行或执行投资。结果仅限于您经过身份验证的 MONVELOP 帐户和您批准的权限。

plugin_asdk_app_6aafe16842708191acfb93d9.productIntro: 像 DSCR 贷方一样分析美国住宅投资物业。 OneMoreDoor Capital 的 DSCR 贷款计算器可计算偿债覆盖率、每月 PITIA、现金流、资本化率以及盈亏平衡租金或 1-10 单位租金的价格，然后在聊天中放置一个完全可编辑的计算器，所以“如果租金为 3,900 美元会怎样？”立即重新运行。在 OneMoreDoor.com 上继续进行相同的交易，并保留每个号码，或者为您的合作伙伴或经纪人获取可共享的链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6aafe16842708191acfb93d9.productIntroEn: Analyze U.S. residential investment property like a DSCR lender does. OneMoreDoor Capital's DSCR Loan Calculator computes debt service coverage ratio, monthly PITIA, cash flow, cap rate, and break-even rent or price for 1-10 unit rentals, then puts a fully editable calculator right in the chat, so "what if rent were $3,900?" re-runs instantly. Continue the same deal on OneMoreDoor.
plugin_asdk_app_6aafe16842708191acfb93d9.longDescription: Analyze U.S. residential investment property like a DSCR lender does. OneMoreDoor Capital's DSCR Loan Calculator computes debt service coverage ratio, monthly PITIA, cash flow, cap rate, and break-even rent or price for 1-10 unit rentals, then puts a fully editable calculator right in the chat, so "what if rent were $3,900?" re-runs instantly. Continue the same deal on OneMoreDoor.com with every number carried over, or get a shareable link for your partner or broker. Investment property only; it never quotes rates, and it collects no personal information.

plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdf9e34b881918505f1cd.productIntro: Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件可通过 Alpaca 的交易 API 和市场数据 API 直接访问模拟交易执行。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdf9e34b881918505f1cd.productIntroEn: Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to paper trading execution via Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdf9e34b881918505f1cd.longDescription:
Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to paper trading execution via Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API. 

Connect ChatGPT to your Alpaca paper account to place simulated trades across stocks, ETFs, options, and crypto. Monitor your positions, analyze market trends, and manage your account through natural language.

Insights generated by Alpaca’s MCP server, ChatGPT plugin and connected AI agents are for educational and informational use only and not investment advice. Do your own due diligence before making decisions.

AlpacaDB, Inc.’s Paper Trading API uses simulated funds and does not enable transactions in real securities. Its availability and content do not constitute an offer, solicitation, investment advice, recommendation, or endorsement involving securities, derivatives, futures, or trading strategies. The API is not offered in jurisdictions where AlpacaDB, Inc. or its affiliates (collectively, “Alpaca”) are not authorized to conduct business.

Options trading is not suitable for all investors due to its inherent high risk, which can potentially result in significant losses. Please read Characteristics and Risks of Standardized Options (https://www.theocc.com/Company-Information/Documents-and-Archives/Options-Disclosure-Document) before investing in options.

Please see the Disclosure Library at https://alpaca.markets/disclosures for additional information and disclosures from Alpaca Clearing and Alpaca Crypto.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdf9e34b881918505f1cd.longDescriptionZh:
Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件可通过 Alpaca 的交易 API 和市场数据 API 直接访问模拟交易执行。 

将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Alpaca 纸质账户，以进行股票、ETF、期权和加密货币的模拟交易。通过自然语言监控您的仓位、分析市场趋势并管理您的账户。

Alpaca 的 MCP 服务器、ChatGPT 插件和连接的 AI 代理生成的见解仅供教育和信息用途，并非投资建议。在做出决定之前，请自行进行尽职调查。

AlpacaDB, Inc. 的模拟交易 API 使用模拟资金，不支持真实证券交易。其可用性和内容并不构成涉及证券、衍生品、期货或交易策略的要约、招揽、投资建议、推荐或认可。在 AlpacaDB, Inc. 或其附属公司（统称“Alpaca”）无权开展业务的司法管辖区，不提供 API。

期权交易因其固有的高风险而并不适合所有投资者，这可能会导致重大损失。在投资期权之前，请阅读标准化期权的特征和风险 (https://www.theocc.com/Company-Information/Documents-and-Archives/Options-Disclosure-Document)。

请参阅披露库 https://alpaca.markets/disclosures，了解 Alpaca Clearing 和 Alpaca Crypto 的更多信息和披露信息。
defaultPrompts: Show today’s biggest stock gainers and losers, then summarize the market conditions behind the moves.

plugin_asdk_app_6a6bb87aadf08191860f8d9d.productIntro: Mergr 是一个私募股权和并购研究数据库，现已在 ChatGPT 中提供。它涵盖 4,100 多家活跃的私募股权公司、224,000 多家公司和 223,000 多笔交易，包含所有权历史、交易顾问和 100,000 多份新闻稿，重点关注中间市场。
plugin_asdk_app_6a6bb87aadf08191860f8d9d.productIntroEn: Mergr is a private equity and M&A research database, now available in ChatGPT. It covers 4,100+ active PE firms, 224,000+ companies, and 223,000+ transactions, with ownership histories, deal advisors, and 100,000+ press releases, focused on the middle market.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6bb87aadf08191860f8d9d.longDescription:
Mergr is a private equity and M&A research database, now available in ChatGPT. It covers 4,100+ active PE firms, 224,000+ companies, and 223,000+ transactions, with ownership histories, deal advisors, and 100,000+ press releases, focused on the middle market.

Ask the questions you'd put to an analyst: which PE firms would buy a $30M revenue HVAC company in Texas; who has owned a company and for how long; which sponsors are building roll-ups in a sector; which banks advised the most software deals last year. You can also paste a list of company names or websites and match them to Mergr records in one step.

Twelve read-only tools cover firm, company, and deal search; buyer, investor, and advisor matching; ownership histories; activity rankings; and roll-up tracking. Every result links to the corresponding mergr.com profile. Access requires a mergr.com membership.
plugin_asdk_app_6a6bb87aadf08191860f8d9d.longDescriptionZh:
Mergr 是一个私募股权和并购研究数据库，现已在 ChatGPT 中提供。它涵盖 4,100 多家活跃的私募股权公司、224,000 多家公司和 223,000 多笔交易，包含所有权历史、交易顾问和 100,000 多份新闻稿，重点关注中间市场。

询问您向分析师提出的问题：哪些私募股权公司会收购德克萨斯州一家收入 3000 万美元的 HVAC 公司；谁拥有一家公司以及拥有多久；哪些赞助商正在某个领域建立汇总；去年哪些银行为最多的软件交易提供了建议。您还可以粘贴公司名称或网站列表，并一步将它们与 Mergr 记录进行匹配。

十二个只读工具涵盖公司、公司和交易搜索；买家、投资者和顾问匹配；所有权历史；活动排名；和汇总跟踪。每个结果都链接到相应的 mergr.com 个人资料。访问需要 mergr.com 会员资格。
defaultPrompts: Who are the best buyers for a $30M HVAC services company based in Texas?
Find active roll-ups in consumer services
In the past 5 years, which PE firms are the most active acquirers in healthcare?
defaultPromptsZh: 谁是德克萨斯州一家价值 3000 万美元的 HVAC 服务公司的最佳买家？
寻找消费者服务中的活跃汇总
过去 5 年中，哪些私募股权公司是医疗保健领域最活跃的收购者？

plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdfb4752881919706186a.productIntro: Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件提供对 Alpaca 交易 API 和市场数据 API 的直接访问。
plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdfb4752881919706186a.productIntroEn: Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdfb4752881919706186a.longDescription:
Alpaca’s ChatGPT Plugin provides direct access to Alpaca's Trading API and Market Data API. 

Connect ChatGPT to your account to monitor your live positions, analyze market trends, and manage your account using natural language. Use Alpaca’s Trading API and Dashboard directly if you want to execute your orders.

Please see the Disclosure Library at https://alpaca.markets/disclosures for additional information and disclosures from Alpaca Clearing and Alpaca Crypto.
plugin_asdk_app_6a3cdfb4752881919706186a.longDescriptionZh:
Alpaca 的 ChatGPT 插件提供对 Alpaca 交易 API 和市场数据 API 的直接访问。 

将 ChatGPT 连接到您的帐户，以监控您的实时头寸、分析市场趋势并使用自然语言管理您的帐户。如果您想执行订单，请直接使用 Alpaca 的交易 API 和仪表板。

请参阅披露库 https://alpaca.markets/disclosures，了解 Alpaca Clearing 和 Alpaca Crypto 的更多信息和披露信息。

plugin_asdk_app_6a8cb0f329ec81919fd57d7a.name: OptionClaws
plugin_asdk_app_6a8cb0f329ec81919fd57d7a.productIntro: OptionClaws 扫描每只可选择的美国股票，并根据您询问的策略返回排名的期权交易。 备兑看涨期权、现金担保看跌期权、信用利差、铁秃鹰期权、蝴蝶期权、日历期权、对角期权、跨式期权、宽跨式期权等。
plugin_asdk_app_6a8cb0f329ec81919fd57d7a.productIntroEn: OptionClaws scans every optionable US stock and returns ranked options trades for the strategy you ask about. Covered calls, cash-secured puts, credit spreads, iron condors, butterflies, calendars, diagonals, straddles, strangles, and more.
plugin_asdk_app_6a8cb0f329ec81919fd57d7a.longDescription:
OptionClaws scans every optionable US stock and returns ranked options trades for the strategy you ask about.  Covered calls, cash-secured puts, credit spreads, iron condors, butterflies, calendars, diagonals, straddles, strangles, and more.

Ask in plain English, like "find me high-probability iron condors on large caps with a max loss under $500" or "show me iron condors on SPY expiring in 30–45 days," and ChatGPT will run the scan and show the top candidates with return, probability of profit, greeks, and liquidity, using quotes that refresh throughout the trading day. You can also start from a built-in preset, re-run scans you've saved on OptionClaws, and look up which filters are available before you scan.

Made for options traders who want to find and compare candidate trades without clicking through chains by hand. Requires an OptionClaws account. Results are informational only and not financial advice
plugin_asdk_app_6a8cb0f329ec81919fd57d7a.longDescriptionZh:
OptionClaws 扫描每只可选择的美国股票，并根据您询问的策略返回排名的期权交易。  备兑看涨期权、现金担保看跌期权、信用利差、铁秃鹰期权、蝴蝶期权、日历期权、对角期权、跨式期权、宽跨式期权等。

用简单的英语询问，例如“为我找到最大损失低于 500 美元的大盘股高概率铁秃鹰”或“向我展示 30-45 天内到期的 SPY 铁秃鹰”，ChatGPT 将运行扫描，并使用整个交易日刷新的报价，向最佳候选者显示回报、盈利概率、希腊语和流动性。您还可以从内置预设开始，重新运行在 OptionClaws 上保存的扫描，并在扫描之前查找可用的过滤器。

专为希望查找和比较候选交易而无需手动点击链的期权交易者而设计。需要 OptionClaws 帐户。结果仅供参考，并非财务建议
defaultPrompts: Find the best cash-secured puts 30–45 DTE with 75%+ probability of expiring worthless, ranked by annualized return.
Find wheel-strategy candidates on dividend-paying stocks using short-dated cash-secured puts with attractive premium.
Find bull put spreads on oversold, profitable stocks and rank the strongest setups by return on risk.
defaultPromptsZh: 寻找最佳现金担保看跌期权 30-45 DTE，到期概率为 75% 以上，一文不值，按年化回报率排名。
使用溢价有吸引力的短期现金担保看跌期权寻找派息股票的轮盘策略候选者。
查找超卖、盈利股票的牛市看跌期权价差，并按风险回报率对最强的设置进行排名。

plugin_asdk_app_6a986f31a74081918c7257f3.name: Rydoo
plugin_asdk_app_6a986f31a74081918c7257f3.description: 管理您的 Rydoo 开支
plugin_asdk_app_6a986f31a74081918c7257f3.productIntro: Rydoo MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Rydoo 帐户，因此您可以通过日常对话来管理您的支出，而无需导航应用程序。使用您现有的 Rydoo 登录名登录一次 - ChatGPT 只能使用您自己的角色和权限查看和执行您在 Rydoo 中已被允许执行的操作。
plugin_asdk_app_6a986f31a74081918c7257f3.productIntroEn: Rydoo MCP connects ChatGPT to your Rydoo account, so you can manage your expenses through everyday conversation instead of navigating the app. Sign in once with your existing Rydoo login — ChatGPT can then only see and do what you're already permitted to do in Rydoo, using your own roles and permissions.
plugin_asdk_app_6a986f31a74081918c7257f3.longDescription:
Rydoo MCP connects ChatGPT to your Rydoo account, so you can manage your expenses through everyday conversation instead of navigating the app. Sign in once with your existing Rydoo login — ChatGPT can then only see and do what you're already permitted to do in Rydoo, using your own roles and permissions.

Key features:
- Read and analyse spend — search expenses you own or oversee by date, status, category, group, person or trip, pull up a single expense with a link into Rydoo, find card expenses still missing a receipt, and get server-computed totals per trip, person or project.
- Process approvals — see what's waiting on you, then approve or reject an expense using your company's reject reasons. Every action is confirmed with you first and recorded under your name.
- Answer questions — expense-policy Q&A: what's reimbursable, which limits apply, and similar.
- Look up company records — find the right category, branch, group, person or trip to filter expenses by, and check your own roles, modules and currencies.
- Review trips — look up trips and bookings you own or oversee, and tie expenses back to them.
- Manage cards and wallets — list cards you hold, approve or oversee as finance, review matched and unmatched card transactions, check wallet balances, spend summaries and monthly statements, and request a virtual card with the limit you confirm. Requires the Rydoo Cards module.
- Send feedback — report a bug or request a feature straight to Rydoo.
plugin_asdk_app_6a986f31a74081918c7257f3.longDescriptionZh:
Rydoo MCP 将 ChatGPT 连接到您的 Rydoo 帐户，因此您可以通过日常对话来管理您的支出，而无需导航应用程序。使用您现有的 Rydoo 登录名登录一次 - ChatGPT 只能使用您自己的角色和权限查看和执行您在 Rydoo 中已被允许执行的操作。

主要特点：
- 阅读和分析支出 - 按日期、状态、类别、团体、人员或行程搜索您拥有或监督的支出，通过 Rydoo 链接提取单个支出，查找仍缺少收据的卡支出，并获取服务器计算的每次行程、个人或项目的总计。
- 流程批准 - 查看等待您的内容，然后使用您公司的拒绝原因批准或拒绝费用。每一个动作都会先与您确认并记录在您的名下。
- 回答问题 — 费用政策问答：什么是可报销的、适用哪些限制等。
- 查找公司记录 - 找到正确的类别、分支机构、团体、人员或旅行来过滤费用，并检查您自己的角色、模块和货币。
- 查看旅行 - 查找您拥有或监督的旅行和预订，并将费用与它们联系起来。
- 管理卡和钱包 - 列出您持有、批准或监管的财务卡，审查匹配和不匹配的卡交易，检查钱包余额、支出摘要和月度报表，并根据您确认的限额申请虚拟卡。需要 Rydoo 卡模块。
- 发送反馈——直接向 Rydoo 报告错误或请求功能。
defaultPrompts: Show my unsubmitted expenses from last month.
Which of my card expenses are still missing a receipt?
What are non-reimbursable expenses in our expense policy?
defaultPromptsZh: 显示我上个月未提交的费用。
我的哪些卡消费仍然缺少收据？
我们的费用政策中哪些是不可报销的费用？

plugin_asdk_app_6a182a19bddc81918ae38430.productIntro: Validis 将 ChatGPT 连接到从公司源分类账中提取的交易级会计数据。无论底层会计系统如何，都可以通过单一一致的模式搜索和选择业务，提取标准化总账、应收账款、应付账款和试算表数据。运行内置分析，包括财务比率、AR 和 AP 账龄、营运资金、收入质量、账本完整性和欺诈指标，或直接查询基础数据。专为需要快速、可靠地访问人工智能工作流程中的财务数据的贷方、审计师和财务团队而设计。

plugin_asdk_app_6a88e3d0a28c8191a17802d7.productIntro: Revestor 是一款面向美国房东的租赁组合和税务准备软件。在 OAuth 同意后连接它以查询实时 Revetor 记录，包括财产、REPS 小时数、费用和里程。通过写入权限，助理可以提出时间日志、里程或非机密费用；提案将在 Revestor AI Review 中保持待决状态，直到您接受为止。连接器流量不使用 Gemini 或 Revestor AI 积分。输出仅为记录和状态，而不是税务、法律或会计建议。

Connect it to query live Revestor records after OAuth consent, including properties, REPS hours, expenses, and mileage. With write access, assistants can propose time logs, mileage, or unclassified expenses; proposals stay pending in Revestor AI Review until you accept them.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa37e50d2548191875fdb36.description: TCG 和运动卡价格及投资回报率
plugin_asdk_app_6aa37e50d2548191875fdb36.productIntro: 查看球星卡的价值以及为其评分是否值得。 Midpoint 返回超过 150 万张 Pokémon、Magic: The Gathering、Yu-Gi-Oh!、One Piece、Lorcana、Gundam、体育（棒球、篮球、足球、曲棍球、足球、摔跤、UFC、高尔夫、网球、拳击、赛车）和娱乐卡的当前美元市场价格。按名称、套装或编号索取卡片，即可按条件获取其原始（未分级）价格以及 PSA、CGC、BGS、SGC 和 TAG 的分级阶梯。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa37e50d2548191875fdb36.productIntroEn: Look up what a trading card is worth and whether grading it pays. Midpoint returns current USD market prices for 1.5M+ Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Gundam, sports (baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, wrestling, UFC, golf, tennis, boxing, racing) and entertainment cards.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa37e50d2548191875fdb36.longDescription: Look up what a trading card is worth and whether grading it pays. Midpoint returns current USD market prices for 1.5M+ Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, Yu-Gi-Oh!, One Piece, Lorcana, Gundam, sports (baseball, basketball, football, hockey, soccer, wrestling, UFC, golf, tennis, boxing, racing) and entertainment cards. Ask for a card by name, set or number to get its raw (ungraded) price by condition and the graded ladder for PSA, CGC, BGS, SGC and TAG. Ask whether it is worth grading to get the PSA 9 and PSA 10 premium, net profit after grading fees, expected value by gem rate and a plain verdict. You can also see 7 to 180 days of price history, the biggest 30-day movers, rising cards that actually sell, the best cards to grade in a game or set, and priced set checklists. Every answer links to the matching page on cardcenteringtool.com. No account is needed and nothing is written.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa37e50d2548191875fdb36.longDescriptionZh: 查看球星卡的价值以及为其评分是否值得。 Midpoint 返回超过 150 万张 Pokémon、Magic: The Gathering、Yu-Gi-Oh!、One Piece、Lorcana、Gundam、体育（棒球、篮球、足球、曲棍球、足球、摔跤、UFC、高尔夫、网球、拳击、赛车）和娱乐卡的当前美元市场价格。按名称、套装或编号索取卡片，即可按条件获取其原始（未分级）价格以及 PSA、CGC、BGS、SGC 和 TAG 的分级阶梯。询问是否值得进行分级以获得 PSA 9 和 PSA 10 溢价、分级费用后的净利润、按宝石率计算的预期值以及简单的判决。您还可以查看 7 至 180 天的价格历史记录、最大的 30 天变动、实际销量上升的卡牌、游戏或套装中最适合评分的卡牌以及定价套装清单。每个答案都链接到 cardcenteringtool.com 上的匹配页面。不需要记账，也没有写任何东西。

plugin_asdk_app_6a9dfc83a9748191aa4d3f1e.description: 巴西房地产投资信托基金研究
plugin_asdk_app_6a9dfc83a9748191aa4d3f1e.productIntro: 使用自然语言研究和跟踪巴西 REIT（房地产投资基金，简称 FII）。 Análise de FII 整理基金价格、股息收益率、基本面、指标、风险、流动性、分布和报告。比较资金并使用筛选器找到符合您标准的 FII。经过身份验证的专业版用户还可以跟踪自己的投资组合，包括持仓、股息、估值和处理状态。免费预览版提供公共基金数据和指标，而专业版则解锁其余工具和完整分析。该应用程序是信息性的和只读的：它不买卖投资、转移资金或取代财务建议。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9dfc83a9748191aa4d3f1e.productIntroEn: Research and track Brazilian REITs (real estate investment funds, or FIIs) using natural language. Análise de FIIs organizes fund prices, dividend yield, fundamentals, indicators, risk, liquidity, distributions, and reports. Compare funds and use a screener to find FIIs that match your criteria.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9dfc83a9748191aa4d3f1e.longDescription: Research and track Brazilian REITs (real estate investment funds, or FIIs) using natural language. Análise de FIIs organizes fund prices, dividend yield, fundamentals, indicators, risk, liquidity, distributions, and reports. Compare funds and use a screener to find FIIs that match your criteria. Authenticated Pro users can also track their own portfolios, including holdings, dividends, valuations, and processing status. The free preview provides public fund data and indicators, while Pro unlocks the remaining tools and full analyses. The app is informational and read-only: it does not buy or sell investments, move money, or replace financial advice.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa202d5642481918aa4380a.name: Thrifle
plugin_asdk_app_6aa202d5642481918aa4380a.productIntro: 询问任何美国零售商的退货政策：退货窗口、是否免费退货、补货费用、假期延长以及从 A+ 到 D- 的等级。检查商店价格是否匹配、提供哪些军事和学生折扣、品牌在您生日时赠送什么以及如何取消订阅。查找包含价格和标价的实时交易，查找商店信用卡条款（包括延期利息促销），并询问亚马逊价格是否值得立即购买或等待。每个答案都包含一个指向其所基于的 Thrifle 页面的链接。
plugin_asdk_app_6aa202d5642481918aa4380a.productIntroEn: Ask about any US retailer's return policy: the return window, whether returns are free, restocking fees, holiday extensions, and a grade from A+ to D-. Check whether a store price-matches, what military and student discounts it offers, what a brand gives away on your birthday, and how to cancel a subscription.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa202d5642481918aa4380a.longDescription: Ask about any US retailer's return policy: the return window, whether returns are free, restocking fees, holiday extensions, and a grade from A+ to D-. Check whether a store price-matches, what military and student discounts it offers, what a brand gives away on your birthday, and how to cancel a subscription. Find live deals with prices and list prices, look up store credit-card terms including deferred-interest promotions, and ask whether an Amazon price is worth buying now or waiting on. Every answer includes a link to the Thrifle page it is based on. The data covers 2,250 US retailers, is verified by Thrifle's editors, and each record carries the date it was last checked. The plugin is read-only: it looks things up and never changes anything.
plugin_asdk_app_6aa202d5642481918aa4380a.longDescriptionZh: 询问任何美国零售商的退货政策：退货窗口、是否免费退货、补货费用、假期延长以及从 A+ 到 D- 的等级。检查商店价格是否匹配、提供哪些军事和学生折扣、品牌在您生日时赠送什么以及如何取消订阅。查找包含价格和标价的实时交易，查找商店信用卡条款（包括延期利息促销），并询问亚马逊价格是否值得立即购买或等待。每个答案都包含一个指向其所基于的 Thrifle 页面的链接。该数据涵盖 2,250 个美国零售商，并由 Thrifle 的编辑验证，每条记录都带有上次检查的日期。该插件是只读的：它会查找内容并且不会更改任何内容。

Dospay provides trusted escrow and third-party managed account services for high-value and complex transactions. Get expert guidance on escrow accounts, payment management, and secure fund holding. The Dospay ChatGPT App gives users access to general business information such as website and contact email address. The app also allows users to get in touch with the Dospay team.

plugin_asdk_app_6a291ec4f5448191b4272359.productIntro: Validis 将 ChatGPT 连接到从公司源分类账中提取的交易级会计数据。无论底层会计系统如何，都可以通过单一一致的模式搜索和选择业务，提取标准化总账、应收账款、应付账款和试算表数据。运行内置分析，包括财务比率、AR 和 AP 账龄、营运资金、收入质量、账本完整性和欺诈指标，或直接查询基础数据。专为需要快速、可靠地访问人工智能工作流程中的财务数据的贷方、审计师和财务团队而设计。
plugin_asdk_app_6a291ec4f5448191b4272359.productIntroEn: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardized general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system.
plugin_asdk_app_6a291ec4f5448191b4272359.longDescription: Validis connects ChatGPT to transaction level accounting data extracted from a company's source ledgers. Search and select engagements, pull standardized general ledger, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and trial balance data through a single consistent schema, regardless of the underlying accounting system. Run built-in analytics including financial ratios, AR and AP aging, working capital, revenue quality, ledger integrity, and fraud indicators, or query the underlying data directly. Designed for lenders, auditors, and finance teams who need fast, reliable access to financial data inside their AI workflows.

plugin_asdk_app_6a9b1dc7ae788191b768ce27.description: 自动征收销售税和增值税
plugin_asdk_app_6a9b1dc7ae788191b768ce27.productIntro: Kintsugi AI：自动征收销售税和增值税。
plugin_asdk_app_6a9b1dc7ae788191b768ce27.productIntroEn: Kintsugi is an AI-powered platform that automates sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for SaaS and ecommerce businesses, and financial firms. The Kintsugi MCP server lets you track your compliance without leaving the conversation.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9b1dc7ae788191b768ce27.longDescription:
Kintsugi is an AI-powered platform that automates sales tax, VAT, and GST compliance for SaaS and ecommerce businesses, and financial firms. The Kintsugi MCP server lets you track your compliance without leaving the conversation.

With the Kintsugi MCP server, you can:

See your nexus exposure in real time, for free, across every jurisdiction where you sell

Look up registrations and jurisdiction-specific requirements

Estimate sales tax, VAT, and GST for a transaction, address, or product

Check on the status of your filings, for all jurisdictions

Look up customer records, transactions, and exemption certificates

Look up your product catalog and product tax categories

This MCP server informs your decisions rather than acting on your behalf: it doesn't file a return, register you in a new jurisdiction, or change any settings. 

Built for finance, accounting, and operations teams who need fast, accurate answers about their compliance status, whether that's confirming a nexus threshold, checking a customer's exemption history, or estimating tax on a new deal.

plugin_asdk_app_6a9f623cba108191ba258ab4.name: Testfolio
plugin_asdk_app_6a9f623cba108191ba258ab4.productIntroEn: Testfolio connects an eligible Testfolio account to portfolio research in ChatGPT. Backtest and compare portfolios, analyze assets, optimize allocations, evaluate tactical strategies and signals, and study retirement withdrawals, Monte Carlo scenarios, leveraged ETFs, factors, and principal components.
plugin_asdk_app_6a9f623cba108191ba258ab4.longDescription: Testfolio connects an eligible Testfolio account to portfolio research in ChatGPT. Backtest and compare portfolios, analyze assets, optimize allocations, evaluate tactical strategies and signals, and study retirement withdrawals, Monte Carlo scenarios, leveraged ETFs, factors, and principal components. Results explain the effective data period, assumptions, ticker provenance, key metrics, and compact summaries of large datasets. Analysis calls record account usage and may consume analysis credits. Users can explicitly create a public configuration link after a successful supported analysis. Testfolio supports historical, simulated, and hypothetical research; it does not execute trades or move money. Access requires Testfolio Max or a separate MCP grant, with tools subject to the connected account's limits.

plugin_asdk_app_6aa11e1e178c8191a6ab3726.productIntroEn: Gate Info provides public, read-only cryptocurrency research data for ChatGPT: coin profiles, market overview and spot snapshots (including batch), Gate candlesticks, order book depth, and recent trades across spot, futures, delivery, and options where supported. No login, no account balances, no order placement or fund transfers. Data is informational only and is not investment advice.
